text: Describe a person you know who would like to choose a career in the medical field (e.g. a doctor, a nurse).
bullets: When you knew him or her
When he or she started to think about that
What he or she would like to do
And explain why he or she would like to choose this career

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“人物类 + 职业规划类”话题，要求你描述一个想从事医疗行业的人。需要说清：你什么时候认识他或她、他或她什么时候开始有这个想法、未来想做什么，以及为什么会选择这个职业。整体以过去时和现在时结合为主。重点在于职业动机和个人特点。
这里可以选择朋友、同学或亲戚。思路上可以先说清你是什么时候认识这个人的；然后要说清他或她什么时候开始想进入医疗行业；接着可以重点说具体想从事什么工作，比如医生或护士；最后解释为什么他或她会选择这个职业。
第一段：介绍这个人是谁以及你什么时候认识他或她；第二段：描述他或她什么时候开始考虑医疗行业以及想做什么；第三段：解释他或她为什么选择这个职业，并表达你的看法。

phrases: The person I want to talk about is my classmate. 我想说的人是我的同学。
I met her in high school. 我是在高中认识她的。
背景描述 She has always been interested in science. 她一直对科学感兴趣。
She is patient and responsible. 她很有耐心也很负责。
Many people think she is suitable for this career. 很多人觉得她适合这个职业。
She started thinking about this career a few years ago. 她几年前开始考虑这个职业。
She would like to become a doctor. 她想成为一名医生。
具体描述 She spends a lot of time studying biology. 她花很多时间学习生物。
She also enjoys helping other people. 她也喜欢帮助别人。
She hopes to work in a large hospital one day. 她希望未来在大医院工作。
I admire her determination. 我佩服她的决心。
This career requires a lot of hard work. 这个职业需要很多努力。
描述感受 I think she has the right personality for it. 我觉得她有适合这个职业的性格。
Her goal sounds meaningful and valuable. 她的目标听起来很有意义。
That is why I support her decision. 这就是我支持她决定的原因。
answer: A person I know who would like to choose a career in the medical field is one of my classmates from high school. I met her when we were in the same science class, and over time I noticed that she was very interested in subjects related to biology and health. She was also known as a patient and responsible person, so many classmates thought she would be suitable for medical work in the future. She started thinking seriously about this career a few years ago when one of her family members became ill and spent a long time in the hospital. During that period, she saw how doctors and nurses worked hard to help patients every day. Since then, she has wanted to become a doctor herself. She now spends a lot of time studying biology and other science subjects because she hopes to enter medical school one day. I think she wants to choose this career mainly because she genuinely enjoys helping other people. She once told me that she would like to make patients feel safer and more comfortable during difficult times. In addition, she enjoys solving problems and learning scientific knowledge, which are both important in the medical field. Personally, I really admire her determination because becoming a doctor requires many years of hard work and study. I believe she has the right personality for this career, and I truly support her decision because it is both meaningful and valuable.
audio_text: Describe a person you know who would like to choose a career in the medical field (e.g. a doctor, a nurse). You should say: When you knew him or her; When he or she started to think about that; What he or she would like to do; And explain why he or she would like to choose this career
label: P2-1
P3-想从事医疗行业的人-Q1
text: Do you think being a doctor is easy or difficult?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“学习时间长”“工作压力大”“责任重”三个方面展开，说明医生职业的难度不仅来自知识，还来自责任感。
answer: I think being a doctor is very difficult. Doctors need to study for many years and learn a large amount of medical knowledge. They must also continue learning because medicine changes over time. Their work is stressful because they deal with sick people and make important decisions. Sometimes they need to work long hours or night shifts. A small mistake can seriously affect a patient’s health. So, being a doctor requires knowledge, patience, and a strong sense of responsibility, which makes it a challenging job.
audio_text: Do you think being a doctor is easy or difficult?

label: P3-想从事医疗行业的人-Q2
text: Do you think learning biology is interesting for children?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“了解自然”“满足好奇心”“实践性强”三个角度展开，解释为什么生物对儿童来说容易产生兴趣。
answer: Yes, I think learning biology is interesting for children. Biology helps children understand animals, plants, and the human body, which are all closely connected to daily life. Children are naturally curious about nature, so they often enjoy these topics. Biology can also include experiments and outdoor activities, which make learning more active and fun. Compared with subjects that require a lot of memorization, biology feels more practical and visual. So, biology is an interesting subject because it combines knowledge, curiosity, and real-life experience.
audio_text: Do you think learning biology is interesting for children?

text: Describe a person who works in a successful company
bullets: What he or she does in the company
And explain why you think it is a successful company

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“人物类 + 工作类”话题，要求你描述一位在成功公司工作的人。需要说清：这个人是谁、他或她在公司里做什么、公司从事什么业务，以及你为什么觉得这家公司很成功。整体以现在时为主。重点在于人物工作内容和公司成功原因。
这里可以选择亲戚、朋友或前同事。思路上可以先说清这个人的身份和你们的关系；然后要说清他或她在公司中的具体工作；接着介绍公司的业务内容；最后重点说你为什么认为这家公司成功，比如规模大、服务好或发展快。
第一段：介绍这个人是谁以及他或她在哪里工作；第二段：描述他或她的工作内容和公司业务；第三段：解释为什么你认为这家公司成功，并表达你的感受。

phrases: The person I want to talk about is my cousin. 我想说的人是我的表哥。
He works for a large technology company. 他在一家大型科技公司工作。
背景描述 I have known about his job for several years. 我了解他的工作已经好几年了。
The company is very popular in my country. 这家公司在我国家很有名。
Many young people want to work there. 很多年轻人都想在那里工作。
He works in the marketing department. 他在市场部门工作。
His job is to communicate with clients and promote products. 他的工作是和客户沟通并推广产品。
具体描述 The company mainly develops technology products. 这家公司主要开发科技产品。
It provides services to many customers. 它为很多顾客提供服务。
The company is growing very quickly. 这家公司发展得很快。
I think the company is well managed. 我觉得这家公司管理得很好。
It has a strong reputation. 它有很强的口碑。
描述感受 Many people trust its products and services. 很多人信任它的产品和服务。
I admire the working environment there. 我很欣赏那里的工作环境。
That is why I think it is a successful company. 这就是我认为它成功的原因。
answer: A person who works in a successful company is my cousin. He works for Tencent , which is one of the largest technology companies in China. I have known about his work for several years because we often talk during family gatherings, and he likes sharing stories about his job. He works in the marketing department, and his main responsibility is to communicate with clients and help promote the company’s online services and products. Sometimes he also works with other teams to plan business activities and improve customer experience. According to him, the company mainly focuses on technology, social media, online entertainment, and digital services. Many people use its apps and platforms every day, so the company has a very large customer base. I think this is a successful company for several reasons. First, it has a strong reputation and is well known both in China and internationally. Second, its products are widely used and trusted by millions of people. In addition, the company keeps developing new ideas and improving its services, which helps it stay competitive. My cousin also told me that the working environment is professional and organized, and employees have many opportunities to grow. Because of all these reasons, I believe it is a very successful company, and I feel proud that my cousin works there.
audio_text: Describe a person who works in a successful company You should say: Who he or she is; What he or she does in the company; What business the company does; And explain why you think it is a successful company
label: P2-2
P3-在成功公司工作的人-Q1
text: Do you think governments should provide financial support to companies?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以采取“有条件支持”的平衡观点。
answer: Yes, I think governments should provide financial support to companies in some situations. For example, small businesses may need help during economic difficulties or public emergencies. This support can protect jobs and help the economy stay stable. However, support should be fair and carefully controlled. Governments should help companies that truly need support and contribute to society. So, financial support can be useful, but it should be given responsibly and with clear rules.
audio_text: Do you think governments should provide financial support to companies?

label: P3-在成功公司工作的人-Q2
text: Do you think companies should donate money to help society?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“社会责任”“企业形象”“资源能力”展开。
answer: Yes, I think companies should donate money to help society when they are able to do so. Large companies often have more resources, so their support can help schools, hospitals, or people in need. Donations also improve a company’s public image and show social responsibility. However, companies should donate in a sincere and transparent way, not only for advertising. So, helping society through donations is positive for both communities and companies.
audio_text: Do you think companies should donate money to help society?

label: P3-在成功公司工作的人-Q3
text: Do you think customer satisfaction is important for a company?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“长期发展”“客户忠诚”“公司口碑”三个方面展开。
answer: Yes, customer satisfaction is very important for a company. Happy customers are more likely to buy products again and recommend the company to others. This helps businesses grow in the long term. Customer satisfaction also improves a company’s reputation. Today, online reviews spread very quickly, so bad service can damage a company’s image. So, keeping customers satisfied is important for both business success and public trust.
audio_text: Do you think customer satisfaction is important for a company?

text: Describe a friend from your childhood
bullets: Where and how you met each other
And explain what made you like him or her

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“人物类 + 童年回忆类”话题，要求你描述一位童年时期的朋友。需要说清：这个朋友是谁、你们在哪里以及如何认识、你们经常一起做什么，以及你为什么喜欢他或她。整体以过去时为主，最后可以适当用现在时表达现在的感受。重点在于共同经历和朋友的性格特点。
这里可以选择小学同学、邻居或亲戚家的孩子。思路上可以先说清你们是如何认识的；然后要说清你们小时候经常做的事情；接着可以重点说这个朋友的性格，比如友善、幽默或乐于帮助别人；最后总结你为什么喜欢他或她。
第一段：介绍这个朋友是谁，以及你们如何认识；第二段：描述你们小时候经常一起做什么；第三段：解释你为什么喜欢他或她，并总结感受。

phrases: The friend I want to talk about is named Jack. 我想说的朋友叫 Jack。
We met in primary school. 我们是在小学认识的。
背景描述 We were classmates for many years. 我们当了很多年同学。
He lived near my neighborhood. 他住在我家附近。
We became close friends quickly. 我们很快成了好朋友。
We often played games after school. 我们放学后经常一起玩游戏。
Sometimes we rode bicycles together. 有时候我们一起骑自行车。
具体描述 We also did homework together. 我们也会一起写作业。
We spent most weekends together. 我们很多周末都一起度过。
We shared many happy memories. 我们有很多快乐回忆。
He was very friendly and funny. 他非常友好也很幽默。
He always made people feel comfortable. 他总能让别人感到轻松。
描述感受 I could talk to him about anything. 我什么都可以和他说。
He was always willing to help me. 他总愿意帮助我。
That is why I liked him so much. 这就是我很喜欢他的原因。
answer: A friend from my childhood that I still remember clearly is a boy named Jack. We met in primary school when we were about eight years old. At that time, we were in the same class, and we quickly became friends because we both enjoyed similar activities. He also lived quite close to my neighborhood, so we often spent time together after school. When we were children, we did many things together. After finishing homework, we often played games in the park or rode bicycles around our neighborhood. During weekends, we sometimes watched cartoons or talked about toys and school life. We also studied together before exams, although most of the time we were simply having fun and enjoying each other’s company. Those small activities became some of my happiest childhood memories. What made me like him most was his personality. He was very friendly, funny, and easy to talk to. Whenever I felt upset or nervous, he could always make me laugh. He was also willing to help others, even with small things. I remember once when I forgot my homework, he stayed with me after class and helped me finish it. Being with him always made me feel relaxed and comfortable. Although we do not meet very often now, I still think of him whenever I remember my childhood. That is why he remains one of the most important childhood friends in my memory.
audio_text: Describe a friend from your childhood You should say: Who he or she is; Where and how you met each other; What you often did together; And explain what made you like him or her
label: P2-3
P3-发小-Q1
text: Do you still keep in touch with your friends from childhood? Why or why not?
strategy: 个人经历类问题。可以从“距离变化”“共同经历”“生活节奏”展开。
answer: Yes, I still keep in touch with some childhood friends. We shared many memories when growing up, so the friendship feels special and comfortable. Although we are now busy with work or study, we still chat online or meet during holidays. However, I have also lost contact with some friends because we moved to different places and have different lifestyles now. So, childhood friendships can last a long time, but keeping them requires effort and communication.
audio_text: Do you still keep in touch with your friends from childhood? Why or why not?

label: P3-发小-Q2
text: How important is childhood friendship to children?
strategy: 影响类问题。可以从“情感支持”“社交能力”“成长记忆”展开。
answer: Childhood friendship is very important to children. Friends give emotional support and help children feel happy and accepted. Playing and learning together also improve communication skills. Friendships teach children how to share, cooperate, and solve small conflicts. These experiences are useful for future relationships. Childhood friends also create special memories that many people remember for a long time. So, childhood friendship plays an important role in emotional and social development.
audio_text: How important is childhood friendship to children?

label: P3-发小-Q3
text: What do you think of communicating via social media?
strategy: ：观点类问题。可以从“便利性”和“情感局限”两个角度展开。
answer: I think communicating through social media is very convenient. People can stay connected with friends and family anytime, even when they live far away. It also allows people to share information quickly. However, social media communication may feel less personal than face-to-face conversation. Messages can sometimes be misunderstood because people cannot see facial expressions or hear tone of voice. So, social media is useful for communication, but real-life interaction is still important.
audio_text: What do you think of communicating via social media?

label: P3-发小-Q4
text: Do you think online communication through social media will replace face-to-face communication?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以明确“不会完全取代”，再解释原因。
answer: No, I don’t think social media communication will completely replace face-to-face communication. Online communication is fast and convenient, especially for people who live far away. However, face-to-face communication is more personal and emotional. People can see facial expressions, body language, and feelings more clearly in real life. This helps build stronger relationships and avoid misunderstanding. So, social media is useful, but direct communication will still remain important in people’s lives.
audio_text: Do you think online communication through social media will replace face-to-face communication?

topic: 喜欢在家或花园种植物的人
text: Describe a person who loves to grow plants (e.g. vegetables, flowers) at home or in the garden
bullets: What plants he or she grows
How he or she grows the plants
And explain why he or she loves growing plants

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“人物类 + 兴趣爱好类”话题，要求你描述一个喜欢种植物的人。需要说清：这个人是谁、他或她种什么植物、如何种植这些植物，以及为什么他或她喜欢种植物。整体以现在时为主。重点在于种植习惯和背后的原因。
这里可以选择家人、邻居或朋友。思路上可以先说清这个人的身份；然后要说清他或她种植的植物类型；接着可以重点说种植方式，比如阳台、花园或日常照顾过程；最后说明他或她为什么喜欢种植物，比如放松、健康或热爱自然。
第一段：介绍这个人是谁；第二段：描述他或她种什么植物以及如何种植；第三段：解释他或她为什么喜欢种植物，并表达你的感受。

phrases: e person I want to talk about is my grandfather. 我想说的人是我爷爷。
He enjoys spending time in the garden. 他喜欢待在花园里。
背景描述 He has grown plants for many years. 他种植物很多年了。
Gardening is one of his favorite hobbies. 园艺是他最喜欢的爱好之一。
He knows a lot about plants. 他懂很多植物知识。
He grows vegetables and flowers. 他种蔬菜和花。
He waters the plants every morning. 他每天早上给植物浇水。
具体描述 He also uses natural fertilizer. 他还会使用天然肥料。
He spends a lot of time taking care of the garden. 他花很多时间照顾花园。
The plants always look healthy and fresh. 这些植物总是看起来健康又新鲜。
Growing plants helps him relax. 种植物能让他放松。
He enjoys being close to nature. 他喜欢亲近自然。
描述感受 It gives him a sense of achievement. 这给他带来成就感。
I admire his patience and care. 我很佩服他的耐心和细心。
That is why I think he truly loves gardening. 这就是我认为他真正热爱园艺的原因。
answer: A person who loves growing plants is my grandfather. He has been interested in gardening for many years, and it has become one of his favorite hobbies. Behind his house, there is a small garden where he spends a lot of his free time every day. He mainly grows vegetables and flowers. For vegetables, he grows tomatoes, peppers, and green onions, while for flowers, he likes growing roses and sunflowers. Every morning, he waters the plants carefully and checks whether they are healthy. He also removes weeds and sometimes uses natural fertilizer to help the plants grow better. During different seasons, he changes the types of plants in the garden and learns new ways to take care of them. Because of his effort, the garden always looks colorful and fresh. I think he loves growing plants because it helps him relax and feel close to nature. Whenever he talks about his garden, he looks happy and excited. He also enjoys seeing the plants grow little by little, which gives him a strong sense of achievement. In addition, he likes sharing vegetables and flowers with neighbors and family members, which makes him feel useful and connected to others. I really admire his patience and care, because gardening requires a lot of time and attention. That is why I believe he truly loves growing plants and enjoys every moment he spends in the garden.
audio_text: Describe a person who loves to grow plants (e.g. vegetables, flowers) at home or in the garden You should say: Who this person is; What plants he or she grows; How he or she grows the plants; And explain why he or she loves growing plants
label: P2-4

topic: 喜欢在家或花园种植物的人
label: P3-喜欢在家或花园种植物的人-Q1
text: What are the advantages of growing vegetables or flowers at home?
strategy: 优势类问题。可以从“放松身心”“健康”“美化环境”三个方面展开。
answer: Growing vegetables or flowers at home has many advantages. First, it helps people relax and reduce stress. Taking care of plants can make people feel calm and happy. Growing vegetables is also healthy because people can eat fresh food they grow themselves. Flowers make the home look more beautiful and comfortable. In addition, gardening teaches patience and responsibility. So, growing plants at home is good for both physical and mental well-being.
audio_text: What are the advantages of growing vegetables or flowers at home?

topic: 喜欢在家或花园种植物的人
label: P3-喜欢在家或花园种植物的人-Q2
text: Do many people grow vegetables or flowers at home in your country?
strategy: 现象类问题。可以从“城市与农村差异”“兴趣”“生活方式”展开。
answer: Yes, some people in my country grow vegetables or flowers at home, especially older people and families with gardens or balconies. Flowers are more common in cities because they make homes look beautiful and relaxing. In rural areas, people are more likely to grow vegetables because they have more space. Growing plants is also seen as a healthy and enjoyable hobby. So, while not everyone grows plants at home, it is still a popular activity in many families.
audio_text: Do many people grow vegetables or flowers at home in your country?

topic: 喜欢在家或花园种植物的人
label: P3-喜欢在家或花园种植物的人-Q3
text: Is it easy to grow plants at home?
strategy: 评估类问题。可以给出“简单但需要耐心”的平衡观点。
answer: Growing plants at home can be easy if people choose simple plants. Some flowers and vegetables only need sunlight, water, and basic care. However, certain plants are harder to grow because they need special temperatures or regular attention. Busy people may also forget to take care of them. So, growing plants at home is possible for most people, but success depends on time, patience, and the type of plant.
audio_text: Is it easy to grow plants at home?

topic: 喜欢在家或花园种植物的人
label: P3-喜欢在家或花园种植物的人-Q4
text: Why do some people like to grow plants?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“放松”“美化环境”“健康生活”三个角度展开。
answer: People like to grow plants because it helps them relax and feel closer to nature. Taking care of plants can reduce stress and improve mood. Plants also make homes more beautiful and comfortable. Some people grow vegetables because they enjoy fresh and healthy food. In addition, gardening gives people a sense of achievement when plants grow well. So, growing plants is popular because it benefits both mental health and daily life.
audio_text: Why do some people like to grow plants?

text: Describe a person you know who has a successful business
bullets: How you got to know him or her
Why and how he or she started the business
What business he or she does
And explain why you think the business is successful

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“人物类 + 商业类”话题，要求你描述一个经营成功生意的人。需要说清：这个人是谁、你是怎么认识他或她的、他或她为什么以及如何开始创业、从事什么生意，以及你为什么认为这门生意是成功的。整体以过去时和现在时结合为主。重点在于创业原因、经营方式和成功原因。
这里可以选择亲戚、朋友或邻居。思路上可以先说清你和这个人的关系；然后要说清他或她为什么开始创业；接着重点可以放在生意内容以及经营方式；最后说明为什么你觉得这门生意很成功，比如顾客多、口碑好或发展稳定。
第一段：介绍这个人是谁，以及你是如何认识他或她的；第二段：描述他或她为什么创业以及具体经营什么；第三段：解释为什么你认为这门生意成功，并表达你的看法。

phrases: The person I want to talk about is my uncle. 我想说的人是我叔叔。
I have known him since childhood. 我从小就认识他。
背景描述 He owns a small business. 他经营一家小生意。
He started the business several years ago. 他几年前开始创业。
At first, the business was quite small. 一开始生意规模很小。
He runs a local restaurant. 他经营一家本地餐馆。
He started the business because he enjoys cooking. 他创业是因为喜欢做饭。
He worked very hard in the beginning. 一开始他工作非常努力。
具体描述
He pays attention to customer service. 他很重视顾客服务。
The restaurant is always busy. 这家餐馆总是很忙。
描述感受
I think he is very determined. 我觉得他很有决心。
The business has a good reputation. 这门生意口碑很好。
描述感受 Many customers return regularly. 很多顾客都会再来。
I admire his hard work and patience. 我佩服他的努力和耐心。
That is why I think his business is successful. 这就是我认为他生意成功的原因。
answer: A person I know who has a successful business is my uncle. I have known him since childhood because he is a close family member, and over the years I have watched his business grow step by step. He owns a local restaurant in our city, and it has become quite popular among local people. My uncle started this business several years ago because he has always enjoyed cooking. Before opening his own restaurant, he worked in other restaurants and learned a lot about food and customer service. At first, his business was very small, and he had to do many things by himself, including cooking, cleaning, and talking with customers. However, he worked very hard and slowly improved the restaurant. He focused on serving fresh food and treating customers politely, which helped him build a good reputation. Now the restaurant is usually busy, especially during weekends and holidays. Many customers come back regularly, and some even recommend the place to their friends. I think the business is successful not only because it makes money, but also because people genuinely like it and trust it. My uncle is also very patient and responsible, and he never stops improving his service. I really admire his hard work and determination. Watching him succeed taught me that running a business requires both effort and good communication skills. That is why I believe his business is truly successful.
audio_text: Describe a person you know who has a successful business You should say: Who this person is; How you got to know him or her; Why and how he or she started the business; What business he or she does; And explain why you think the business is successful
label: P2-5
P3-拥有成功商业的人-Q1
text: Why do some people start their own business?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“自由”“赚钱机会”“个人兴趣”展开。
answer: Some people start their own business because they want more freedom. They prefer making their own decisions instead of following company rules all the time. Others believe running a business can bring better income and personal success. Some people also want to turn their hobbies or ideas into work. Although starting a business is risky, it can give people a strong sense of achievement. So, independence, interest, and financial goals are common reasons for becoming entrepreneurs.
audio_text: Why do some people start their own business?

label: P3-拥有成功商业的人-Q2
text: Should governments provide financial support to start-ups?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“创新”“就业”“风险控制”展开。
answer: Yes, governments should provide some financial support to start-ups. New businesses can create jobs and bring new ideas to society. Many small companies have potential but lack money in the beginning. Government support can help them survive difficult early stages. However, support should be carefully managed, and companies should meet clear standards. So, helping start-ups can support innovation and economic growth when done responsibly.
audio_text: Should governments provide financial support to start-ups?

label: P3-拥有成功商业的人-Q3
text: Do most people prefer shopping at big stores or small stores?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以给出“大店更普遍”的观点，再补充小店的优势。
answer: I think most people prefer shopping at big stores because they offer more choices and lower prices. People can buy many things in one place, which saves time and feels convenient. However, some people still like small stores because the service is more personal and friendly. Small shops may also sell local or unique products. So, big stores are more popular overall, but small stores still have their own advantages.
audio_text: Do most people prefer shopping at big stores or small stores?

label: P3-拥有成功商业的人-Q4
text: What makes a business successful?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“产品质量”“客户服务”“管理能力”展开。
answer: A successful business usually provides good products or services. If customers are satisfied, they are more likely to return and recommend the business to others. Good management is also important. Business owners need clear plans and responsible workers. In addition, understanding customer needs helps businesses stay competitive. So, quality, good service, and effective management are key factors in business success.
audio_text: What makes a business successful?

topic: 擅长学习和说语言的人
text: Describe a person who is good at learning and speaking new languages
bullets: How you got to know him or her
How he or she learns a new language
What languages he or she can speak
And explain how you feel about him/her

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“人物类 + 能力类”话题，要求你描述一个擅长学习和说外语的人。需要说清：你是怎么认识他或她的、他或她如何学习新语言、会说哪些语言，以及你对他或她的感受。整体以现在时为主。重点在于学习方法、语言能力以及你对这个人的评价。
这里可以选择朋友、同学或同事。思路上可以先说清你们是怎么认识的；然后要说清他或她学习语言的方法，比如日常练习、模仿或交流；接着可以重点说他或她会哪些语言；最后表达你对这个人的感受，比如佩服、受到鼓励或觉得很厉害。
第一段：介绍这个人是谁以及你如何认识他或她；第二段：描述他或她学习语言的方法和会说的语言；第三段：解释你对他或她的感受，并总结原因。

phrases: The person I want to talk about is my colleague. 我想说的人是我的同事。
I got to know him at work. 我是在工作中认识他的。
背景描述 He has a strong interest in languages. 他对语言很感兴趣。
He enjoys communicating with different people. 他喜欢和不同的人交流。
Learning languages is part of his daily life. 学语言已经成了他日常生活的一部分。
He practices listening and speaking every day. 他每天练习听力和口语。
He likes reading short articles in foreign languages. 他喜欢阅读外语短文章。
具体描述 He often watches videos without subtitles. 他经常不看字幕看视频。
He can speak English, Spanish, and some Korean. 他会说英语、西班牙语和一些韩语。
He learns by using the language actively. 他通过主动使用语言来学习。
I think he is very disciplined. 我觉得他非常自律。
His progress is really impressive. 他的进步非常惊人。
描述感受 He motivates me to study harder. 他激励我更努力学习。
I admire his confidence and patience. 我佩服他的自信和耐心。
That is why I respect him a lot. 这就是我很尊敬他的原因。
answer: A person who is very good at learning and speaking new languages is one of my colleagues. I got to know him a few years ago when we started working in the same office. From our first conversation, I noticed that he was very interested in different cultures and languages. He has a very consistent way of learning new languages. Every day, he spends some time practicing listening and speaking. He often watches foreign videos without subtitles and reads short articles in different languages during breaks. Instead of only memorizing vocabulary, he prefers using the language actively in real conversations. He also talks with online language partners and sometimes records his own voice to improve pronunciation. According to him, regular practice is more important than studying for many hours once in a while. At the moment, he can speak English fluently, and he also speaks Spanish quite well. Besides that, he knows some Korean because he has been learning it for the past two years. What surprised me most is that he can switch between languages very naturally during conversations. I really admire him because learning languages requires patience and discipline, and he has both qualities. His attitude also makes language learning seem less stressful and more enjoyable. After seeing his progress, I became more motivated to improve my own English speaking skills. That is why I respect him a lot and think he is truly talented in this area.
audio_text: Describe a person who is good at learning and speaking new languages You should say: How you got to know him or her; How he or she learns a new language; What languages he or she can speak; And explain how you feel about him/her
label: P2-6

topic: 擅长学习和说语言的人
label: P3-擅长学习和说语言的人-Q1
text: Are there many people who can speak foreign languages in your country?
strategy: 现象类问题。可以从“英语教育普及”和“实际使用能力差异”展开。
answer: Yes, many people in my country study foreign languages, especially English. Students usually begin learning English at school from a young age. However, there is still a difference between learning a language and speaking it fluently. People living in large cities or working in international companies often use foreign languages more confidently. Older people may have fewer chances to practice. So, many people can speak some foreign languages, but fluency levels are quite different.
audio_text: Are there many people who can speak foreign languages in your country?

topic: 擅长学习和说语言的人
label: P3-擅长学习和说语言的人-Q2
text: Does speaking other languages help at work?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“工作机会”“沟通能力”“国际合作”展开。
answer: Yes, speaking other languages can help a lot at work. It gives people more job opportunities, especially in international companies or tourism-related industries. Knowing another language also improves communication with clients and coworkers from different countries. It can help people build stronger professional relationships. So, language skills are valuable because they improve both career opportunities and workplace communication
audio_text: Does speaking other languages help at work?

topic: 擅长学习和说语言的人
label: P3-擅长学习和说语言的人-Q3
text: Do people learn any languages other than English?
strategy: 现象类问题。可以从“教育需求”“兴趣”“工作机会”展开。
answer: Yes, some people learn languages other than English. Popular choices include Japanese, Korean, French, and Spanish. Some people learn these languages because of work or study opportunities, while others are interested in foreign culture, music, or travel. Young people are especially interested in learning languages connected to entertainment and social media. So, although English is the most common foreign language, many people also study other languages for different reasons.
audio_text: Do people learn any languages other than English?

topic: 擅长学习和说语言的人
label: P3-擅长学习和说语言的人-Q4
text: Why is it easier for children to learn new things than for adults?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“大脑发展”“时间精力”“害怕犯错较少”展开。
answer: It is often easier for children to learn new things because their brains are still developing and adapting quickly. Children are naturally curious and willing to try new experiences. They are also less afraid of making mistakes, which helps them learn more confidently. Adults, on the other hand, are usually busier and may feel more pressure or stress when learning. So, flexibility, curiosity, and fewer worries make learning easier for children.
audio_text: Why is it easier for children to learn new things than for adults?

text: Describe a time when you worked in a group
bullets: And explain why you worked in the group

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“经历类 + 合作类”话题，要求你描述一次团队合作经历。需要说清：你们做了什么、和谁一起合作、过程中遇到了什么问题，以及为什么需要团队合作。整体以过去时为主。重点在于合作过程和问题解决。
这里可以选择学校项目、比赛或活动准备。思路上可以先说清任务内容和团队成员；然后要说清你们合作过程中遇到的问题，比如时间不够、意见不同；接着可以重点说大家如何解决问题；最后说明为什么这项任务需要团队合作。
第一段：介绍这次团队合作是什么，以及你和谁一起完成；第二段：描述你们遇到的问题和合作过程；第三段：解释为什么需要团队合作，并总结你的感受。

phrases: The experience happened during high school. 这次经历发生在高中。
I worked with several classmates. 我和几个同学一起合作。
背景描述 We were preparing a group presentation. 我们当时在准备小组展示。
Everyone had different responsibilities. 每个人都有不同任务。
The project was important for our final grade. 这个项目对期末成绩很重要。
We faced some communication problems. 我们遇到了一些沟通问题。
Some members had different ideas. 有些成员有不同想法。
具体描述 We also had limited time. 我们时间也很紧。
In the end, we divided the work clearly. 最后我们明确分工。
We helped each other finish the project. 我们互相帮助完成了项目。
I learned the importance of teamwork. 我学到了团队合作的重要性。
Working together made the task easier. 一起合作让任务变得更容易。
描述感受 I felt proud of our final result. 我为最后的成果感到自豪。
The experience improved my communication skills. 这次经历提升了我的沟通能力。
That is why I still remember this experience clearly. 这就是我至今仍记得这次经历的原因。
answer: A time when I worked in a group was during high school when my classmates and I prepared a group presentation for an English class. The project was very important because it counted toward our final grade, so everyone took it seriously. There were five students in the group, including me, and each person had different responsibilities. Our topic was about environmental protection, and we needed to collect information, make slides, and give a presentation in front of the class. At the beginning, we faced some problems because everyone had different ideas about how to organize the project. In addition, we did not have much free time because we also had other homework and exams. Sometimes communication became difficult, and a few members worried that we would not finish everything on time. In the end, we solved the problem by dividing the work more clearly. One person focused on finding information, another worked on the design of the slides, and others practiced speaking. We also created a simple schedule so that everyone knew what to do. Because we worked together and helped each other, we finished the project successfully and received positive feedback from the teacher. I think we worked in a group because the task was too large for one person to complete alone. This experience taught me the importance of teamwork and communication. It also helped me become more patient and organized when working with others.
audio_text: Describe a time when you worked in a group You should say: What you did; Who you worked with; What problems you faced; And explain why you worked in the group
label: P2-7
P3-在团队中工作-Q1
text: Why do some people prefer to work by themselves?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“自由度”“工作效率”“减少社交压力”三个角度展开。
answer: Some people prefer to work by themselves because they enjoy freedom and independence. When working alone, they can decide their own schedule and working style. Working alone may also improve concentration. Some people feel more efficient without too many meetings or discussions. In addition, introverted people may feel more comfortable without strong social pressure. So, people who value independence and quiet working environments often prefer to work alone.
audio_text: Why do some people prefer to work by themselves?

label: P3-在团队中工作-Q2
text: What should a leader do to make team members want to follow him or her?
strategy: 解决方式类问题。可以从“沟通”“公平”“以身作则”三个方面展开。
answer: A good leader should communicate clearly and respect team members. When people understand goals and feel listened to, they are more willing to follow the leader. Fairness is also important. Leaders should treat everyone equally and recognize hard work. In addition, leaders should set a good example by working responsibly and staying positive. So, strong communication, fairness, and good behavior help leaders gain trust and support from their teams.
audio_text: What should a leader do to make team members want to follow him or her?

label: P3-在团队中工作-Q3
text: Should students learn to do group work?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“团队合作”“沟通能力”“未来工作需求”三个方面展开。
answer: Yes, students should learn to do group work. Group activities help students improve teamwork and communication skills. They learn how to share ideas and solve problems together. Group work is also useful for future jobs because many workplaces require cooperation. In addition, students can learn from classmates with different opinions and strengths. So, group work not only improves learning but also helps students develop important social skills.
audio_text: Should students learn to do group work?

label: P3-在团队中工作-Q4
text: What group tasks are there in schools?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“课堂项目”“体育活动”“讨论展示”三个方面举例。
answer: There are many group tasks in schools. Students often work together on projects, presentations, or research activities. These tasks require students to share ideas and divide responsibilities. Sports activities are also common group tasks because students need teamwork and cooperation. In some classes, students join discussions or solve problems together in groups. So, group tasks help students improve communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
audio_text: What group tasks are there in schools?

text: Describe a time when you got up early
bullets: And how you felt about it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“经历类 + 日常生活类”话题，要求你描述一次你早起的经历。需要说清：是什么时候、你做了什么、为什么要早起，以及你对这次经历的感受。整体以过去时为主。重点在于早起原因和当时的体验。
这里可以选择考试、旅行、活动或重要安排。思路上可以先说清时间背景；然后要说清你早起后做了什么；接着可以重点说为什么必须早起；最后描述你当时的感受，比如疲惫、兴奋或满足。
第一段：介绍什么时候早起以及原因；第二段：描述你早起后做了什么；第三段：解释你的感受，并总结这次经历。

phrases: The experience happened last summer. 这次经历发生在去年夏天。
I had to wake up very early. 我必须很早起床。
背景描述 It was earlier than my normal routine. 这比我平时起得早。
I usually do not wake up that early. 我平时不那么早起。
The day was quite important to me. 那天对我来说很重要。
I got up at around five o’clock. 我大约五点起床。
I quickly prepared everything. 我很快准备好了一切。
具体描述 I went out before sunrise. 我在日出前出了门。
I spent most of the morning traveling. 我大半个早上都在路上。
The streets were quiet and peaceful. 街道很安静。
At first, I felt very sleepy. 一开始我很困。
Later, I started to feel excited. 后来我开始感到兴奋。
描述感受 The fresh morning air made me feel relaxed. 清晨的新鲜空气让我很放松。
I felt satisfied after finishing everything. 完成事情后我很满足。
That is why I still remember this experience clearly. 这就是我至今还清楚记得这次经历的原因。
answer: A time when I got up early was last summer when I went on a short trip with my friends. We planned to take an early train, so I had to wake up at around five o’clock in the morning, which was much earlier than my normal routine. Usually, I prefer sleeping a little longer, so getting up that early was not easy for me. After waking up, I quickly washed my face, packed my bag, and checked my tickets and phone one more time before leaving home. I went out before sunrise and met my friends at the train station. During the journey, we talked about our travel plans and watched the city slowly become brighter as the sun came up. The streets were much quieter than usual, and the fresh morning air made everything feel calm and peaceful. I got up early that day because I did not want to miss the train, and I was also excited about the trip. At first, I felt very sleepy and tired, but later I became more energetic and happy. Although waking up early was difficult, I felt satisfied because the whole day went smoothly and we had a wonderful trip together. This experience also made me realize that getting up early can sometimes make a day feel longer and more productive. That is why I still remember this experience clearly.
audio_text: Describe a time when you got up early You should say: When it was; What you did; Why you got up early; And how you felt about it
label: P2-8
P3-早起经历-Q1
text: Is it good to arrive early in any situation?
strategy: 个人举例类问题。可以简单描述人物和原因。
answer: Yes, I know several people who like to get up early, especially older family members. They believe mornings are quiet and peaceful, which helps them start the day in a good mood. Some people exercise, read, or prepare work early in the morning because they feel more energetic at that time. My friend also likes getting up early to avoid traffic and have a more organized day. So, people who enjoy quiet time and good routines often prefer waking up early.
audio_text: Is it good to arrive early in any situation?

label: P3-早起经历-Q2
text: Do you know anyone who likes to get up early?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“工作学习”“生活习惯”“效率感”展开。
answer: People get up early for different reasons. Many people need to start work or school early, especially in busy cities with heavy traffic. Some people also believe mornings are the most peaceful and productive time of the day. They use the early hours to exercise, read, or prepare for work. Older people often wake up early because of long-term habits. So, work needs, personal routines, and lifestyle habits are the main reasons people get up early.
audio_text: Do you know anyone who likes to get up early?

label: P3-早起经历-Q3
text: Why do people get up early?
strategy: 情境类问题。可以从“正式场合”“交通不确定性”“礼貌”展开。
answer: People usually need to arrive early for important or formal occasions. Job interviews, exams, and business meetings are good examples because being late may cause problems or leave a bad impression. People also arrive early for flights, concerts, or weddings to avoid traffic and prepare calmly. Arriving early shows respect and good planning. So, events with strict schedules or social importance usually require people to come early.
audio_text: Why do people get up early?

label: P3-早起经历-Q4
text: What kinds of occasions need people to arrive early?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“工作学习”“个人习惯”“夜晚安静”展开。
answer: Some people like to stay up late because they feel more relaxed and focused at night. The environment is usually quieter, so they can study, work, or enjoy hobbies without interruption. Others stay up late because of busy schedules or entertainment, such as watching videos or playing games. Some people naturally prefer sleeping later due to personal habits. So, lifestyle, work pressure, and personal preference are common reasons for staying up late.
audio_text: What kinds of occasions need people to arrive early?

text: Describe a live sports event you watched and liked
bullets: When and where you watched it
And explain why you liked it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“事件经历类 + 体育类”话题，要求你描述一次你看过并且喜欢的现场体育赛事。需要说清：这是什么比赛、你什么时候和在哪里看的、和谁一起看的，以及你为什么喜欢这场比赛。整体以过去时为主。重点在于现场氛围和个人感受。
这里可以选择足球、篮球或其他热门体育赛事。思路上可以先说清比赛类型；然后要说清观看时间、地点和同行的人；接着可以重点说比赛过程中让你印象深刻的地方；最后说明你为什么喜欢这场比赛。
第一段：介绍这场体育赛事是什么，以及你什么时候、在哪里观看；第二段：描述比赛过程和你和谁一起看；第三段：解释为什么你喜欢这场比赛，并总结感受。

phrases: The sports event I want to talk about was a basketball game. 我想说的体育赛事是一场篮球比赛。
I watched it last year. 我是去年看的。
背景描述 The match took place in a large stadium. 比赛在一个大型体育馆举行。
Many fans attended the event. 很多球迷都去了现场。
The atmosphere was very exciting. 现场气氛非常热烈。
I watched the game with my friends. 我和朋友一起看了比赛。
The players performed very well. 球员们表现得很好。
具体描述 The score stayed very close during the game. 比分一直很接近。
Everyone cheered loudly during important moments. 关键时刻大家都大声欢呼。
The final part of the game was especially exciting. 比赛最后阶段尤其精彩。
I enjoyed the energy of the crowd. 我很喜欢现场观众的氛围。
Watching it live felt very different from TV. 现场观看和电视上很不一样。
描述感受 The game kept me excited the whole time. 整场比赛都让我很兴奋。
It became a memorable experience for me. 它成了我难忘的经历。
That is why I liked this sports event so much. 这就是我这么喜欢这场赛事的原因。
answer: A live sports event I watched and really liked was a basketball game between two professional teams. I watched it last year in a large indoor stadium in my city. It was my first time watching a professional basketball game live, so I felt quite excited even before the match started. I went there with two of my close friends because we all enjoy watching basketball. When we arrived at the stadium, there were already many fans wearing team shirts and cheering loudly. The atmosphere was much more energetic than I expected. During the game, both teams played very well, and the score stayed close for most of the match. The most exciting part was near the end, when one team scored an important three-point shot just before the final whistle. Everyone around us stood up and shouted at the same time. I liked this sports event mainly because of the atmosphere and the excitement of watching everything happen in real time. Watching the game live felt completely different from watching it on television. I could hear the crowd, see the players clearly, and feel the energy inside the stadium. In addition, spending time with my friends made the experience even more enjoyable. It became one of my favorite sports memories, and that is why I still remember this event so clearly.
audio_text: Describe a live sports event you watched and liked You should say: What it was; When and where you watched it; Who you watched it with; And explain why you liked it
label: P2-9
P3-喜欢的现场体育赛事-Q1
text: Why do some people like to watch sports events?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“娱乐性”“团队支持”“情绪体验”三个角度展开。
answer: Some people like watching sports events because they are exciting and entertaining. Sports games often have competition and unexpected results, which keep viewers interested. Many people also support certain teams or athletes, so watching sports gives them a strong sense of connection and excitement. Watching games with friends or family can also be a social activity. So, sports events are popular because they provide entertainment, emotional excitement, and opportunities for social interaction.
audio_text: Why do some people like to watch sports events?

label: P3-喜欢的现场体育赛事-Q2
text: Where do people normally watch sports events?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“家里”“体育场”“公共场所”展开。
answer: People usually watch sports events at home because it is comfortable and convenient. They can watch games on TV or online with family and friends. Some sports fans prefer watching events in stadiums because the atmosphere is more exciting and energetic. In addition, people sometimes watch important games in restaurants or public places together. So, people choose different places depending on convenience, cost, and the kind of experience they want.
audio_text: Where do people normally watch sports events?

label: P3-喜欢的现场体育赛事-Q3
text: What are the advantages of watching sports events online?
strategy: 优势类问题。可以从“方便”“选择多”“互动性”展开。
answer: Watching sports events online has many advantages. First, it is very convenient because people can watch games anywhere with a phone or computer. Online platforms also offer more choices, such as highlights, replays, and different camera angles. Some people enjoy chatting with other fans online while watching games, which makes the experience more interactive. So, online sports viewing is flexible, convenient, and more personalized for modern audiences.
audio_text: What are the advantages of watching sports events online?

label: P3-喜欢的现场体育赛事-Q4
text: What sports matches are suitable for children to attend?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“安全性”“娱乐性”“教育意义”展开。
answer: Sports matches that are safe, friendly, and exciting are suitable for children. For example, football, basketball, or swimming competitions are popular because children can enjoy the atmosphere and learn teamwork. Events with positive behavior and good organization are important because children may learn from players and audiences. Matches that are too violent or aggressive may not be suitable for younger children. So, sports events that are fun, educational, and safe are the best choices for children.
audio_text: What sports matches are suitable for children to attend?

text: Describe a time when you had a problem with using an electronic device
bullets: And explain how you solved the problem at last

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“事件经历类 + 科技类”话题，要求你描述一次使用电子设备时遇到的问题。需要说清：事情发生在什么时候、在哪里、出现了什么问题，以及最后你是如何解决的。整体以过去时为主。重点在于问题过程和解决方式。
这里可以选择手机、电脑、平板或耳机等设备。思路上可以先说清事情发生的时间和地点；然后要说清具体问题是什么；接着可以重点说你当时的反应和解决过程；最后表达你从这次经历中的感受。
第一段：介绍什么时候、在哪里发生了这个问题；第二段：描述电子设备出现的问题以及你的反应；第三段：解释你最后如何解决问题，并总结感受。

phrases: The problem happened a few months ago. 这个问题发生在几个月前。
I was using my laptop at home. 我当时正在家里用笔记本电脑。
背景描述 The device suddenly stopped working properly. 设备突然无法正常工作。
I depended on it a lot at that time. 当时我很依赖这个设备。
The situation made me feel nervous. 当时让我有点紧张。
The screen suddenly went black. 屏幕突然黑了。
The device could not restart normally. 设备无法正常重启。
具体描述 I tried several simple methods first. 我先尝试了几个简单方法。
I searched for solutions online. 我在网上搜索了解决办法。
In the end, I asked a technician for help. 最后我找了技术人员帮忙。
At first, I felt stressed and worried. 一开始我感到紧张和担心。
I was afraid of losing important files. 我担心重要文件丢失。
描述感受 Luckily, the problem was solved in the end. 幸运的是最后问题解决了。
The experience taught me to back up my files. 这次经历让我学会备份文件。
That is why I still remember this experience clearly. 这就是我现在还记得这次经历的原因。
answer: A time when I had a problem with using an electronic device was a few months ago when I was using my laptop at home. I depended on it heavily because I needed it for both work and study, so the problem made me feel quite nervous. One evening, while I was working on an important document, the screen suddenly went black. At first, I thought the battery had run out, but after charging it for some time, the laptop still could not restart normally. I tried several simple methods by myself, such as restarting the computer and checking the power connection, but nothing worked. At that moment, I became worried because I was afraid of losing some important files stored on the laptop. After trying to solve the problem alone, I searched online for possible solutions. I followed some instructions from a technology forum, but the device still did not work properly. In the end, I decided to take the laptop to a repair shop near my home. The technician checked the computer and told me there was a problem with the system software. Luckily, he managed to repair it without deleting my files. I felt very relieved after the laptop started working again. This experience taught me that electronic devices can fail unexpectedly, so it is important to back up important files regularly. That is why I still remember this experience very clearly.
audio_text: Describe a time when you had a problem with using an electronic device You should say: When it happened; Where it happened; What the problem was; And explain how you solved the problem at last
label: P2-10
P3-坏掉的电子设备-Q1
text: Why are people keen on buying new electronic devices?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“功能升级”“社会趋势”“便利性”三个方面展开。
answer: People are keen on buying new electronic devices because technology changes quickly. New products often have better functions, faster speed, and more convenient features. Some people also buy new devices because of social trends. They want to keep up with modern lifestyles or own fashionable products. In addition, electronic devices help people with work, study, and entertainment. So, improved technology, convenience, and social influence make electronic products very attractive to many people.
audio_text: Why are people keen on buying new electronic devices?

label: P3-坏掉的电子设备-Q2
text: What impact do electronic devices have on people?
strategy: 影响类问题。可以从“便利性”和“负面依赖”两方面展开。
answer: Electronic devices have changed people’s lives a lot. They make communication, learning, and work much more convenient. People can quickly get information and stay connected through phones or computers. However, electronic devices can also create problems. Some people spend too much time on screens and become less active. Overuse may also affect sleep and face-to-face communication. So, electronic devices bring many benefits, but people should use them in a balanced way.
audio_text: What impact do electronic devices have on people?

text: Describe a challenging technological problem you faced
bullets: When and where you faced it
And explain how you solved it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“事件经历类 + 科技类”话题，要求你描述一次你遇到的技术问题。需要说清：问题是什么、你什么时候和在哪里遇到的、它有多困难，以及你是如何解决它的。整体以过去时为主。重点在于问题解决过程和你的感受。
这里可以选择电脑、手机、网络或软件相关问题。思路上可以先说清发生的时间和场景；然后要说清具体技术问题；接着可以重点说这个问题为什么困难；最后说明你是如何一步步解决它的。
第一段：介绍你遇到的技术问题是什么；第二段：描述问题发生的时间、地点以及困难之处；第三段：解释你是如何解决问题的，并表达你的感受。

phrases: The problem happened while I was using my laptop. 问题发生在我用笔记本电脑的时候。
It happened a few months ago. 这件事发生在几个月前。
背景描述 I was working on an important task. 我当时正在处理一个重要任务。
The situation made me feel stressed. 当时让我很紧张。
I had never faced this problem before. 我以前从没遇到过这个问题。
My computer suddenly stopped working properly. 我的电脑突然无法正常工作。
The screen froze several times. 屏幕卡住了好几次。
具体描述 I could not save my files. 我无法保存文件。
The problem was difficult because I had limited time. 这个问题很困难，因为我时间不够。
I tried several methods to fix it. 我尝试了很多方法修复。
At first, I felt nervous and frustrated. 一开始我既紧张又沮丧。
Later, I became more calm and focused. 后来我变得更冷静、更专注。
描述感受 I learned some useful technical skills. 我学到了一些有用的技术技巧。
The experience improved my problem-solving ability. 这次经历提升了我的解决问题能力。
That is why I still remember this experience clearly. 这就是我至今还记得这次经历的原因。
answer: A challenging technological problem I faced happened a few months ago while I was using my laptop at home. At that time, I was preparing an important presentation, and I had already spent several hours working on it. Suddenly, my computer stopped responding properly, and the screen froze several times. The situation became very stressful because I could not save my files or continue my work. I tried restarting the laptop, but the same problem appeared again after a few minutes. Since the presentation deadline was close, I felt quite nervous and frustrated. What made the problem more difficult was that I had never experienced this kind of issue before, so I did not know the exact cause of it. After calming down, I started searching for possible solutions on my phone. I watched a few online videos and read some simple technical guides. Eventually, I realized that the laptop memory was almost full and several unnecessary programs were running in the background. I deleted some large files, closed unused applications, and restarted the system again. After that, the laptop worked much more smoothly, and I was finally able to finish my presentation on time. Although the experience was stressful, I learned some useful technical skills and became more confident when dealing with technology problems. That is why I still remember this experience very clearly.
audio_text: Describe a challenging technological problem you faced You should say: What the problem was; When and where you faced it; How challenging it was; And explain how you solved it
label: P2-11
P3-遇到的科技问题-Q1
text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of AI?
strategy: 利弊类问题。可以从“效率提升”和“依赖与失业风险”两个方面展开，体现平衡观点。
answer: AI has many advantages. It helps people work more efficiently and saves time in areas such as healthcare, education, and transportation. AI can also handle repetitive tasks and provide quick information. However, AI also has disadvantages. Some people worry that AI may replace human jobs, especially simple or repetitive work. In addition, people may become too dependent on technology and lose some practical skills. So, AI is very useful, but it should be used carefully and responsibly.
audio_text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of AI?

label: P3-遇到的科技问题-Q2
text: Do you think people today should learn about AI technology?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“社会发展”“工作需求”“正确使用”展开。
answer: Yes, I think people today should learn about AI technology because it is becoming part of daily life and work. Understanding AI helps people use technology more effectively and responsibly. AI is already used in education, healthcare, and business, so basic knowledge can improve future job opportunities. It also helps people understand the risks and limits of AI. So, learning about AI is important for adapting to modern society and future development.
audio_text: Do you think people today should learn about AI technology?

label: P3-遇到的科技问题-Q3
text: Should children learn to use AI?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以采取“应该，但需要指导”的平衡观点。
answer: Yes, I think children should learn to use AI because it will become more important in the future. AI can help children study, search for information, and improve learning efficiency. However, children also need guidance from teachers and parents. They should learn how to use AI responsibly and not depend on it too much. Critical thinking is still very important. So, learning AI is useful for children, but proper guidance is necessary.
audio_text: Should children learn to use AI?

label: P3-遇到的科技问题-Q4
text: How can AI help in our lives?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“学习”“工作”“日常生活便利”展开。
answer: AI can help people in many areas of life. In education, AI can provide quick information and personalized learning support. At work, AI improves efficiency by handling repetitive tasks and organizing data. AI is also useful in daily life. For example, smart devices help people manage schedules, find directions, or control home equipment more easily. So, AI makes life more convenient, efficient, and organized for many people.
audio_text: How can AI help in our lives?

text: Describe an important decision that you made
bullets: What the results of the decision were
And explain why it was important

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“经历类 + 决策类”话题，要求你描述一个你曾经做出的重要决定。需要说清：这个决定是什么、你是如何做出决定的、结果如何，以及为什么这个决定很重要。整体以过去时为主，最后可用现在时总结影响。重点在于思考过程和决定带来的变化。
这里可以选择学习、工作或生活中的重要决定。思路上可以先说清决定内容；然后要说清你是如何思考和做出决定的；接着可以重点说这个决定带来的结果；最后说明为什么它对你来说很重要。
第一段：介绍你做出的重要决定是什么；第二段：描述你如何做出这个决定以及结果如何；第三段：解释为什么这个决定很重要，并表达你的感受。

phrases: The decision I want to talk about was related to my studies. 我想说的决定和学习有关。
I made this decision a few years ago. 我是几年前做出这个决定的。
背景描述 At that time, I felt uncertain about the future. 当时我对未来有些迷茫。
I spent a long time thinking about it. 我花了很长时间思考。
It was not an easy decision to make. 这不是一个容易做出的决定。
I discussed the situation with my family and friends. 我和家人朋友讨论了这件事。
具体描述 I compared different choices carefully. 我认真比较了不同选择。
In the end, I followed my own interests. 最后我选择了自己的兴趣。
The decision changed my daily life a lot. 这个决定很大程度改变了我的生活。
The result was better than I expected. 结果比我想象中更好。
The experience helped me become more independent. 这次经历让我更独立。
I learned how to make careful decisions. 我学会了如何认真做决定。
描述感受 I feel proud of the choice I made. 我为自己的选择感到自豪。
The decision influenced my future plans. 这个决定影响了我的未来规划。
That is why I think it was very important. 这就是我认为它非常重要的原因。
answer: An important decision that I made was choosing my university major a few years ago. At that time, I was finishing high school and thinking seriously about my future. I felt quite uncertain because there were many different options, and I knew this decision could influence my career and daily life in the future. To make the decision, I spent a long time thinking carefully about my interests and strengths. I also talked with my family, teachers, and friends to hear different opinions. Some people suggested choosing a major that was more stable or popular, while others encouraged me to follow my personal interests. After comparing several choices, I finally decided to choose a major that matched my interests and communication skills instead of simply following other people’s expectations. The result of this decision was much better than I expected. During university, I became more motivated to study because I genuinely enjoyed the subjects I was learning. I also met many people with similar interests, which made my university life more enjoyable and meaningful. In addition, this decision helped me become more confident and independent, because it was one of the first major choices I made by myself. I think this decision was very important because it influenced both my education and my future career plans. It taught me the importance of understanding myself before making big decisions, and I still feel proud of the choice I made.
audio_text: Describe an important decision that you made You should say: What the decision was; How you made your decision; What the results of the decision were; And explain why it was important
label: P2-12
P3-重要决定-Q1
text: Do you think children sometimes have to make important decisions?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以给出“适当参与”的观点，强调年龄与指导的重要性。
answer: Yes, I think children sometimes need to make important decisions, especially about study, hobbies, or friendships. Making decisions helps children develop independence and responsibility. However, children may not have enough experience to handle very serious decisions alone. Parents and teachers should guide them and give support when necessary. So, children should gradually learn to make decisions, but adults still need to provide advice and protection
audio_text: Do you think children sometimes have to make important decisions?

label: P3-重要决定-Q2
text: What important decisions do teenagers need to make after graduation?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“继续学习”“职业方向”“生活方式”展开。
answer: After graduation, teenagers need to make several important decisions. One major decision is whether to continue studying or start working. They also need to think about future careers and choose subjects or jobs that match their interests and abilities. Some teenagers may decide where to live or whether to move to another city. So, graduation is an important stage because it affects future education, work, and lifestyle
audio_text: What important decisions do teenagers need to make after graduation?

label: P3-重要决定-Q3
text: Who can children turn to for help when making a decision?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“父母”“老师”“朋友”展开。
answer: Children can turn to different people for help depending on the situation. Parents are usually the first choice because they care about their children and have more life experience. Teachers can also give useful advice about study and future plans. In some situations, children may talk to close friends because they feel more comfortable sharing personal feelings. So, parents, teachers, and friends all play important roles in helping children make decisions.
audio_text: Who can children turn to for help when making a decision?

label: P3-重要决定-Q4
text: Do you think advertisements can influence our decisions when shopping?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“吸引注意力”“制造需求”“社交影响”展开。
answer: Yes, I think advertisements can strongly influence shopping decisions. Attractive pictures, discounts, and celebrity endorsements can make products seem more appealing. Advertisements also create awareness of new products and sometimes make people feel they need things they did not plan to buy. Social media advertising is especially powerful because people see it very often. So, advertisements affect people’s choices by attracting attention and influencing emotions.
audio_text: Do you think advertisements can influence our decisions when shopping?

text: Describe a time when a person did something to help you solve a problem
bullets: And explain how you felt about the experience

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“经历类 + 人物帮助类”话题，要求你描述一次别人帮助你解决问题的经历。需要说清：这个人是谁、你遇到了什么问题、他或她是如何帮助你的，以及你对这次经历的感受。整体以过去时为主。重点在于问题解决过程和你的情绪变化。
这里可以选择学习、工作或生活中的真实问题。思路上可以先说清问题背景；然后要说清这个人是如何帮助你的；接着可以重点说问题最后是如何解决的；最后表达你对这个人的感谢和感受。
第一段：介绍帮助你的人是谁以及你遇到了什么问题；第二段：描述他或她是如何帮助你的；第三段：解释你对这次经历的感受，并总结原因。

phrases: The person I want to talk about is my friend. 我想说的人是我的朋友。
The experience happened last year. 这件事发生在去年。
背景描述 At that time, I was under a lot of pressure. 当时我压力很大。
I faced a difficult problem at work. 我在工作中遇到了困难。
I did not know how to solve it by myself. 我当时不知道该怎么自己解决。
He listened to my problem patiently. 他耐心听我说问题。
He gave me some practical advice. 他给了我一些实际建议。
具体描述 He helped me organize my work step by step. 他帮我一步一步整理工作。
Together, we found a solution. 我们一起找到了办法。
The problem became much easier after his help. 在他的帮助下问题容易多了。
I felt very grateful to him. 我非常感谢他。
His support made me feel less stressed. 他的帮助让我没那么焦虑。
描述感受 I learned the importance of asking for help. 我学会了寻求帮助的重要性。
The experience improved our friendship. 这次经历也让我们的友谊更深。
That is why I still remember this experience clearly. 这就是我至今还记得这次经历的原因。
answer: A time when a person helped me solve a problem was last year when I was preparing an important presentation for work. At that time, I had a lot of tasks to finish, and I felt extremely stressed because the deadline was very close. The person who helped me was one of my close friends, who is also very organized and good at solving practical problems. The main problem was that my presentation materials were incomplete, and I could not organize my ideas clearly. I spent hours trying to improve the slides, but everything still looked messy. When my friend noticed that I was worried, he offered to help me. First, he listened carefully while I explained the situation. Then he suggested dividing the presentation into smaller sections and focusing on the most important points instead of trying to include too much information. He also helped me improve the structure of the slides and gave me advice on how to speak more confidently. After following his suggestions, the presentation became much clearer and easier to understand. In the end, everything went smoothly, and I received positive feedback from my manager. I felt very grateful because his help reduced a lot of my stress and gave me more confidence. This experience taught me that asking for help is sometimes very important. It also made me appreciate my friend even more because he stayed patient and supportive throughout the whole process.
audio_text: Describe a time when a person did something to help you solve a problem You should say: Who the person is; What the problem was; How he/she helped you; And explain how you felt about the experience
label: P2-13
P3-别人帮助解决问题-Q1
text: How important is it for schools to help children become smarter?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“知识能力”“思维培养”“未来发展”展开。
answer: It is very important for schools to help children become smarter. Schools do not only teach knowledge, but also help children improve thinking and problem-solving skills. Good education encourages curiosity, creativity, and independent learning. These abilities are useful for both future work and daily life. Schools also help children understand how to communicate and cooperate with others. So, helping children develop intelligence and thinking skills is one of the main responsibilities of schools.
audio_text: How important is it for schools to help children become smarter?

text: Describe a time when you received a message or email and it took you a long time to reply
bullets: Why you spent a lot of time replying
And explain how you felt about the experience

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“经历类 + 沟通类”话题，要求你描述一次你收到消息或邮件后花了很长时间回复的经历。需要说清：发消息的人是谁、消息内容是什么、为什么你花了很久回复，以及你对这次经历的感受。整体以过去时为主。重点在于思考过程和情绪变化。
这里可以选择老师、朋友或工作相关的人发来的消息。思路上可以先说清发消息的人和消息内容；然后要说清为什么回复困难，比如内容重要、需要认真考虑；接着可以重点说你是如何准备回复的；最后表达你的感受。
第一段：介绍是谁给你发了消息以及内容是什么；第二段：描述为什么你花了很长时间回复；第三段：解释你的感受，并总结这次经历。

phrases: The message was sent by my manager. 这条消息是我经理发来的。
I received it a few months ago. 我是几个月前收到的。
背景描述 The message was quite important. 这条消息非常重要。
I noticed it late in the evening. 我是在晚上看到它的。
At first, I did not know how to reply. 一开始我不知道怎么回复。
The message was related to work plans. 这条消息和工作安排有关。
I needed time to organize my thoughts. 我需要时间整理思路。
具体描述 I rewrote my reply several times. 我改了好几次回复。
I wanted my answer to sound professional. 我希望回复听起来专业一些。
In the end, I finally sent the message. 最后我终于把消息发出去了。
I felt nervous at the beginning. 一开始我很紧张。
Later, I became more confident. 后来我变得更有信心。
描述感受 The experience taught me to communicate carefully. 这次经历让我学会认真沟通。
I felt relieved after sending the reply. 发出回复后我松了一口气。
That is why I still remember this experience clearly. 这就是我至今还记得这次经历的原因。
answer: A time when I received a message and spent a long time replying was a few months ago when my manager sent me an important work-related message. I saw it late in the evening after finishing my daily tasks, and at first I felt quite nervous because the message was about a new project arrangement. In the message, my manager asked whether I would be willing to take on more responsibilities in an upcoming project. It sounded like a good opportunity, but at the same time, I was worried because I already had a busy schedule. I did not want to reply too quickly without thinking carefully. Because of that, I spent a long time considering my answer and organizing my thoughts. I even rewrote the message several times because I wanted my reply to sound professional, polite, and clear. In the end, I replied the next morning after thinking about the advantages and disadvantages carefully. I accepted the opportunity but also honestly explained my concerns about workload and time management. Fortunately, my manager understood my situation and appreciated my careful response. At first, the whole experience made me feel stressed and uncertain, but later I felt more confident and relieved after sending the reply. This experience taught me that important messages sometimes require time and careful communication instead of quick reactions. That is why I still remember this experience very clearly.
audio_text: Describe a time when you received a message or email and it took you a long time to reply You should say: Who this person was; What the message/email was about; Why you spent a lot of time replying; And explain how you felt about the experience
label: P2-14
P3-花很久时间回复信息-Q1
text: When do people spend a long time responding to others’ messages?
strategy: 情境类问题。可以从“内容重要”“情绪考虑”“工作正式场合”展开。
answer: People usually spend a long time replying to messages when the topic is important or sensitive. For example, work emails or serious discussions often require careful thinking before answering. Some people also take longer when they want to avoid misunderstanding or express feelings clearly. In personal relationships, people may think carefully before replying to emotional messages. So, people often spend more time replying when the message is important or requires careful communication.
audio_text: When do people spend a long time responding to others’ messages?

label: P3-花很久时间回复信息-Q2
text: In what situations do people not respond to messages right away?
strategy: 情境类问题。可以从“工作学习忙”“情绪考虑”“正式回复需要时间”展开。
answer: People may not reply to messages immediately when they are busy with work, study, or meetings. In these situations, they may not have time to answer carefully. Some people also delay replies when messages are emotional or important because they want to think before responding. In addition, people sometimes ignore messages when they want personal space or rest. So, delays in replying are often related to time, emotions, or the need for careful communication.
audio_text: In what situations do people not respond to messages right away?

label: P3-花很久时间回复信息-Q3
text: What would you do if you haven’t received a reply after sending out a message?
strategy: 情境类问题。可以从“耐心等待”“再次确认”“理解对方忙碌”展开。
answer: If I do not receive a reply after sending a message, I usually wait for some time first because the other person may be busy. If the message is important, I may send a polite reminder later or try another way to contact them. However, I try not to become impatient because people sometimes need time to respond. So, I prefer to stay polite and understanding when waiting for replies.
audio_text: What would you do if you haven’t received a reply after sending out a message?

text: Describe a special day out that cost you little money/didn’t cost you much
bullets: And explain how you feel about the day

analysis_zh.text: 这里可以选择公园、海边、城市散步或短途出行。思路上可以先说清时间和地点；然后要说清当天做了什么以及实际花费；接着可以重点说为什么虽然便宜但依然特别；最后表达你的感受。
第一段：介绍这一天是什么时候以及你去了哪里；第二段：描述当天的活动和花费；第三段：解释为什么这一天特别，并表达你的感受。

phrases: The special day happened last spring. 这个特别的日子发生在去年春天。
I went out with one of my close friends. 我和一个好朋友一起出去。
背景描述 We decided to have a simple day trip. 我们决定来一次简单的一日游。
The weather was warm and comfortable. 天气温暖又舒服。
We did not plan to spend much money. 我们原本就没打算花很多钱。
We visited a public park near the city center. 我们去了市中心附近的一个公园。
Most activities there were free. 那里的大部分活动都是免费的。
具体描述 We bought some snacks and drinks. 我们买了一些零食和饮料。
In total, I spent very little money. 总共我花的钱很少。
We spent hours walking and talking. 我们花了很长时间散步聊天。
The day felt relaxing and meaningful. 那一天既放松又有意义。
I enjoyed the simple atmosphere. 我喜欢那种简单轻松的氛围。
It reminded me that happiness does not always require money. 它让我意识到快乐不一定需要花很多
描述感受
钱。
I made some wonderful memories that day. 那天我留下了很美好的回忆。
That is why I still remember the day clearly. 这就是我至今还记得那一天的原因。
answer: A special day out that did not cost me much happened last spring when I went to a public park with one of my close friends. At that time, both of us were quite busy with work and study, so we wanted to relax for a day without spending too much money. The weather was warm and sunny, which made the whole trip even more enjoyable. We visited a large park near the city center. Most activities there were completely free, so we mainly spent time walking around, talking, and enjoying the natural scenery. We also sat near a lake for a while and watched people riding bicycles and flying kites. The only things we bought were a few snacks and drinks from a small store nearby. In total, I probably spent less than fifty yuan that day, which was much cheaper than going shopping or eating in expensive restaurants. Even though the trip was simple and inexpensive, I still think it was a very special day. I felt relaxed because there was no pressure, no busy schedule, and no need to spend a lot of money. Sometimes expensive activities can actually feel tiring, but that day felt natural and comfortable. Spending time with a good friend and enjoying a peaceful environment made me very happy. This experience reminded me that meaningful moments do not always need to cost a lot of money. That is why I still remember this special day very clearly.
audio_text: Describe a special day out that cost you little money/didn’t cost you much You should say: When the day was; Where you went; How much you spent; And explain how you feel about the day
label: P2-15
P3-花费甚少的外出日-Q1
text: Do people like to spend their leisure time out in your country?
strategy: 现象类问题。可以从“放松需求”“社交活动”“年轻人与家庭差异”展开。
answer: Yes, many people in my country like spending their leisure time outside. They often go shopping, eat at restaurants, or visit parks with friends and family. Young people may enjoy cafés, cinemas, or sports activities, while families often choose parks or tourist places during weekends. However, some people still prefer staying at home to rest or watch videos. So, outdoor leisure activities are popular because they help people relax and socialize.
audio_text: Do people like to spend their leisure time out in your country?

label: P3-花费甚少的外出日-Q2
text: How do people spend their leisure time in your country?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“线上娱乐”“社交活动”“户外休闲”展开。
answer: People in my country spend their leisure time in many ways. Some enjoy watching videos, playing games, or using social media at home. Others prefer going out with friends or family. They may go shopping, eat at restaurants, or visit parks and tourist places. Exercise and sports are also becoming more popular. So, people choose different leisure activities depending on their interests and lifestyle.
audio_text: How do people spend their leisure time in your country?

label: P3-花费甚少的外出日-Q3
text: How does technology affect the way people spend their leisure time?
strategy: 影响类问题。可以从“线上娱乐增加”和“户外活动减少”两个方面展开。
answer: Technology has greatly changed the way people spend their leisure time. Many people now relax by watching videos, playing games, or using social media on their phones. Technology also makes entertainment more convenient because people can access music, movies, and online activities anytime. However, some people spend less time doing outdoor activities or meeting friends face to face. So, technology makes leisure activities more convenient, but it may also reduce real-world interaction.
audio_text: How does technology affect the way people spend their leisure time?

label: P3-花费甚少的外出日-Q4
text: Do you think only old people have time for leisure?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以反驳绝对化观点，说明不同年龄都有休闲需求。英文回答：
answer: No, I don’t think only old people have time for leisure. Young people and adults also need free time to relax after work or study. Many people spend weekends or holidays doing hobbies, sports, or social activities. Older people may have more free time after retirement, so they can enjoy leisure activities more regularly. However, leisure is important for people of all ages because it helps reduce stress and improve mental health. So, everyone needs leisure time, although different age groups use it differently.
audio_text: Do you think only old people have time for leisure?

text: Describe a thing you did to learn another language
bullets: How it helped you learn the language
And how you felt about it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“学习类 + 语言类”话题，要求你描述一件你为了学习另一门语言而做的事情。需要说清：你学的是哪种语言、你做了什么、这件事如何帮助你学习语言，以及你的感受。整体以过去时和现在时结合为主。重点在于学习方法和实际效果。
这里可以选择看视频、练口语、背单词或和外国人交流。思路上可以先说清你学的语言；然后要说清你具体做了什么；接着可以重点说这个方法是如何帮助你的；最后表达你的感受和收获。
第一段：介绍你学习的语言以及你做了什么；第二段：描述这个方法如何帮助你提高语言能力；第三段：解释你的感受，并总结这次学习经历。

phrases: The language I learned was English. 我学习的语言是英语。
I started learning it several years ago. 我几年前开始学习它。
背景描述 At first, learning the language was difficult. 一开始学这门语言很困难。
I wanted to improve my speaking skills. 我想提高口语能力。
I tried different learning methods. 我尝试了不同学习方法。
I watched English videos every day. 我每天看英语视频。
I repeated sentences aloud. 我会大声重复句子。
具体描述 I also wrote down useful expressions. 我还会记下有用表达。
This method improved my listening and speaking. 这个方法提升了我的听力和口语。
Gradually, I became more confident. 渐渐地，我变得更自信了。
The learning process was sometimes challenging. 学习过程有时很有挑战。
However, it was also very rewarding. 不过它也很有成就感。
描述感受 I enjoyed seeing my own progress. 我很享受看到自己的进步。
The experience made language learning more interesting. 这次经历让语言学习更有趣。
That is why I still continue using this method today. 这就是我现在还在继续用这个方法的原因。
answer: A thing I did to learn another language was watching English videos every day. The language I learned was English, and I started doing this seriously a few years ago when I wanted to improve my listening and speaking skills. At first, I found it difficult to understand native speakers because they spoke too quickly for me. To improve, I began watching short English videos online every evening. I usually chose topics that interested me, such as travel, daily life, or interviews. While watching, I often repeated sentences aloud and wrote down useful expressions or new vocabulary. Sometimes I watched the same video several times so I could better understand the pronunciation and sentence structure. Gradually, this habit helped me become more familiar with natural English speaking. I think this method helped me a lot because it improved both my listening and speaking at the same time. Instead of only memorizing grammar rules from textbooks, I could hear how people actually use English in real conversations. After several months, I noticed that I became more confident when speaking and could understand videos more easily than before. Although the learning process was sometimes tiring, I still found it very rewarding. Watching videos made language learning feel more interesting and practical. It also gave me motivation to continue improving my English. That is why I still use this method regularly today.
audio_text: Describe a thing you did to learn another language You should say: What language you learned; What you did; How it helped you learn the language; And how you felt about it
label: P2-16
P3-语言学习-Q1
text: What difficulties do people face when learning a language?
strategy: 问题类。可以从“词汇语法”“发音”“缺少练习环境”展开。
answer: People face many difficulties when learning a language. Vocabulary and grammar can be hard to remember, especially when the language structure is very different from their own language.
