Pronunciation is another challenge because some sounds may not exist in the learner’s native language. In addition, many people lack chances to practice speaking in real situations. So, memory, pronunciation, and limited practice are common problems in language learning.
audio_text: What difficulties do people face when learning a language?

label: P3-语言学习-Q2
text: Do you think language learning is important? Why?
strategy: 观点 + 原因类问题。可以从“沟通”“工作机会”“文化理解”展开。
answer: Yes, I think language learning is very important. Learning another language helps people communicate with others from different countries and cultures. It can also improve job opportunities, especially in international companies or travel-related work. In addition, learning a language helps people understand different cultures and ways of thinking. So, language learning is useful for communication, career development, and personal growth.
audio_text: Do you think language learning is important? Why?

label: P3-语言学习-Q3
text: Which is better, to study a language alone or to study it in a group? Why?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以采取“各有优点，但小组更好”的观点。
answer: I think studying a language in a group is usually better because people can practice speaking and communication together. Group learning also makes lessons more interactive and interesting. Students can help each other and feel more motivated when learning with classmates. However, studying alone is also useful for reviewing vocabulary or grammar quietly. So, both methods are helpful, but group study is often better for improving communication skills.
audio_text: Which is better, to study a language alone or to study it in a group? Why?

label: P3-语言学习-Q4
text: What's the best way to learn a language?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“长期练习”“真实交流”“兴趣结合”展开。
answer: I think the best way to learn a language is through regular practice and real communication. Speaking with other people helps learners improve fluency and confidence more quickly. Watching videos, reading books, and listening to music in the target language are also helpful because they make learning more natural and interesting. In addition, learning a little every day is better than studying only occasionally. So, consistent practice and real-life use are the most effective ways to learn a language
audio_text: What's the best way to learn a language?

topic: 想有空时去旅游的地方
text: Describe a place you would like to visit in your free time
bullets: How long you will stay there
And explain why you would like to visit it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“地点类 + 休闲活动类”话题，要求你描述一个你空闲时间想去的地方。需要说清：这个地方在哪里、你会在那里做什么、你会待多久，以及你为什么想去那里。整体以将来时为主。重点在于放松感和个人兴趣。
这里可以选择自然景点、小城市、海边或安静的地方。思路上可以先说清地点；然后要说清你到了之后会做什么；接着可以重点说停留时间和生活节奏；最后说明为什么这个地方对你有吸引力。
第一段：介绍这个地方在哪里；第二段：描述你会在那里做什么以及会待多久；第三段：解释你为什么想去那里，并总结感受。

phrases: The place I would like to visit is a seaside town. 我想去的地方是一个海边小镇。
It is located in the south of China. 它位于中国南方。
背景描述 I have wanted to visit it for a long time. 我想去那里已经很久了。
It looks quiet and relaxing. 它看起来很安静、很放松。
I learned about it from travel videos. 我是通过旅行视频了解到它的。
I would like to walk along the beach. 我想沿着海边散步。
I also want to try local food. 我还想尝试当地食物。
具体描述 I would spend most of my time relaxing. 我大部分时间都会用来放松。
I plan to stay there for several days. 我计划在那里待几天。
I want to enjoy the slow pace of life. 我想感受慢节奏生活。
he place would help me reduce stress. 那个地方能帮我减轻压力。
I enjoy peaceful environments. 我喜欢安静的环境。
描述感受 It feels very different from city life. 它和城市生活很不一样。
I think the trip would refresh my mind. 我觉得这趟旅行会让我放松很多。
That is why I want to visit it in my free time. 这就是我想在空闲时间去那里的原因。
answer: A place I would like to visit in my free time is Sanya, which is a famous seaside city in the south of China. I have wanted to visit this place for a long time because many people say it has beautiful beaches and a very relaxing atmosphere. I first learned about it from travel videos and photos online. If I go there, I would spend most of my time near the sea. I would like to walk along the beach, enjoy the fresh air, and watch the sunset in the evening. I also want to try local seafood and tropical fruit because they look very fresh and delicious. Besides that, I think I would simply relax in a quiet café or hotel and enjoy the slow pace of life there. I would probably stay in Sanya for about four or five days, which I think is enough time to rest properly without feeling rushed. I want to visit this place because it feels very different from my daily life. Normally, my schedule is quite busy, so I rarely have time to completely relax. A peaceful place like Sanya would help me reduce stress and refresh my mind. I think spending time near the sea would make me feel calmer and happier. That is why Sanya is a place I would really like to visit during my free time.
audio_text: Describe a place you would like to visit in your free time You should say: Where it is; What you will do there; How long you will stay there; And explain why you would like to visit it
label: P2-17

topic: 想有空时去旅游的地方
label: P3-想有空时去旅游的地方-Q1
text: Why do you think some people choose not to travel abroad?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“费用”“语言与文化差异”“国内旅游替代”三个角度展开，说明不出国旅行并不一定是不喜欢旅行。
answer: Some people choose not to travel abroad because international travel can be expensive. Flights, hotels, and visas may cost a lot of money, so domestic travel feels more practical. Language barriers are another reason. Some people feel uncomfortable in places where they cannot communicate easily. Cultural differences may also make them nervous. In addition, some countries have many beautiful places to visit, so people feel there is no need to go abroad. So, cost, convenience, and personal comfort are the main reasons why some people avoid international travel.
audio_text: Why do you think some people choose not to travel abroad?

topic: 想有空时去旅游的地方
label: P3-想有空时去旅游的地方-Q2
text: Do you think a gap period in life is important?
strategy: 观点类问题。这里的 gap period 可以理解为 gap year 或人生中的短暂停顿。可以从“放松调整”“思考未来”“获得经验”三个角度展开，同时补充“需要合理安排”。
answer: Yes, I think a gap period can be important. After long periods of study or work, people may feel tired or unsure about their future. Taking some time off helps them relax and think more clearly. During a gap period, people can travel, learn new skills, or gain work experience. These experiences may help them understand themselves better and make wiser decisions later. However, the time should be used meaningfully. Without a clear plan, people may waste time. So, a well- planned gap period can be very valuable for personal growth.
audio_text: Do you think a gap period in life is important?

text: Describe your favorite city that you have visited
bullets: And explain why it is your favourite city

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“地点类 + 旅行经历类”话题，要求你描述一座你去过并且最喜欢的城市。需要说清：这座城市在哪里、你是怎么知道它的、你什么时候去的，以及为什么它是你最喜欢的城市。整体以过去时描述旅行经历，用现在时表达现在的感受。重点在于旅行体验和个人感受。
这里可以选择国内或国外真实去过的城市。思路上可以先说清城市的位置以及你最初是怎么知道它的；然后要说清你什么时候去的；接着可以重点说旅行中的体验，比如景点、美食或生活氛围；最后总结为什么它成为你最喜欢的城市。
第一段：介绍这座城市在哪里，以及你是如何知道它的；第二段：描述你什么时候去的以及在那里做了什么；第三段：解释为什么这是你最喜欢的城市，并总结感受。

phrases: My favorite city is Kyoto. 我最喜欢的城市是京都。
It is located in Japan. 它位于日本。
背景描述 I first learned about it from travel programs. 我最早是通过旅游节目了解它的。
The city has a long history. 这座城市历史悠久。
Many tourists visit it every year. 每年都有很多游客去那里。
I visited the city last year. 我去年去了这座城市。
I stayed there for several days. 我在那里待了几天。
具体描述 I visited temples and traditional streets. 我参观了寺庙和传统街道。
I also tried local food. 我还尝试了当地食物。
The environment felt peaceful and clean. 那里的环境安静又干净。
he city made me feel relaxed. 这座城市让我很放松。
I enjoyed the slow pace of life there. 我很喜欢那里的慢节奏生活。
描述感受 It was different from my daily routine. 它和我的日常生活很不一样。
I would love to visit it again. 我很想再去一次。
That is why it became my favorite city. 这就是它成为我最喜欢城市的原因。
answer: My favorite city that I have visited is Kyoto. It is located in Japan and is famous for its traditional culture and beautiful temples. I first learned about this city from travel programs and online videos several years ago. Many people described it as a peaceful and historic place, which made me very interested in visiting it one day. I finally visited Kyoto last year during a short holiday. I stayed there for about five days with one of my friends. During the trip, we visited many famous temples, walked through traditional streets, and tried different kinds of local food. I especially enjoyed walking around quiet neighborhoods and seeing old wooden houses that looked very different from buildings in my own city. We also spent some time in small cafés and parks, which made the whole trip feel slow and relaxing. Kyoto became my favorite city mainly because of its atmosphere. The city felt peaceful, clean, and well organized. Compared with my busy daily life, spending time there helped me relax both physically and mentally. I also liked the way traditional culture and modern life existed together in the city. Everything seemed calm and meaningful. Even now, I still remember many small details from that trip. That is why Kyoto is my favorite city that I have ever visited, and I hope I can go there again in the future.
audio_text: Describe your favorite city that you have visited You should say: Where it is; How you knew it; When you visited it; And explain why it is your favourite city
label: P2-18
P3-去过的最喜欢的城市-Q1
text: Which is more suitable for young people, urban life or rural life, and which is more suitable for old people?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以从“机会”“生活节奏”“环境”展开。
answer: I think urban life is more suitable for young people because cities offer more job opportunities, education, and entertainment. Young people usually enjoy fast-paced and active lifestyles. For older people, rural life may be more suitable. The countryside is quieter, less crowded, and closer to nature, which helps people relax. However, some elderly people still prefer cities because of better healthcare and public services. So, the best place depends on personal needs and lifestyle.
audio_text: Which is more suitable for young people, urban life or rural life, and which is more suitable for old people?

label: P3-去过的最喜欢的城市-Q2
text: How do people choose a city to travel to?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“兴趣”“预算”“交通便利”展开。
answer: People usually choose a city to travel to based on their interests and budget. Some prefer historical cities, while others enjoy modern cities with shopping and entertainment. Transportation and accommodation are also important. People often choose places that are easy to reach and not too expensive. Weather and safety can also influence decisions. So, travel choices depend on personal interests, convenience, and cost.
audio_text: How do people choose a city to travel to?

label: P3-去过的最喜欢的城市-Q3
text: Do you think a tourist city is also a good place to live? Why?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“便利设施”和“生活压力”两个方面展开。
answer: A tourist city can be a good place to live because it usually has good transportation, restaurants, and entertainment facilities. The environment is often clean and attractive as well. However, tourist cities can also be crowded and expensive. During holidays, traffic and noise may affect local residents’ daily life. So, tourist cities offer convenience and opportunities, but they may also bring stress and higher living costs.
audio_text: Do you think a tourist city is also a good place to live? Why?

label: P3-去过的最喜欢的城市-Q4
text: Do most people prefer traveling to a modern city or a historical city?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以采取“因人而异”的平衡观点。
answer: I think different people prefer different types of cities. Some people enjoy modern cities because they offer shopping, entertainment, and convenient transportation. Modern cities also feel exciting and active. Others prefer historical cities because they want to learn about culture and history. Old buildings and traditional streets create a special atmosphere. So, travel preference depends on personal interests, such as entertainment or cultural experience.
audio_text: Do most people prefer traveling to a modern city or a historical city?

text: Describe a boring place
bullets: And explain why you think it is a boring place

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“地点类 + 个人体验类”话题，要求你描述一个你觉得无聊的地方。需要说清：这个地方在哪里、你和谁一起去的、你在那里做了什么，以及为什么你觉得它无聊。整体以过去时为主。重点在于个人感受和具体原因。
这里可以选择展览馆、等待区、小城市或无聊的景点。思路上可以先说清地点和同行的人；然后要说清你在那里做了什么；接着可以重点说让你觉得无聊的原因，比如活动少、环境单调或等待时间太长；最后总结你的感受。
第一段：介绍这个地方在哪里，以及你和谁一起去；第二段：描述你在那里做了什么；第三段：解释为什么你觉得它无聊，并表达你的感受。

phrases: The place I want to talk about is a small museum. 我想说的地方是一个小博物馆。
It is located in my hometown. 它位于我的家乡。
背景描述 I went there with my classmates. 我是和同学一起去的。
The visit happened during a school activity. 这次参观发生在学校活动期间。
At first, I thought it would be interesting. 一开始我以为那里会很有趣。
We walked around the museum slowly. 我们慢慢地参观了博物馆。
Most of the exhibits looked similar. 大多数展品看起来都差不多。
具体描述 There were not many interactive activities. 那里没有太多互动活动。
I spent a lot of time just reading information. 我花了很多时间只是看介绍。
The environment felt very quiet and dull. 那里的环境很安静但有些沉闷。
I lost interest after a short time. 过了一会儿我就失去兴趣了。
The visit felt much longer than expected. 这次参观看起来比想象中漫长。
描述感受 I could not stay focused. 我无法保持专注。
The place did not leave a strong impression on me. 这个地方没有给我留下深刻印象。
That is why I think it was a boring place. 这就是我觉得它无聊的原因。
answer: A boring place I once visited was a small museum in my hometown. I went there with several classmates during a school activity a few years ago. At first, I thought the trip would be interesting because I usually enjoy visiting new places and learning something different. However, the experience turned out to be much less enjoyable than I expected. When we arrived, we walked around the museum slowly and looked at different exhibits. Most of the displays were old photos, documents, and simple objects placed inside glass cases. Although the information was probably meaningful, many exhibits looked very similar to each other. There were also very few interactive activities, so most of the time we were just reading long introductions on the walls. The museum was extremely quiet, and after some time, I started to feel tired and bored. I think this place felt boring mainly because the experience was not engaging enough. Everything seemed too repetitive, and there was nothing that really caught my attention. In addition, we stayed there for quite a long time, which made the visit feel even longer. Compared with museums that use technology or interactive displays, this place felt old-fashioned and dull. Although I understand that museums are important for education and history, this particular one did not leave a strong impression on me. That is why I still remember it as one of the most boring places I have ever visited.
audio_text: Describe a boring place You should say: Where it is; Who you went there with; What you did there; And explain why you think it is a boring place
label: P2-19
P3-去过的无聊地方-Q1
text: Why do most children think education is boring?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“学习方式单一”“压力大”“缺少兴趣关联”展开。
answer: Many children think education is boring because lessons are sometimes too focused on memorization and exams. Repeating information without interaction can make learning feel dull. Children also have different interests, so they may not enjoy every subject. Too much homework and pressure can reduce motivation as well. If classes include games, discussions, or practical activities, children may become more interested. So, teaching style and pressure strongly affect how children feel about education.
audio_text: Why do most children think education is boring?

label: P3-去过的无聊地方-Q2
text: Why aren’t young people willing to listen to the experiences of older people?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“代际差异”“独立意识”“社会变化快”展开。
answer: Some young people are not willing to listen to older people because they think times have changed. Advice from older generations may seem old-fashioned or less useful in modern life. Young people also want independence and prefer making their own decisions. In addition, technology and society change quickly, so younger people may believe their experiences are different. However, older people still have valuable life experience. So, the problem often comes from communication gaps between generations.
audio_text: Why aren’t young people willing to listen to the experiences of older people?

label: P3-去过的无聊地方-Q3
text: What can people do when they feel bored?
strategy: 解决方式类问题。可以从“娱乐”“社交”“学习新事物”三个方面展开。
answer: When people feel bored, they can do many different things. Some people relax by watching movies, listening to music, or playing games. These activities help reduce stress and pass time. Others prefer meeting friends or doing exercise because social activities improve mood and energy. Some people also learn new skills or hobbies, such as cooking or drawing. So, people usually deal with boredom through entertainment, social interaction, or trying something new.
audio_text: What can people do when they feel bored?

label: P3-去过的无聊地方-Q4
text: Why are some teachers’ classes boring? Are there any solutions?
strategy: 问题 + 解决类问题。可以从“教学方式单一”“互动不足”“内容脱离兴趣”展开，再给出解决方案。
answer: Some teachers’ classes are boring because they focus too much on memorization and long explanations. Students may lose attention if there is little interaction or discussion. Another reason is that lessons may not connect with students’ interests or daily life. To improve this, teachers can use games, videos, or group activities to make lessons more interesting. Asking questions and encouraging participation also help students stay active. So, more interactive and practical teaching methods can make classes more enjoyable and effective.
audio_text: Why are some teachers’ classes boring? Are there any solutions?

text: Describe a place you have travelled to that you would like to recommend to others
bullets: What you saw and did there
And explain why you would like to recommend it to others

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“地点类 + 旅行推荐类”话题，要求你描述一个你去过并且想推荐给别人的地方。需要说清：这个地方是什么、它在哪里、你在那里看到了什么和做了什么，以及你为什么想推荐它。整体以过去时描述旅行经历，用现在时表达推荐理由。重点在于旅行体验和推荐原因。
这里可以选择国内旅游城市、自然景点或海边城市。思路上可以先说清地点和位置；然后要说清你在那里做了什么、看到了什么；接着可以重点说这个地方的环境、食物或生活节奏；最后总结你为什么推荐它。
第一段：介绍这个地方是什么以及它在哪里；第二段：描述你在那里看到和做了什么；第三段：解释你为什么想推荐这个地方，并表达你的感受。

phrases: The place I want to recommend is a coastal city. 我想推荐的地方是一座海滨城市。
It is located in the south of China. 它位于中国南方。
I visited it during a holiday. 我是在假期去那里的。
背景描述
The city is famous for its beaches and seafood. 这座城市以海滩和海鲜闻名。
Many tourists travel there every year. 每年都有很多游客去那里。
具体描述
I spent a lot of time near the sea. 我花了很多时间待在海边。
I walked along the beach every evening. 我每天晚上都会沿着海边散步。
具体描述 I also tried different kinds of seafood. 我还尝试了很多不同的海鲜。
The weather was warm and comfortable. 天气温暖又舒服。
I enjoyed the slow pace of life there. 我很喜欢那里的慢节奏生活。
The trip helped me relax completely. 这次旅行让我彻底放松。
The environment felt peaceful and fresh. 那里的环境安静又清新。
描述感受 I think the city is suitable for holidays. 我觉得这座城市很适合度假。
It gave me many happy memories. 它给了我很多快乐回忆。
That is why I would recommend it to others. 这就是我会推荐它给别人的原因。
answer: A place I have travelled to that I would like to recommend to others is Sanya. It is a famous coastal city in the south of China, and many people visit it during holidays because of its beautiful beaches and warm weather. I travelled there with my family about two years ago during the summer vacation. During the trip, I spent a lot of time near the sea. Every evening, we walked slowly along the beach and enjoyed the fresh air and beautiful sunset. I also tried many kinds of local seafood, which tasted very fresh and delicious. Besides relaxing on the beach, we visited some parks and local markets, where I could see many tourists and experience the local atmosphere. The city felt lively but not stressful, which made the trip very enjoyable. I would recommend this place to others mainly because it is perfect for relaxing. Compared with busy city life, Sanya has a much slower pace, and the natural scenery makes people feel calm and comfortable. The weather is warm, the environment is clean, and there are many things to do without feeling rushed. I think it is a good destination for families, friends, or even people travelling alone. The trip gave me many happy memories, and that is why I would strongly recommend Sanya to other people.
audio_text: Describe a place you have travelled to that you would like to recommend to others You should say: What it is; Where it is; What you saw and did there; And explain why you would like to recommend it to others
label: P2-20
P3-推荐旅行过的地方-Q1
text: Where do people in your country often go for holidays?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“自然景点”“大城市”“海外旅行”几个方向展开。
answer: People in my country often travel to natural places during holidays, such as beaches, mountains, or lakes. These places help people relax and escape busy city life. Some people prefer visiting famous cities because they enjoy shopping, food, and entertainment. Historical cities are also popular among tourists who want to learn about culture and history. In recent years, more people have started traveling abroad as well. So, travel choices depend on people’s interests and budgets.
audio_text: Where do people in your country often go for holidays?

label: P3-推荐旅行过的地方-Q2
text: What is the ideal length for a holiday?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以给出一个合理时间，并解释原因。
answer: I think one or two weeks is an ideal length for a holiday. This gives people enough time to relax, travel, and recover from stress without feeling rushed. A very short holiday may not help people rest properly, while a very long holiday can make people lose their daily routine or feel bored. So, a balanced holiday length is best because it allows relaxation while still keeping life organized.
audio_text: What is the ideal length for a holiday?

label: P3-推荐旅行过的地方-Q3
text: How do people usually plan holidays?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“预算”“地点”“网络工具”展开。
answer: People usually begin planning holidays by deciding their budget and travel dates. After that, they choose destinations based on interests such as beaches, history, or shopping. Many people use the internet to compare hotels, flights, and tourist information. Some also make schedules for activities and transportation before traveling. So, holiday planning often includes budgeting, destination choice, and online research.
audio_text: How do people usually plan holidays?

label: P3-推荐旅行过的地方-Q4
text: Is it important to plan a holiday?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“节省时间”“控制预算”“减少问题”展开。
answer: Yes, I think planning a holiday is important. Good planning helps people manage their budget, transportation, and accommodation more easily. Planning also reduces stress because people know what to do and where to go in advance. During busy travel seasons, booking early can save money and avoid problems. However, some flexibility is also useful during travel. So, holiday planning helps people travel more smoothly and comfortably.
audio_text: Is it important to plan a holiday?

topic: 喜欢拜访但不想住的家
text: Describe a home that you like to visit but do not want to live in
bullets: Why you like to visit it
And explain why you would not like to live there

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“地点类 + 个人偏好类”话题，要求你描述一个你喜欢去但不想长期居住的家。需要说清：它在哪里、是什么样子、你为什么喜欢去，以及为什么不想住在那里。整体以现在时为主。重点在于喜欢与不适合长期居住之间的对比。
这里可以选择亲戚、朋友或乡下的房子。思路上可以先说清这个家的位置和外观；然后要说清你为什么喜欢去，比如环境好、氛围轻松；接着可以重点说为什么不适合长期住，比如交通不方便、空间太小或生活节奏不同；最后总结感受。
第一段：介绍这个家在哪里以及它是什么样子；第二段：描述你为什么喜欢去那里；第三段：解释为什么你不想长期住在那里，并总结感受

phrases: The home I want to talk about belongs to my grandparents. 我想说的房子属于我爷爷奶奶。
It is located in the countryside. 它位于乡下。
背景描述 The house has a very traditional style. 这栋房子是很传统的风格。
It is surrounded by nature. 它被自然环境包围。
I usually visit it during holidays. 我通常假期会去那里。
The environment there is peaceful and quiet. 那里的环境安静平和。
I enjoy spending time in the yard. 我喜欢待在院子里。
具体描述 The air feels very fresh. 那里的空气很新鲜。
The house gives me a relaxing feeling. 这栋房子让我感到放松。
I always feel comfortable when visiting. 我每次去都觉得很舒服。
However, life there is not very convenient. 不过那里的生活不是很方便。
There are fewer shops and services nearby. 附近商店和服务比较少。
Transportation is also limited. 交通也有限。
描述感受
I prefer the convenience of city life. 我更喜欢城市生活的便利。
That is why I enjoy visiting but would not want to live there permanently. 这就是我喜欢去但不想长期
住那里的原因。
answer: A home that I like to visit but do not want to live in is my grandparents’ house in the countryside. It is located in a small village outside the city, and I usually go there during holidays or family gatherings. The house is quite traditional and surrounded by trees, plants, and open fields, which makes the environment feel very peaceful. I enjoy visiting this home because it is very different from my daily life in the city. The air is fresh, the streets are quiet, and everything feels much slower and more relaxing. Whenever I go there, I like sitting in the yard, talking with my grandparents, and enjoying home-cooked food. Sometimes I also take short walks around the village because the natural scenery is beautiful and calming. Compared with the noisy city, the atmosphere there helps me relax a lot. However, although I enjoy visiting this place, I would not want to live there permanently. The main reason is that life in the countryside is less convenient. There are fewer shops, restaurants, and entertainment options nearby, and transportation is not very convenient either. In addition, I am already used to the fast pace and convenience of city life. I think staying there for a short holiday is wonderful, but living there every day might become a little boring for me. That is why I like visiting my grandparents’ home but would not want to live there permanently.
audio_text: Describe a home that you like to visit but do not want to live in You should say: Where it is; What it is like; Why you like to visit it; And explain why you would not like to live there
label: P2-21

topic: 喜欢拜访但不想住的家
label: P3-喜欢拜访但不想住的家-Q1
text: Do Chinese people like to visit others’ homes?
strategy: 文化类问题。可以从“家庭观念”“社交习惯”“现代变化”展开。
answer: Yes, many Chinese people like visiting others’ homes, especially during festivals or family gatherings. Visiting relatives and friends is an important part of social culture in China. People often bring small gifts or food when visiting someone’s home. However, younger people today may meet more often in restaurants or cafés because modern life is busy. So, home visits are still common in China, although social habits are slowly changing.
audio_text: Do Chinese people like to visit others’ homes?

topic: 喜欢拜访但不想住的家
label: P3-喜欢拜访但不想住的家-Q2
text: What do Chinese people do when they visit others?
strategy: 文化类问题。可以从“带礼物”“聊天吃饭”“表达礼貌”展开。
answer: When Chinese people visit others, they often bring small gifts such as fruit, snacks, or tea to show politeness and respect. Hosts usually prepare food or drinks, and people spend time chatting together. During festivals or family visits, meals are often an important part of the gathering. So, visiting others in China is usually warm and polite, with a strong focus on hospitality and social connection.
audio_text: What do Chinese people do when they visit others?

topic: 喜欢拜访但不想住的家
label: P3-喜欢拜访但不想住的家-Q3
text: What kind of place do people in your country like to live in?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“便利性”“环境”“不同年龄偏好”展开。
answer: Many people in my country like living in places with convenient transportation, good public services, and a comfortable environment. Young people often prefer cities because of work opportunities and entertainment. Older people may prefer quieter places with cleaner air and less stress. Some families also like living near parks, schools, or shopping areas because daily life becomes easier. So, people usually choose places that balance convenience, comfort, and lifestyle needs.
audio_text: What kind of place do people in your country like to live in?

topic: 喜欢拜访但不想住的家
label: P3-喜欢拜访但不想住的家-Q4
text: What's the difference between homes in cities and those in the countryside?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以从“空间”“环境”“生活便利”展开。
answer: Homes in cities are usually smaller and closer together because land is expensive. However, city homes are often more convenient because they are near schools, shops, and public transportation. Homes in the countryside are generally larger and quieter. People there often have gardens or open space around their houses. The environment is usually more peaceful and natural. So, city homes offer convenience, while countryside homes provide more space and a calmer lifestyle.
audio_text: What's the difference between homes in cities and those in the countryside?

text: Describe an important river/lake in your country
bullets: And explain why it is important

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“地点类 + 地理类”话题，要求你描述一个你国家里重要的河流或湖泊。需要说清：它在哪里、它有多大或多长、它看起来是什么样子，以及它为什么重要。整体以现在时为主。重点在于自然特点和实际意义。
这里可以选择中国著名河流或湖泊，比如长江、西湖或洞庭湖。思路上可以先说清它的位置；然后要说清规模和外观；接着可以重点说它的重要性，比如历史、经济或旅游价值；最后表达你的看法。
第一段：介绍这个河流或湖泊的位置；第二段：描述它的大小和外观；第三段：解释它为什么重要，并表达你的感受。

phrases: The river I want to talk about is the Yangtze River. 我想说的河流是长江。
It is located in China. 它位于中国。
背景描述 It is one of the most famous rivers in the country. 它是中国最著名的河流之一。
Many cities are built along the river. 很多城市都建在江边。
The river has a long history. 这条河历史悠久。
It is extremely long and wide. 它非常长也非常宽。
The river passes through many areas. 这条河流经很多地区。
具体描述 The scenery around it is beautiful. 它周围风景很美。
In some places, the water looks calm and peaceful. 有些地方水面平静安宁。
The river changes a lot in different seasons. 这条河在不同季节变化很大。
The river is important for transportation and farming. 这条河对交通和农业很重要。
It supports the lives of many people. 它支撑着很多人的生活。
描述感受 It also attracts many tourists every year. 它每年也吸引很多游客。
I think it is an important symbol of China. 我觉得它是中国的重要象征。
That is why this river is so important. 这就是这条河如此重要的原因。
answer: An important river in my country is Yangtze River. It is one of the most famous rivers in China and is located across several parts of the country. The river starts in western China and flows all the way to the eastern coast. Many large cities are built along it, so it plays a very important role in people’s daily lives. The Yangtze River is extremely long and wide. In fact, it is the longest river in China and one of the longest rivers in the world. The scenery around the river changes a lot depending on the area. In some places, there are mountains and forests nearby, while in other places, there are busy cities and large bridges crossing the river. Sometimes the water looks calm and peaceful, especially during good weather, and the natural scenery can be very beautiful. I think this river is important for several reasons. First, it supports transportation, farming, and business activities in many regions. Second, millions of people depend on it for water and economic development. In addition, the river has strong historical and cultural importance in China, so many people see it as an important national symbol. It also attracts many tourists every year because of its beautiful scenery. That is why I believe the Yangtze River is one of the most important rivers in my country.
audio_text: Describe an important river/lake in your country You should say: Where it is located; How big/long it is; What it looks like; And explain why it is important
label: P2-22
P3-重要河流/湖泊-Q1
text: Are rivers and lakes important to a country?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“资源”“经济”“环境”三个方面展开。
answer: Yes, rivers and lakes are very important to a country. They provide water for daily life, farming, and industry. Many cities also depend on rivers for transportation and economic activities. Rivers and lakes are important for the environment as well. They support wildlife and help maintain natural balance. In addition, beautiful lakes and rivers can attract tourists. So, rivers and lakes are valuable for both economic development and environmental protection.
audio_text: Are rivers and lakes important to a country?

label: P3-重要河流/湖泊-Q2
text: What are the popular water sports in your country?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“游泳”“冲浪”“划船”等常见项目展开。
answer: Swimming is one of the most popular water sports in my country because it is healthy and suitable for many ages. People often swim in pools during summer. In coastal areas, sports such as surfing and sailing are becoming more popular among young people. Some people also enjoy boating or kayaking during holidays. So, water sports are becoming more common because they are fun, relaxing, and good for health.
audio_text: What are the popular water sports in your country?

label: P3-重要河流/湖泊-Q3
text: Are rivers and lakes good for transport? Why?
strategy: 观点 + 原因类问题。可以从“运输成本”“大量货物”“环境影响”展开。
answer: Yes, rivers and lakes are good for transport in many situations. Water transport is usually cheaper than road or air transport, especially for large amounts of goods. It can also reduce traffic pressure in busy cities and may be better for the environment because ships use less energy for heavy transport. However, water transport is slower and depends on weather conditions. So, rivers and lakes are useful for transportation, especially for heavy goods and long-distance shipping.
audio_text: Are rivers and lakes good for transport? Why?

label: P3-重要河流/湖泊-Q4
text: How do rivers and lakes affect local tourism?
strategy: 影响类问题。可以从“自然景观”“旅游活动”“经济带动”展开。
answer: Rivers and lakes can strongly support local tourism. Beautiful natural scenery attracts visitors who want to relax, take photos, or enjoy outdoor activities. Many places also offer water sports, boat tours, or fishing activities, which make tourism more interesting. Hotels and restaurants near rivers and lakes can benefit from more visitors as well. So, rivers and lakes help tourism by improving natural beauty and creating recreational opportunities.
audio_text: How do rivers and lakes affect local tourism?

topic: 喜欢或不喜欢的高建筑
text: Describe a tall building you like or dislike
bullets: And explain why you like or dislike it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“地点类 + 建筑类”话题，要求你描述一栋你喜欢或不喜欢的高楼。需要说清：这栋楼是做什么用的、它在哪里、外观是什么样子，以及你为什么喜欢或不喜欢它。整体以现在时为主。重点在于建筑特点 + 个人感受。
这里可以选择地标建筑、办公楼或酒店。思路上可以先说清这栋楼的位置和用途；然后要说清它的外观，比如高度、颜色或设计风格；接着可以重点说你为什么喜欢它，比如景观、设计感或城市氛围。
第一段：介绍这栋高楼是什么以及它在哪里；第二段：描述它的用途和外观；第三段：解释你为什么喜欢它，并总结感受。

phrases: The building I want to talk about is a famous tower. 我想说的建筑是一座著名高塔。
It is located in a busy city center. 它位于繁忙的市中心。
背景描述 Many tourists visit it every year. 每年都有很多游客去那里。
It is one of the tallest buildings in the area. 它是当地最高的建筑之一。
I first saw it in a travel program. 我最早是在旅游节目里看到它的。
The building is mainly used for offices and tourism. 这栋楼主要用于办公和旅游。
It has a modern glass design. 它是现代玻璃设计。
具体描述 The tower looks very impressive at night. 这座塔在夜晚看起来非常震撼。
Its lights can be seen from far away. 很远就能看到它的灯光。
The building stands out from the surrounding area. 它在周围建筑中非常显眼。
I like its modern appearance. 我喜欢它现代化的外观。
It gives the city a special atmosphere. 它让城市更有特色。
描述感受 I enjoy looking at it from a distance. 我喜欢远远地看着它。
The design makes me feel amazed. 它的设计让我感到惊叹。
That is why I like this tall building so much. 这就是我喜欢这栋高楼的原因。
answer: A tall building that I really like is Shanghai Tower. It is located in the center of Shanghai, one of the biggest cities in China. This building is very famous because it is one of the tallest buildings in the world, and many tourists visit it every year. The building is mainly used for offices, hotels, and tourism. It has a very modern design with a glass exterior, and the shape of the tower looks slightly twisted as it goes upward. During the daytime, the building reflects sunlight and looks bright and clean. At night, the lights make it look even more impressive. Because it is so tall, people can see it from many different parts of the city. There is also an observation deck where visitors can enjoy the view of Shanghai from high above. I like this building mainly because of its modern appearance and strong visual impact. Whenever I see photos or videos of it, I feel amazed by how advanced and beautiful it looks. I also think it represents the fast development of big cities in China. Compared with ordinary buildings, it gives the city a more exciting and international atmosphere. That is why Shanghai Tower is a tall building that I truly like and hope to visit again in the future.
audio_text: Describe a tall building you like or dislike You should say: What it is used for; Where it is; What it looks like; And explain why you like or dislike it
label: P2-23

topic: 喜欢或不喜欢的高建筑
label: P3-喜欢或不喜欢的高建筑-Q1
text: Are there many tall buildings in your country?
strategy: 事实 + 说明类问题。可以从“城市化发展”“人口密度”“现代化象征”三个角度展开，解释为什么高楼在中国越来越常见。
answer: Yes, there are many tall buildings in my country, especially in large cities. As cities develop quickly, more people move to urban areas, so tall buildings help save space and provide housing and offices. Many modern business areas are full of skyscrapers, which also show economic development and modern city life. In addition, shopping malls and hotels are often built in tall buildings. However, smaller cities and rural areas usually have fewer tall buildings. So, tall buildings are very common in big cities, but less common in quieter areas.
audio_text: Are there many tall buildings in your country?

topic: 喜欢或不喜欢的高建筑
label: P3-喜欢或不喜欢的高建筑-Q2
text: What are the differences between those tall buildings in your country?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以从“功能”“设计风格”“地理位置”三个方面展开，说明不同高楼的用途和特点不同，而不是只比较高度
answer: Tall buildings in my country are different in many ways. Some are office buildings used for business, while others are apartment buildings for living. Their designs and functions are not the same. In big business areas, tall buildings often look modern and use glass and steel. Residential buildings are usually simpler and focus more on comfort and daily life. Some tall buildings are also hotels or shopping centers. The location also affects their style. Buildings in large cities are usually taller and more modern than those in smaller cities. So, purpose and location create many differences among tall buildings.
audio_text: What are the differences between those tall buildings in your country?

topic: 喜欢或不喜欢的高建筑
label: P3-喜欢或不喜欢的高建筑-Q3
text: Why are different places laid out and designed differently?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“自然环境”“文化背景”“功能需求”三个方面展开，说明不同地区为什么会形成不同的设计风格和布局。
answer: Different places are designed differently because they serve different needs. Climate is one important reason. For example, hot places may need open spaces and better airflow, while colder areas require warmer and more closed buildings. Culture also affects design. Some countries prefer traditional styles, while others focus more on modern and practical designs. In addition, the purpose of a place matters. Business areas, parks, and residential neighborhoods all need different layouts. So, environment, culture, and function are the main reasons why places are planned differently.
audio_text: Why are different places laid out and designed differently?

topic: 喜欢或不喜欢的高建筑
label: P3-喜欢或不喜欢的高建筑-Q4
text: What are the advantages of living in tall buildings?
strategy: 优势类问题。可以从“节省空间”“生活便利”“视野与安全”三个角度展开，说明高层住宅在现代城市中的实用性。
answer: Living in tall buildings has several advantages. First, tall buildings save space, which is very important in crowded cities. More people can live in the same area, so land can be used more efficiently. Second, tall buildings are often located in convenient areas close to shops, schools, and public transportation. This makes daily life easier. People living on higher floors may also enjoy better views and less street noise. Some modern buildings also provide security systems and shared facilities such as gyms or gardens. So, tall buildings offer convenience, efficient use of space, and comfortable city living.
audio_text: What are the advantages of living in tall buildings?

text: Describe a special cake you received from others
bullets: Who you got the cake from
And explain why it's a special cake

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“经历类 + 礼物类”话题，要求你描述一个别人送给你的特别蛋糕。需要说清：事情发生在什么时候、在哪里、是谁送给你的，以及为什么这个蛋糕特别。整体以过去时为主，最后可以用现在时总结感受。重点在于情感意义和当时的氛围。
这里可以选择生日、毕业、节日或惊喜聚会中的蛋糕。思路上可以先说清事情发生的时间和地点；然后要说清是谁送给你的；接着可以重点说蛋糕特别在哪里，比如外形、味道或背后的心意；最后表达你的感受。
第一段：介绍事情发生的时间、地点和送蛋糕的人；第二段：描述蛋糕的样子和当时发生的事情；第三段：解释为什么这个蛋糕很特别，并总结感受。

phrases: It happened on my birthday last year. 事情发生在去年我生日的时候。
The celebration took place at home. 庆祝是在家里进行的。
背景描述 I received the cake from my friends. 我从朋友那里收到了这个蛋糕。
It was a complete surprise. 这是一个完全的惊喜。
I did not expect anything special that day. 那天我原本没期待什么特别的事。
The cake had a simple but beautiful design. 蛋糕设计简单但很好看。
It was decorated with fruit and chocolate. 它用了水果和巧克力装饰。
具体描述 My name was written on the top. 上面写着我的名字。
Everyone sang a birthday song together. 大家一起唱了生日歌。
The atmosphere was warm and cheerful. 当时的气氛很温暖开心。
I felt touched and happy. 我感到感动又开心。
The cake showed their care for me. 这个蛋糕体现了他们对我的关心。
描述感受 It became one of my favorite memories. 它成了我最喜欢的回忆之一。
I still remember that moment clearly. 我现在还清楚记得那个时刻。
That is why the cake was very special to me. 这就是为什么那个蛋糕对我来说很特别。
answer: A special cake I received from others was on my birthday last year. The celebration happened at my home in the evening, and the cake was given to me by a group of my close friends. I did not expect anything special that day, because I thought everyone was too busy with study and work. That evening, my friends suddenly came to my house with a birthday cake and some small gifts. The cake was not very large, but it had a beautiful design. It was decorated with fruit, cream, and chocolate, and my name was written on the top. What made it even more special was that they chose my favorite flavor, which was mango. After they brought out the cake, everyone sang a birthday song together, and the atmosphere became very warm and cheerful. I think this cake was special not because of its price or appearance, but because of the feelings behind it. My friends spent time planning the surprise and remembered what I liked, which made me feel truly cared for. At that moment, I felt very touched and grateful to have such thoughtful friends around me. Even now, I still remember that evening clearly whenever I think about birthdays. That is why this cake became one of the most special cakes I have ever received.
audio_text: Describe a special cake you received from others You should say: When it happened; Where it happened; Who you got the cake from; And explain why it's a special cake
label: P2-24
P3-收到特殊蛋糕-Q1
text: What are the differences between special food in China and other countries?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以从“口味”“烹饪方式”“饮食文化”三个方面展开，不需要绝对化，而是强调文化差异。
answer: Chinese special food is often very different from food in other countries. Chinese dishes usually have rich flavors and use many cooking methods, such as frying, steaming, and boiling. Sharing food together is also an important part of Chinese culture. In some other countries, food may be simpler in flavor and served in separate portions. People may focus more on bread, meat, or cold dishes. So, the main differences are in taste, cooking style, and eating habits, which are closely connected to culture and history.
audio_text: What are the differences between special food in China and other countries?

label: P3-收到特殊蛋糕-Q2
text: Is there any food in your country that is eaten at special times or on special occasions?
strategy: 说明与举例类问题。可以结合中国节日文化展开，重点解释“食物与意义”的联系。
answer: Yes, there are many foods in my country that are eaten on special occasions. For example, people eat dumplings during the Chinese New Year because they represent wealth and good luck. Mooncakes are popular during the Mid-Autumn Festival, when families gather together and enjoy the full moon. Rice dumplings are eaten during the Dragon Boat Festival to remember an important historical person. These foods are not only for eating. They also carry cultural meaning and help families celebrate together. So, special foods are an important part of traditional festivals in my country.
audio_text: Is there any food in your country that is eaten at special times or on special occasions?

label: P3-收到特殊蛋糕-Q3
text: Why are some people willing to spend a lot of money on meals on special days?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“纪念意义”“社交情感”“体验价值”三个角度展开。
answer: Some people spend a lot of money on meals on special days because these occasions are important to them. Birthdays, weddings, and festivals are meaningful moments, so people want to celebrate properly. A good meal also creates a warm atmosphere for family and friends. Many people think the experience and memories are more valuable than the money itself. In addition, eating at a special restaurant can make the day feel more exciting. So, emotions, celebration, and shared experiences make people willing to pay more for meals on important occasions.
audio_text: Why are some people willing to spend a lot of money on meals on special days?

label: P3-收到特殊蛋糕-Q4
text: Do you think it’s good to communicate when eating with your family?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“增进感情”“分享信息”“减少距离感”三个角度展开，强调家庭交流的重要性。
answer: Yes, I think it is very good to communicate when eating with family. Mealtime gives family members a chance to talk about daily life, school, or work. This helps people understand and support each other better. Talking during meals also creates a warm and relaxed atmosphere. In modern life, many people are busy, so family meals may be one of the few times they spend together. So, communication during meals is important for building strong family relationships and improving emotional connection.
audio_text: Do you think it’s good to communicate when eating with your family?

text: Describe a food that people eat on special occasions or events
bullets: What the special event or occasion is
How it is cooked or made
And explain why people eat it on that special occasion or event

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“物品类+食物类”话题，要求你描述一种人们在特殊场合会吃的食物。需要说清：这是什么食物、在什么场合吃、如何制作，以及为什么人们会在这个场合吃它。整体以现在时为主。重点在于食物背后的文化意义和习俗。
这里可以选择节日食品、生日食品或家庭聚会常见食物。思路上可以先说清食物名称和对应场合；然后要说清基本制作过程；接着可以重点说这种食物的象征意义；最后说明为什么人们会在这个特殊场合吃它。
第一段：介绍这种食物以及对应的特殊场合；第二段：描述它是如何制作的；第三段：解释为什么人们会在这个场合吃它，并表达你的感受。

phrases: The food I want to talk about is dumplings. 我想说的食物是饺子。
People often eat it during the Spring Festival. 人们通常在春节吃它。
背景描述 It is a traditional Chinese food. 它是一种传统中国食物。
Many families make it together. 很多家庭会一起做。
The dish is closely connected to family gatherings. 这道食物和家庭团聚关系密切。
The filling is usually made with meat and vegetables. 馅料通常由肉和蔬菜做成。
People wrap the filling in thin dough. 人们会把馅包进面皮里。
具体描述 Then the dumplings are boiled in hot water. 然后把饺子放进热水里煮。
Different families have different recipes. 不同家庭有不同做法。
Making dumplings often takes time and teamwork. 包饺子通常需要时间和合作。
The food represents reunion and happiness. 这种食物象征团圆和幸福。
Eating it creates a warm atmosphere. 吃它会营造温暖氛围。
描述感受 It reminds people of family traditions. 它让人想到家庭传统。
I always look forward to eating it. 我总是很期待吃它。
That is why this food is important on special occasions. 这就是这种食物在特殊场合重要的原因。
answer: A food that people often eat on special occasions in China is dumplings. It is a very traditional Chinese food, and many families eat it during the Spring Festival, which is the most important holiday in China. During this festival, family members usually gather together, have dinner, and celebrate the beginning of a new year. Dumplings are normally made with thin dough and different kinds of fillings. The filling is often prepared with meat and vegetables, such as pork, cabbage, or green onions. After preparing the filling, people wrap it carefully inside small pieces of dough. Then the dumplings are boiled in hot water until they are ready to eat. In many families, making dumplings is not only about cooking food, but also about spending time together. Everyone sits around the table and helps with the process. People eat dumplings on special occasions because they represent reunion, happiness, and good luck. Their shape is also believed to look like ancient Chinese gold pieces, so many people think eating dumplings can bring wealth and good fortune in the new year. For me, dumplings are more than just food. Whenever I eat them during the Spring Festival, I feel a strong sense of warmth and family connection. That is why this food is so important during special celebrations in China.
audio_text: Describe a food that people eat on special occasions or events You should say: What it is; What the special event or occasion is; How it is cooked or made; And explain why people eat it on that special occasion or event
label: P2-25
P3-特别场合的食物-Q1
text: Why are there special foods on special occasions or events?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“文化传统”“象征意义”“家庭团聚”三个方面展开。
answer: There are special foods on special occasions because food is closely connected to culture and tradition. Many traditional foods have symbolic meanings, such as good luck, happiness, or family unity. Special food also helps create a festive atmosphere. During holidays or celebrations, families and friends gather together and enjoy meals as part of the event. These traditions are often passed down from older generations. So, special foods are important because they carry cultural meaning and help people celebrate together.
audio_text: Why are there special foods on special occasions or events?

label: P3-特别场合的食物-Q2
text: What are the differences between everyday food and festival food?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以从“制作复杂度”“象征意义”“家庭氛围”三个方面展开。
answer: Everyday food is usually simple and practical because people eat it regularly. It is often quick to prepare and focuses on daily nutrition and convenience. Festival food is different because it carries cultural meaning and is often prepared more carefully. Special dishes are usually richer and more expensive, and families often cook together during festivals. Some foods also symbolize good luck or happiness. So, everyday food focuses on daily needs, while festival food is more connected to tradition, celebration, and family gatherings
audio_text: What are the differences between everyday food and festival food?

label: P3-特别场合的食物-Q3
text: Are there any differences between the food people eat today and the food people ate in the past?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以从“饮食种类”“烹饪方式”“生活节奏”三个方面展开。
answer: Yes, there are many differences between food today and food in the past. In the past, people usually ate simpler and more traditional meals made with local ingredients. Home cooking was more common. Today, people have more food choices because of globalization and technology. Fast food and takeout are much more popular now because modern life is busy. People also pay more attention to healthy food and nutrition. So, modern food is more diverse and convenient, while traditional food was usually simpler and more connected to local culture.
audio_text: Are there any differences between the food people eat today and the food people ate in the past?

text: Describe a story/book with animals in it
bullets: And explain what you think of this story/book

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“书籍类 + 故事类”话题，要求你描述一本有动物角色的故事书。需要说清：里面有哪些动物、故事讲了什么、你为什么读这本书，以及你对这本书的看法。整体以现在时和过去时结合为主。重点在于故事内容和个人感受。
这里可以选择童话、寓言或儿童文学。思路上可以先说清故事中的动物；然后要说清故事主要内容；接着可以重点说你为什么会读这本书；最后表达你对这个故事的看法，比如有趣、感人或有教育意义。
第一段：介绍这本书以及里面有哪些动物；第二段：描述故事内容和你为什么会读它；第三段：解释你对这个故事的感受，并总结原因。

phrases: The story I want to talk about is a famous children’s book. 我想说的故事是一本著名儿童书。
It includes several animal characters. 它里面有几个动物角色。
背景描述 I read it when I was younger. 我小时候读过它。
The book is popular in many countries. 这本书在很多国家都很受欢迎。
I first learned about it at school. 我最早是在学校知道它的。
The main characters are different farm animals. 主要角色是不同的农场动物。
The story is about friendship and teamwork. 这个故事关于友谊和合作。
具体描述 Each animal has a different personality. 每只动物都有不同性格。
The animals go through many challenges together. 这些动物一起经历了很多困难。
The story is simple but meaningful. 这个故事简单但很有意义。
I found the book very enjoyable. 我觉得这本书非常有趣。
The story taught me some important lessons. 这个故事教会了我一些重要道理。
描述感受 I liked the animal characters a lot. 我很喜欢里面的动物角色。
The book left a strong impression on me. 这本书给我留下了深刻印象。
That is why I still remember it clearly today. 这就是我今天还清楚记得它的原因。
answer: A story with animals in it that I still remember clearly is Charlotte's Web. It is a famous children’s book that includes several animal characters, especially a pig named Wilbur and a spider named Charlotte. I first read this book when I was in primary school after my teacher recommended it to our class. The story is mainly about friendship and kindness. Wilbur is a small pig living on a farm, and one day he learns that he may be killed when he grows bigger. Charlotte, the spider, decides to help him by creating words in her web to make people think Wilbur is special. Because of her efforts, Wilbur becomes famous and is eventually saved. Besides Wilbur and Charlotte, there are also other farm animals in the story, and each one has a different personality. I read this book because many people said it was touching and meaningful, and I was curious about it. After reading it, I understood why it is so popular. Although the story is simple, it teaches important lessons about friendship, loyalty, and helping others. I especially liked the relationship between the pig and the spider because it showed that true friendship can exist between very different individuals. I think this is a wonderful story because it is emotional, easy to understand, and meaningful for both children and adults. That is why I still remember it clearly today.
audio_text: Describe a story/book with animals in it You should say: What animals are in it; What the story/book is about; Why you read the story/book; And explain what you think of this story/book
label: P2-26
P3-包含动物的故事或书-Q1
text: Should schools teach children about animals?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“自然知识”“环保意识”“兴趣培养”展开。
answer: Yes, schools should teach children about animals. Learning about animals helps children understand nature and the environment better. It can also increase respect and care for living things. Children are usually interested in animals, so these lessons can make learning more enjoyable. Schools can also teach students about protecting endangered animals and natural habitats. So, animal education is useful for both knowledge and environmental awareness.
audio_text: Should schools teach children about animals?

label: P3-包含动物的故事或书-Q2
text: Some people think pets should not be kept in cities. What do you think?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以采取平衡观点，承认问题但认为合理管理即可。
answer: I think pets can be kept in cities if owners are responsible. Pets can provide emotional support and reduce loneliness, especially for people living alone. However, there can be problems such as noise, safety issues, or dirty public spaces if pets are not managed properly. Owners should follow rules and take good care of their animals. So, pets are acceptable in cities as long as people behave responsibly.
audio_text: Some people think pets should not be kept in cities. What do you think?

label: P3-包含动物的故事或书-Q3
text: Many people regard pets as members of their family. What do you think?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“情感陪伴”“家庭关系”“责任”展开。
answer: I think it is natural for many people to regard pets as family members. Pets provide emotional support and companionship, especially for people who live alone or feel stressed. Many owners spend a lot of time caring for their pets, so strong emotional bonds develop over time. However, keeping pets also means taking responsibility for their health and behavior. So, pets can become part of the family because they bring comfort, friendship, and emotional connection.
audio_text: Many people regard pets as members of their family. What do you think?

label: P3-包含动物的故事或书-Q4
text: Do many people keep pets in your country?
strategy: 现象类问题。可以从“城市养宠增加”“陪伴需求”“常见宠物”展开。
answer: Yes, many people in my country keep pets nowadays, especially in cities. Dogs and cats are the most common pets because they provide companionship and emotional support. Young people and older adults often enjoy having pets at home. In recent years, keeping pets has become more popular because living standards have improved and people pay more attention to emotional well-being. So, pet ownership is becoming increasingly common in my country.
audio_text: Do many people keep pets in your country?

text: Describe a plan that you had to change recently
bullets: What made you change the plan
And how you felt about the change

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“经历类 + 变化调整类”话题，要求你描述一个你最近不得不改变的计划。需要说清：这件事是什么时候发生的、为什么你要改变计划、新计划是什么，以及你对这个变化的感受。整体以过去时为主。重点在于计划变化的原因和你的情绪变化。
这里可以选择旅行计划、学习安排或聚会。思路上可以先说清原本的计划是什么；然后要说清是什么原因导致计划改变；接着可以重点说新的安排；最后表达你从失望到接受甚至满意的情绪变化。
第一段：介绍原本的计划以及事情发生的时间；第二段：描述为什么计划发生变化，以及新的安排；第三段：解释你对这次变化的感受，并总结想法。

phrases: This happened about a month ago. 这件事发生在大约一个月前。
I originally planned to travel with my friends. 我原本计划和朋友去旅行。
背景描述 We had prepared for it in advance. 我们提前做了准备。
Everything seemed well organized at first. 一开始一切看起来都安排好了。
I was looking forward to the plan. 我当时很期待这个计划。
Something unexpected happened. 发生了一些意外情况。
The weather suddenly became terrible. 天气突然变得很糟。
具体描述 We had to cancel the original plan. 我们不得不取消原计划。
Instead, we changed it to a short local trip. 后来我们改成了本地短途活动。
The new plan was simpler and more practical. 新计划更简单也更现实。
At first, I felt disappointed. 一开始我很失望。
Later, I understood the situation better. 后来我更能理解当时的情况。
描述感受 The change turned out to be a good idea. 这个改变后来证明是个好主意。
I learned to be more flexible. 我学会了更加灵活。
That experience left a strong impression on me. 那次经历给我留下了深刻印象。
answer: A plan that I had to change recently happened about a month ago. My friends and I originally planned to take a short trip to another city during a weekend holiday. We had already discussed the transportation, hotel, and places we wanted to visit, so I was really looking forward to it. However, a few days before the trip, the weather suddenly became very bad. Heavy rain was expected for several days, and there were also delays in public transportation. Because of these problems, we realized that continuing with the original plan would not be safe or enjoyable. After discussing it together, we decided to cancel the trip and change it to a simple local activity instead. In the end, we spent the weekend visiting a nearby park, eating together, and watching a movie. At first, I felt quite disappointed because I had been excited about traveling for a long time. I even prepared clothes and made a list of places I wanted to visit. However, after spending time with my friends during the new plan, I slowly felt better. The experience was still relaxing and enjoyable, even though it was different from what I expected. This change taught me that plans do not always go perfectly, and sometimes being flexible is important. Looking back, I think changing the plan was actually a smart decision, and I learned how to deal with unexpected situations more calmly.
audio_text: Describe a plan that you had to change recently You should say: When this happened; What made you change the plan; What the new plan was; And how you felt about the change
label: P2-27
P3-近期改变的计划-Q1
text: Do people often change their plans?
strategy: 现象类问题。可以从“生活变化快”“突发情况”“个人想法改变”解释。
answer: Yes, people often change their plans today. Modern life changes quickly, so unexpected situations happen quite often. Work schedules, traffic, or family matters may force people to adjust plans. People may also change their minds after getting new information or ideas. Sometimes changing a plan is a practical choice rather than a problem. So, changing plans is very common because life is flexible and unpredictable.
audio_text: Do people often change their plans?

label: P3-近期改变的计划-Q2
text: Would you tell others if you change your plan?
strategy: 个人态度类问题。可以根据“是否影响他人”展开。
answer: Yes, I would usually tell others if I change my plan, especially when the plan involves other people. Informing others shows respect and helps avoid misunderstanding or inconvenience. For example, if I cancel a meeting or change travel time, I think it is important to let people know early. However, if the change only affects myself, I may not always mention it. So, whether I tell others depends on how much the change influences them.
audio_text: Would you tell others if you change your plan?

label: P3-近期改变的计划-Q3
text: Why do you think parents still make plans for their children nowadays?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“竞争压力”“对子女未来的担心”“传统观念”展开。
answer: Parents still make plans for their children because they care about their future. Competition in education and work is strong, so parents want to help children succeed. Many parents also believe their experience can guide children and help them avoid mistakes. In some cultures, parents feel responsible for making important decisions for the family. So, concern for children’s future and social pressure are the main reasons parents continue making plans for them.
audio_text: Why do you think parents still make plans for their children nowadays?

label: P3-近期改变的计划-Q4
text: How does technology help people make plans?
strategy: 影响类问题。可以从“信息获取”“时间管理”“沟通协调”三个方面展开。
answer: Technology helps people make plans more easily and efficiently. Mobile phones and apps allow people to organize schedules, set reminders, and manage time clearly. The internet also provides useful information about weather, transportation, or prices, which helps people make better decisions. In addition, communication tools make it easier for groups to discuss and change plans quickly. So, technology improves planning by saving time and making information easier to access.
audio_text: How does technology help people make plans?

text: Describe an interesting video
bullets: When and where you watched it
And explain how you feel about it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“媒体类 + 经历类”话题，要求你描述一个你觉得很有趣的视频。需要说清：你什么时候、在哪里看的，视频内容是什么，你为什么会看它，以及你对这个视频的感受。整体以过去时描述观看经历，用现在时表达感受。重点在于视频内容和你的兴趣点。
这里可以选择纪录片、旅行视频、科普视频或短视频。思路上可以先说清你是在什么情况下看到这个视频的；然后要说清视频主要讲了什么；接着可以重点说你为什么点开它；最后说明这个视频为什么让你觉得有趣。
第一段：介绍你什么时候、在哪里看到了这个视频；第二段：描述视频内容以及你为什么会看它；第三段：解释你对这个视频的感受，并总结原因。

phrases: I watched the video a few weeks ago. 我是几周前看的这个视频。
I found it on a video-sharing platform. 我是在视频平台上发现它的。
背景描述 I watched it at home in the evening. 我是在晚上在家看的。
The video became popular online. 这个视频当时在网上很火。
A friend also recommended it to me. 一个朋友也推荐了它。
The video was about wildlife and nature. 这个视频是关于野生动物和自然的。
It showed beautiful natural scenery. 它展示了美丽的自然景色。
具体描述 The camera work was impressive. 拍摄方式很棒。
The narrator explained things clearly. 讲解者解释得很清楚。
I learned many new things from it. 我从中学到了很多新东西。
I found the video both relaxing and educational. 我觉得这个视频既放松又有教育意义。
It kept my attention the whole time. 它从头到尾都吸引着我。
描述感受 I felt more interested in nature after watching it. 看完后我对自然更感兴趣了。
The video left a strong impression on me. 这个视频给我留下了深刻印象。
That is why I think it was very interesting. 这就是我觉得它很有趣的原因。
answer: An interesting video I watched recently was a nature documentary video that I found online a few weeks ago. I watched it at home one evening after finishing my work. At first, I only planned to watch it for a few minutes, but the content became so interesting that I ended up watching the entire video. The video was mainly about wildlife and natural scenery in different parts of the world. It showed forests, mountains, oceans, and many wild animals living in their natural environment. What impressed me most was the camera work, because the scenes looked extremely clear and beautiful. The narrator also explained things in a simple and interesting way, so it was easy to understand even for people who do not know much about nature. I decided to watch this video because one of my friends recommended it to me. He said it was relaxing and educational, and he was right. While watching it, I felt calm and completely focused on the scenes. I also learned many new things about animals and the environment. After watching the video, I became more interested in nature and wanted to learn more about wildlife protection. Overall, I think it was a very interesting video because it was not only entertaining, but also meaningful and informative. It helped me relax while teaching me something valuable at the same time.
audio_text: Describe an interesting video You should say: When and where you watched it; What it is about; Why you watched it; And explain how you feel about it
label: P2-28
P3-有趣视频-Q1
text: What kind of videos do people in your country like to watch?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“娱乐”“学习”“短视频趋势”展开。
answer: People in my country enjoy many kinds of videos. Short videos are very popular because they are quick and entertaining. Many people watch funny clips, food videos, or travel content to relax. Educational videos are also common, especially among students and young workers. People use them to learn languages, cooking, or work skills. So, people usually prefer videos that are interesting, useful, and easy to watch in daily life.
audio_text: What kind of videos do people in your country like to watch?

label: P3-有趣视频-Q2
text: Which is more helpful, watching videos or reading books?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以采取平衡观点，但说明各自优势。
answer: Both watching videos and reading books are helpful, but they help people in different ways. Videos are easier to understand quickly because they use pictures and sound. They are useful for learning practical skills or watching demonstrations. Books are better for deep thinking and concentration. Reading helps improve imagination, vocabulary, and understanding of complex ideas. So, videos are more convenient for quick learning, while books are more helpful for deeper learning and thinking.
audio_text: Which is more helpful, watching videos or reading books?

label: P3-有趣视频-Q3
text: What skills can people learn from watching videos?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“实用技能”“学习效率”“兴趣培养”三个角度展开。
answer: People can learn many useful skills from watching videos. For example, they can learn cooking, languages, or computer skills through online tutorials. Videos are helpful because people can clearly see each step and repeat difficult parts. Watching videos can also inspire people to try new hobbies or creative activities. So, videos make learning more visual, convenient, and interesting for many people.
audio_text: What skills can people learn from watching videos?

label: P3-有趣视频-Q4
text: Are there any differences between the videos that young people and old people like to watch?
strategy: 对比类问题。可以从“内容类型”“观看目的”“平台使用”展开。
answer: Yes, there are clear differences. Young people often enjoy short videos, games, music, or fashion content because these videos are fast and entertaining. They usually watch videos on apps and social media platforms. Older people may prefer news, health programs, cooking videos, or traditional TV shows. They often watch videos to learn useful information or relax quietly. So, age, interests, and lifestyle strongly influence the kinds of videos people like to watch.
audio_text: Are there any differences between the videos that young people and old people like to watch?

text: Describe a new law you would like to introduce in your country
bullets: Whether this new law will be popular
How you came up with the new law
And explain how you feel about this new law

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“社会类 + 观点类”话题，要求你描述一项你希望在自己国家实行的新法律。需要说清：这项法律是什么、会带来什么变化、它是否会受欢迎、你是如何想到这项法律的，以及你对它的感受。整体以现在时和将来时为主。重点在于法律内容和现实影响。
这里可以选择与生活关系密切、容易展开的话题，比如环保、网络使用或公共场所行为。思路上可以先说清法律内容；然后要说清它会带来哪些变化；接着可以重点说人们是否会支持它以及原因；最后说明你为什么想到这个法律，并表达你的态度。
第一段：介绍这项法律是什么；第二段：描述它会带来的变化，以及是否会受欢迎；第三段：解释你为什么想到这项法律，并总结你的感受。

phrases: The law I want to introduce is related to mobile phones. 我想提出的法律和手机有关。
It would focus on public behavior. 它会关注公共行为。
背景描述 Many people face this problem every day. 很多人每天都会遇到这个问题。
I started thinking about it recently. 我是最近开始想到这个问题的。
The law would mainly apply to public places. 这项法律主要适用于公共场所。
The law would limit loud phone use in public areas. 这项法律会限制公共场所大声使用手机。
People would need to lower their volume. 人们需要降低音量。
具体描述 It could make public spaces quieter. 它能让公共场所更安静。
The law might improve people’s daily experience. 这项法律可能改善人们的日常体验。
Some people would support it immediately. 有些人会立刻支持它。
I think the idea is practical. 我觉得这个想法很实际。
It could improve public manners. 它能改善公共礼仪。
描述感受 I would feel happier in quieter environments. 我会在更安静的环境里更开心。
The law may take time to become accepted. 这项法律可能需要时间被接受。
That is why I would like this law to exist. 这就是我希望有这项法律的原因。
answer: A new law I would like to introduce in my country is a law that limits loud mobile phone use in public places such as buses, trains, restaurants, and libraries. Nowadays, many people watch videos or make phone calls loudly in public, which can disturb others around them. I think this is a common problem in daily life. If this law were introduced, people would need to lower the volume of their phones or use headphones in shared public spaces. It could make public environments quieter and more comfortable for everyone. I believe this law would improve public manners and reduce unnecessary noise. Some people would probably support it immediately because they also feel annoyed by loud phone sounds. However, others might think the law is too strict at first, so it could take some time for everyone to accept it fully. I came up with this idea because I often experience noisy situations when taking public transportation or studying outside. Sometimes it becomes difficult to focus or relax because of loud videos and phone calls nearby. After experiencing this many times, I started thinking that there should be clearer rules for public behavior. Personally, I feel this law would be practical and useful. It may seem like a small change, but I think it could improve people’s daily experience in a meaningful way. That is why I would really like to introduce this law in my country.
audio_text: Describe a new law you would like to introduce in your country You should say: What law it is; What changes this law brings; Whether this new law will be popular; How you came up with the new law; And explain how you feel about this new law
label: P2-29
P3-想颁布的新法律-Q1
text: What rules should students follow at school?
strategy: 明类问题。可以从“纪律”“尊重”“安全”三个角度展开。
answer: Students should follow rules that help create a good learning environment. For example, they should arrive on time, finish homework, and listen carefully in class. Respect is also important. Students should be polite to teachers and classmates and avoid bullying or fighting. Schools also need safety rules, such as not running in dangerous areas. So, school rules help students study well, respect others, and stay safe.
audio_text: What rules should students follow at school?

label: P3-想颁布的新法律-Q2
text: Do people in your country usually obey the law?
strategy: 现象类问题。可以给出总体肯定，再承认少数例外。
answer: Yes, I think most people in my country usually obey the law. People understand that laws help keep society safe and organized. For example, most people follow traffic rules and public regulations in daily life. However, there are still some people who break rules for convenience or personal benefit. So, although not everyone follows the law perfectly, most people respect legal rules in general.
audio_text: Do people in your country usually obey the law?

label: P3-想颁布的新法律-Q3
text: What kinds of behavior are considered as good behavior?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从“礼貌”“责任感”“尊重他人”展开。
answer: Good behavior usually means being polite and respectful to others. Saying “please” and “thank you,” listening carefully, and speaking kindly are common examples. Being responsible is also important. People who keep promises, follow rules, and help others are often seen as well behaved. So, good behavior is about treating others kindly and acting responsibly in daily life.
audio_text: What kinds of behavior are considered as good behavior?

label: P3-想颁布的新法律-Q4
text: Do you think children can learn about the law outside of school?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“家庭教育”“媒体影响”“社会经验”展开。
answer: Yes, children can learn about the law outside of school. Parents can teach children simple rules and explain why laws are important in daily life. Children also learn from TV programs, books, and the internet. Real-life experiences, such as following traffic rules or public rules, also help children understand the law. So, schools are important, but families and society also play a big role in legal education.
audio_text: Do you think children can learn about the law outside of school?

text: Describe an advertisement with a famous person in it
bullets: And explain how you feel about the advertisement

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“物品类+媒体类 ”话题，要求你描述一个有名人出演的广告。需要说清：这个名人是谁、你在哪里看到这个广告、广告内容是什么，以及你对这个广告的感受。整体以现在时和过去时结合为主。重点在于广告内容和你对名人代言的看法。
这里可以选择运动员、演员或歌手出演的广告。思路上可以先说清这个名人是谁；然后要说清你在哪里看到广告；接着可以重点说广告在宣传什么；最后表达你对广告的感受，比如是否吸引人、真实或有影响力。
第一段：介绍广告中的名人是谁，以及你在哪里看到广告；第二段：描述广告内容；第三段：解释你对这个广告的感受，并总结原因。

phrases: The advertisement I want to talk about features a famous athlete. 我想说的广告里有一位著名运动
员。
I saw it online and on television. 我是在网上和电视上看到它的。
背景描述 The advertisement became very popular. 这个广告当时很火。
Many people talked about it on social media. 很多人在社交媒体上讨论它。
The famous person in the advertisement is well known worldwide. 广告里的名人在世界范围内都很
有名。
The advertisement is about sports products. 这个广告是关于运动产品的。
It shows the athlete training very hard. 它展示了这位运动员努力训练。
具体描述 The video uses inspiring music and scenes. 视频用了很励志的音乐和画面。
The message is about hard work and confidence. 它传递的是努力和自信。
The advertisement looks professional and energetic. 这个广告看起来专业又有活力。
I found the advertisement very motivating. 我觉得这个广告很激励人。
The famous person made the advertisement more believable. 这个名人让广告更有说服力。
描述感受 It left a strong impression on me. 它给我留下了深刻印象。
I could understand why people liked it. 我能理解为什么大家喜欢它。
That is why I have a positive feeling about it. 这就是我对它印象不错的原因。
answer: An advertisement with a famous person in it that I remember clearly is a sports advertisement featuring Cristiano Ronaldo. I first saw it online, and later I also noticed it on television and social media platforms. At that time, many people were sharing and discussing the advertisement because Cristiano Ronaldo is extremely popular around the world. The advertisement was mainly about sports shoes and training products. In the video, Ronaldo was shown practicing football very hard, running, exercising, and improving his skills step by step. The scenes moved quickly, and the background music made the advertisement feel exciting and powerful. The main message of the advertisement was that success comes from hard work, discipline, and confidence. Even people who are already successful still need to practice every day. I felt quite positive about this advertisement because it was more than just promoting a product. It also gave people motivation and energy. I think using a famous athlete like Ronaldo made the message more believable, because many people admire his dedication and professional attitude. The video looked very professional and left a strong impression on me. Even though it was clearly a commercial advertisement, I still enjoyed watching it because it felt inspiring instead of boring. That is why I have a good impression of this advertisement.
audio_text: Describe an advertisement with a famous person in it You should say: Who the person is; Where you can see it; What the advertisement is about; And explain how you feel about the advertisement
label: P2-30
P3-名人出演的广告-Q1
text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of advertisements?
strategy: 利弊类问题。可以从“获取信息”和“过度消费”两个方面展开。
answer: Advertisements have both advantages and disadvantages. On the positive side, they help people learn about new products and services. Good advertisements can save people time when choosing what to buy. However, some advertisements encourage unnecessary spending. They may make products look better than they really are, especially through social media or celebrity influence. Too many ads can also feel annoying. So, advertisements are useful for sharing information, but they may also influence people to buy things they do not really need.
audio_text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of advertisements?

label: P3-名人出演的广告-Q2
text: Why are many advertisements endorsed by celebrities? How useful are they?
strategy: 原因 + 评估类问题。可以从“吸引注意力”“增加可信度”展开，同时说明效果有限。
answer: Many advertisements use celebrities because famous people attract attention easily. Fans may become interested in a product simply because their favorite actor or athlete promotes it. Celebrity advertisements can also make products seem more trustworthy or fashionable. However, they are not always effective. Some people only care about product quality and do not trust celebrity influence too much. So, celebrity endorsements are useful for attracting attention, but long-term success still depends on the product itself.
audio_text: Why are many advertisements endorsed by celebrities? How useful are they?

label: P3-名人出演的广告-Q3
text: What is the most important factor in an advertisement?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以选择“吸引注意力”或“真实性”展开，这里采用“吸引力 + 清晰信息”。
answer: I think the most important factor in an advertisement is whether it can attract people’s attention clearly and quickly. If people do not notice the advertisement, they will not remember the product. Good advertisements should also provide simple and honest information about the product. Attractive pictures or famous celebrities may help, but the message still needs to be clear and believable. So, attention and clear communication are the key factors in successful advertising.
audio_text: What is the most important factor in an advertisement?

label: P3-名人出演的广告-Q4
text: Why are some advertisements boring?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从“内容重复”“缺少创意”“与观众无关”三个方面展开。
answer: Some advertisements are boring because they repeat the same ideas again and again. When people see similar products and messages too often, they quickly lose interest. Another reason is the lack of creativity. Advertisements that are too long or only focus on selling products may not attract attention. In addition, people may find ads boring if they are not related to their needs or interests. So, repetition, weak creativity, and low relevance are common reasons why advertisements become boring.
audio_text: Why are some advertisements boring?

topic: 最近看过的电视或网络节目
text: Describe a TV show or online program you have watched recently
bullets: And explain how you feel about it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“媒体类 + 日常生活类”话题，要求你描述一个你最近看过的电视节目或网络节目。需要说清：它是什么、内容是什么、你多久看一次，以及你对它的感受。整体以现在时为主，介绍第一次观看时可用过去时。重点在于节目内容和个人感受。
这里可以选择综艺、纪录片、访谈节目或网络视频节目。思路上可以先说清节目名称和类型；然后要说清节目主要内容；接着可以重点说你观看的频率和原因；最后表达你对这个节目的看法和感受。
第一段：介绍这个节目是什么；第二段：描述节目内容以及你多久看一次；第三段：解释你对它的感受，并总结原因。

phrases: The program I want to talk about is an online travel show. 我想说的节目是一个旅行类网络节目。
I started watching it recently. 我是最近开始看的。
背景描述 It is quite popular online. 它在网上很受欢迎。
Many people recommend this program. 很多人推荐这个节目。
I usually watch it in my free time. 我通常空闲时看它。
The program introduces different cities and cultures. 这个节目介绍不同城市和文化。
It also shows local food and daily life. 它还展示当地食物和日常生活。
具体描述 The host speaks in a relaxed way. 主持人说话方式很轻松。
Each episode is around thirty minutes long. 每集大约三十分钟。
I watch it once or twice a week. 我每周看一两次。
I find the program relaxing and interesting. 我觉得这个节目轻松又有趣。
It helps me learn new things. 它让我学到很多新东西。
描述感受 The show makes me want to travel more. 这个节目让我更想旅行。
I enjoy the peaceful atmosphere in the videos. 我喜欢视频里轻松的氛围。
That is why I like watching it so much. 这就是我喜欢看它的原因。
answer: A TV show that I have watched recently is an online travel program on a video-sharing platform. I started watching it a few months ago after one of my friends recommended it to me. Since then, it has become one of my favorite programs to watch during my free time. The program is mainly about travel, culture, and daily life in different cities. In each episode, the host visits a new place and introduces local food, famous streets, and interesting traditions. What I like most is that the program does not feel rushed or overly dramatic. The host speaks in a calm and natural way, which makes the whole show feel relaxing. Most episodes are around thirty minutes long, and I usually watch the program once or twice a week, especially in the evening after work or study.
