audio_text: Do you think minority languages will disappear?

text: Describe a natural place(e.g.parks, mountains, etc.)
bullets: And explain why you like to visit it

analysis_zh.text: 本题是“地点类+自然类”话题，需要描述一个自然景点。必须包含：它在哪里、你如何知道它、它的样子、以及为什么喜欢去。重点在于自然风景特点+个人感受。时态以现在时为主，涉及第一次知道时可用过去时。
可以选择：家乡的公园、著名山脉（黄山）、湖泊（西湖）、海滩。要突出：景色（山、水、树）、氛围（安静、清新）、个人收获（放松、启发）。
第一段：介绍地点和你如何知道；第二段：描述外观、氛围、细节；第三段：解释为什么你喜欢去。

phrases: I first heard about it from my parents. 我最初从父母那里听说的。
It is a famous natural spot in my country. 它是我国著名的自然景点。
背景描述 I visited it during my summer holiday. 我在暑假去过那里。
It is located not far from my hometown. 它离我家乡不远。
I got to know it from a travel program. 我从旅游节目中知道的。
The mountains are covered with green trees. 群山被绿色的树木覆盖。
The water in the lake is very clear. 湖水非常清澈。
具体描述 There are many small paths for walking. 有很多小路可以散步。
Birds can be heard singing in the morning. 早晨能听到鸟叫。
The air is fresh and cool. 空气清新凉爽。
I feel relaxed and calm there. 我在那里感到放松和安静。
It helps me forget stress from study. 它让我忘记学习的压力。
描述感受 The natural view makes me more creative. 自然景色让我更有创造力。
I feel close to nature whenever I visit. 每次去都觉得贴近自然。
It is one of my favorite places to spend time. 它是我最喜欢待的地方之一。
answer: A natural place I really like is West Lake, which is located in Hangzhou, a beautiful city in eastern China. I first learned about it from my parents, because they told me many stories and poems about this lake when I was a child. Later, I got the chance to visit it during a family trip, and it became one of my favorite places. West Lake is famous for its clear water, green mountains, and many small bridges. The lake is surrounded by trees and flowers, and in spring, everything looks colorful and alive. There are paths for walking and cycling, so visitors can enjoy the view slowly. On the water, there are small boats, and people can take a ride to see the scenery from another angle. In the morning, the air is fresh, and you can hear birds singing. At night, the lights from the city reflect on the lake, making it peaceful and romantic. I like West Lake because it makes me feel relaxed and calm. When I sit by the lake, I can forget stress from study and enjoy the beauty of nature. It also reminds me of Chinese culture, because many old poems and paintings were inspired by it. For me, West Lake is not just a tourist place but also a source of inspiration and comfort. I hope I can visit it again in the future.
audio_text: Describe a natural place(e.g.parks, mountains, etc.) You should say: Where this place is; How you knew this place; What it is like; And explain why you like to visit it
label: P2-47
P3-自然之地-Q1
text: What kind of people like to visit natural places?
strategy: 事件说明类问题。可以从性格（喜欢安静、热爱冒险）、兴趣（摄影、运动、环保）等角度说明。
answer: People who enjoy peace and quiet often like to visit natural places. Nature lovers, hikers, and people who enjoy fresh air also choose them. Some visit natural places to escape stress from city life, while others go for exercise or photography. Families also like them for relaxing and spending time together. So, both adventure seekers and people who want calm enjoy natural areas.
audio_text: What kind of people like to visit natural places?

label: P3-自然之地-Q2
text: What are the differences between a natural place and a city?
strategy: 比较类问题。可以从环境、生活节奏、空气质量、设施等角度说明自然环境与城市的不同。
answer: Natural places are quiet, clean, and full of green plants, rivers, or mountains. They give people fresh air and a slow pace of life. Cities are crowded, noisy, and full of buildings, cars, and shops. Life in cities is fast, with more jobs and services. The main difference is that natural places offer peace, while cities provide opportunities and convenience.
audio_text: What are the differences between a natural place and a city?

label: P3-自然之地-Q3
text: Do you think that going to the park is the only way to get close to nature?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从“公园是常见方式”入手，再指出自然体验还可以通过乡村、山林、海边等方式实现。
answer: No, going to the park is not the only way to get close to nature. Parks are easy to visit in cities, but people can also go to the countryside, forests, or beaches. Gardening at home or walking near rivers is another way to enjoy nature. Even watching birds or planting trees helps people feel close to it. So, there are many ways to connect with nature, not just parks.
audio_text: Do you think that going to the park is the only way to get close to nature?

label: P3-自然之地-Q4
text: What can people gain from going to natural places?
strategy: 事件影响类问题。可以从放松心情、改善健康、学习自然知识、增进家庭关系等方面说明人们去自然环境的收获。
answer: People can gain many things from going to natural places. They feel relaxed and forget daily stress when they see green trees and fresh air. It is also good for health, because walking or hiking in nature is good exercise. People can learn more about plants, animals, and the environment. Spending time in natural places also makes families and friends closer.
audio_text: What can people gain from going to natural places?

text: Describe a city that you have been to and would like to visit again
bullets: And explain why you would like to visit it again

analysis_zh.text: 这是“地点+个人经历类”话题，要求你描述一个你去过并想再次访问的城市。题目重点是“have been to”和 “would like to visit again”，所以你需要描述一次过去的旅行经历，并突出这个城市让你想再次造访的理由。时态以过去时为主，表达愿望时用现在或将来时。
你可以选择国内或国外的城市，例如北京、上海、东京、新加坡、巴黎等。可以讲述旅行的时间、做过的事情（如参观名胜、吃美食、拍照、逛街），城市的特点（热闹、美丽、安静、友好等），最后说明你想再去的原因，如还有没看完的景点、很喜欢那里的氛围、美食或朋友等。
第一段说明你去过哪个城市，是什么时候去的；第二段描述你在那里的活动和城市的特点；第三段表达你为什么想再次去这个城市，包括情感和实际原因

phrases: I visited this city two years ago during a school holiday. 我是在两年前学校放假时去的这个城市。
It was my first time travelling to a big city. 那是我第一次去大城市旅行。
背景描述： My family took me there for a short trip. 我家人带我去那边短途旅行。
We stayed there for three days. 我们在那里待了三天。
It was a popular tourist city with many famous places. 那是一个有很多著名景点的旅游城市。
We visited museums, parks, and historical buildings. 我们参观了博物馆、公园和历史建筑。
The food was amazing, especially the local snacks. 那里的食物特别棒，尤其是当地的小吃。
具体描述： The people there were very kind and friendly. 那里的人非常善良和友好。
The streets were clean and the city felt very safe. 街道很干净，城市也很安全。
I took lots of photos and bought some gifts. 我拍了很多照片，还买了些礼物。
I had a great time there and didn't want to leave. 我在那里过得很开心，不想离开。
I didn't have enough time to see everything. 我没有足够的时间看完所有地方。
描述感受： I still remember the beautiful views and the nice weather. 我还记得那里的美景和好天气。
I hope I can go back and explore more next time. 我希望下次能再去，多看看别的地方。
It's one of my favourite cities and I really miss it. 那是我最喜欢的城市之一，我真的很想它。
answer: A city I have been to and would like to visit again is Hangzhou. I visited it with my parents three years ago during the spring holiday. It was just a short trip, but the experience left a deep impression on me, and I still think about it from time to time. During our stay, we went to the famous West Lake, which is probably the most well-known attraction in the city. We took a boat ride on the lake and also walked along the paths by the water. The scenery was beautiful, with willow trees gently moving in the wind, flowers blooming, and small bridges crossing the calm lake. Everything looked like a traditional Chinese painting. We also explored some old streets nearby, where we tried local snacks such as sweet rice balls and hand-pulled noodles. The food was not only delicious but also different from what I usually eat in my city. What I really liked about Hangzhou was the peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. The people were friendly, the streets were clean, and the weather was cool and fresh. The city also has a long history and rich culture, which made it even more interesting. Unfortunately, we only stayed there for two days, so we didn't have enough time to visit all the places I wanted to see. That's why I would really love to go back again—explore more scenic spots, enjoy the tasty food again, and simply take in the calm and beauty of the city. Hangzhou is definitely one of my favorite cities in China.
audio_text: Describe a city that you have been to and would like to visit again You should say: When you visited it; What you did there; What it was like; And explain why you would like to visit it again
label: P2-48
P3-想再去一次的城市-Q1
text: What's the difference between the city and the countryside?
strategy: 评估和比较类问题。可以从生活节奏、环境、交通、工作机会等方面比较城市和乡村的不同。
answer: The city is busy, with more people, tall buildings, and many shops. Life is fast, and there are more jobs. The countryside is quiet, with fresh air, green fields, and fewer people. Life there is slower and more peaceful.
audio_text: What's the difference between the city and the countryside?

label: P3-想再去一次的城市-Q2
text: Some people say large cities are suitable for old people. What do you think?
strategy: 观点考察题。可以从医疗资源、交通便利和生活服务方面说明城市的优点，同时简要提及城市生活节奏的挑战
answer: Large cities have good hospitals, transport, and shops, which help old people. But city life is fast and noisy, which may not be good for everyone. Some old people prefer quiet places. It depends on their needs and health.
audio_text: Some people say large cities are suitable for old people. What do you think?

label: P3-想再去一次的城市-Q3
text: Do you think it is possible that all of the population move to cities?
strategy: 这是观点考察题。可以从资源、生活质量、就业机会、自然环境等方面判断人口是否可能完全转向城市生活，并说明其中的限制因素。
answer: I don't think everyone will move to cities. Some people enjoy living in the countryside. It is quiet, clean, and more relaxing. Also, if too many people live in cities, there may not be enough space, jobs, or houses. Some people work on farms or with animals, and they need to stay in rural areas. So, cities will grow, but not everyone will move there.
audio_text: Do you think it is possible that all of the population move to cities?

label: P3-想再去一次的城市-Q4
text: Do you think people in the countryside are friendlier than people in the city?
strategy: 这是对比类问题。可以从生活节奏、社区大小、人际距离等方面分析乡村人是否更友好，也可以指出城市中友好人的存在。
answer: Yes, I think people in the countryside are often friendlier. Life is slower, and people know their neighbors. They like to talk and help each other. In the city, people are busy and don't have time to stop and chat. But some city people are also kind. It depends on the place and the person.
audio_text: Do you think people in the countryside are friendlier than people in the city?

text: Describe a shop/store you enjoy visiting
bullets: And explain why you like to visit it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“地点+情感类”话题，要求你描述一家你喜欢逛的商店。你需要说明这家商店的名称、位置、你多久去一次，以及为什么喜欢去那儿。这道题的核心在于“enjoy visiting”，所以不仅要描述商店的基本情况，更要着重表达你去这家店的体验感和情感价值。主要使用一般现在时，描述初次印象或第一次去时可以用过去时。
你可以选择的商店包括：书店、咖啡馆、文具店、服装店、手工艺品店、电子产品店、特色超市等。重点可以围绕商品的种类、服务体验、环境氛围或你和这家店之间的特别联系来展开。你也可以补充一些具体的细节，比如特别喜欢的一个角落、工作人员的热情、商店的设计风格等。
第一段介绍这家店的名称和地点，以及你去的频率。第二段描述商店的特色或布局，以及你通常在那儿做什么。第三段说明你为什么喜欢它，包括感受、回忆或你从中获得的满足感

phrases: There's a small bookstore near my school that I love visiting. 我很喜欢去我们学校附近的一家小书
店。
The shop is located in a quiet street not far from my home. 这家店在我家附近的一条安静街道上。
背景描述： I discovered the store a year ago when I was exploring the neighborhood. 我是一年前闲逛时偶然发
现这家店的。
I usually drop by once or twice a week. 我通常每周会去一到两次。
It has become part of my weekend routine. 它已经成了我周末生活的一部分。
The shop is small but well-organized. 商店虽然不大，但布置得很整洁。
It sells a wide variety of books, from fiction to self-help. 它出售各种类型的书，从小说到自我提升类
的都有。
具体描述：
The background music and lighting make it feel relaxing. 背景音乐和灯光让人感到非常放松。
I usually spend time browsing and reading quietly. 我通常会在那里静静地翻书阅读。
The staff are friendly and often give good recommendations. 店员很友好，经常会推荐好书。
I enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and the smell of books. 我喜欢那里的宁静氛围和书香气。
It's a great place to escape from stress. 那是一个让我远离压力的好地方。
描述感受： I always leave the store feeling calm and inspired. 每次离开这家店我都感到平静又受启发。
It reminds me of why I love reading. 它让我再次确认我为何热爱阅读。
Visiting this store has become a small joy in my life. 逛这家店已经成了我生活中的一个小确幸。
answer: Tucked away on a quiet side street near my school is a charming little bookstore called Leaf & Letter, and it has become one of my favorite places to visit. I usually go there about once a week, mostly on weekends when I have some time to relax and slow down. The shop isn't very large, but it's beautifully arranged. Books are stacked neatly on warm wooden shelves that reach all the way up to the ceiling. There's a cozy reading corner with two soft armchairs, a small round table, and a lamp that gives off a gentle golden light. They also play calm background music—usually soft jazz or piano—which makes the whole space feel incredibly peaceful. Near the counter, there's a small area where they serve simple coffee and tea, so I often grab a drink while flipping through a book. What makes this store so special to me is the atmosphere. It doesn't feel like a commercial place at all. It feels more like a quiet retreat from the noisy outside world. The staff are friendly and often recommend books based on what I've liked before. Sometimes they even set aside new arrivals they think I might enjoy. Whether I buy anything or not, I always leave feeling calmer and more refreshed. It's more than just a store— it's a space that helps me reconnect with myself, take a breath, and remember how much I love reading and quiet moments.
audio_text: Describe a shop/store you enjoy visiting You should say: What the shop's name is; Where it is; How often you visit it; And explain why you like to visit it
label: P2-49
P3-商店-Q1
text: Do people in your country go to the shopping mall frequently?
strategy: 观点考察题。可以从购物、休闲、聚会等角度说明人们常去商场的原因。
answer: Yes, many people go to shopping malls often. They shop, eat, watch movies, or meet friends. Malls are clean, cool, and have many things in one place, so they are very popular.
audio_text: Do people in your country go to the shopping mall frequently?

label: P3-商店-Q2
text: How have people's shopping habits changed in recent decades?
strategy: 对比过去与现在类问题。可从购物方式、频率和商品选择等方面对比说明。
answer: People now shop more online than before. In the past, they went to stores. Now they use apps and websites. It's faster and more convenient. People also compare prices and read reviews before buying things.
audio_text: How have people's shopping habits changed in recent decades?

label: P3-商店-Q3
text: Do you think shops and shopping malls will disappear in the future?
strategy: 这是观点考察题。可以围绕网购的流行、技术发展、以及人们对购物体验的需求展开。回答时要说明为什么一些人可能不再去商场，同时也要解释为什么一些实体店可能还会存在。
answer: I don't think shops and malls will fully disappear. Many people like shopping online because it is fast and easy. You can buy things at home, and they come to your door. But some people still enjoy going to malls. They want to see and touch the things before buying. Also, they like spending time with family or friends at the mall. So, maybe there will be fewer shops in the future, but they will not all disappear. Some will stay open for people who want a real shopping experience.
audio_text: Do you think shops and shopping malls will disappear in the future?

label: P3-商店-Q4
text: What are the differences between shopping in street markets and in big shopping malls?
strategy: 这是评估和比较类问题。可以从价格、购物体验、商品种类、环境和服务等方面对比街边市场和大型商场的不同之处，并说明各自的优缺点。
answer: Street markets are usually cheaper. You can find fresh food and local things. It's open-air, and sometimes you can talk with the sellers. But malls are big and clean. They have many shops and good service. You can buy clothes, shoes, and eat in a restaurant in one place. Malls are better when the weather is bad. So both are good, but in different ways.
audio_text: What are the differences between shopping in street markets and in big shopping malls?

text: Describe a quiet place you like to go
bullets: And explain how you feel about the place
phrases: be tucked away 藏匿在某处
a secluded area 隐匿的区域
背景描述:
kick back and relax 放松
what impresses me most is that 让我映像深刻的是
a social networking website 社交网站
描述如何了 a local internet influencer 当地网红
解&频率 get a discount on tickets 票价打折
different types of flowers flourish 不同的花盛开
I was actually shocked by 背惊讶到
the diversity of botanical collection 植物的多样性
描述个人感
beyond my expectation 超越期待
受
completely splendid 绚烂的
the spectacular and artistic gardening 壮观的，有艺术感的园艺
answer: I'd like to talk about a botanic garden I've been to before, it is really beautiful, iridescent and of course tranquil. And this garden is tucked away in a secluded area which is in the eastern part of the city. Since it is a botanic garden, I mainly go there to appreciate different plants, hang out with my friend, and simply just kick back and relax. By the way, What impresses me most is that there are serval tropical nursery houses which accommodate more than 500 living different plants, from a rainforest on the wall to an entire room of cacti. And these houses are across 10 climatic zones, giving each glass room a whole different environment. Moving on to the second question, which is how I knew it, I first got to know this place on a social networking website, and it was highly recommended by a local internet influencer. In his video, he elaborated the features of this place and also gave a few tips, like when was the best time to visit, how to get a discount on tickets and things like that. Speaking of how often I go there, generally, I guess twice a year, one in spring, one in fall, simple because different types of flowers flourish in different seasons, like cherry flowers only bloom in spring. There are several reasons why I was deeply impressed. First of all, I was actually shocked by the diversity of botanical collection there, ranging from the oldest collection of Orchids to the most endangered and threatened species. Anyway, it was way beyond my expectation. Apart from that, it was the spectacular and artistic gardening that made me remember it very well. As soon as I got into the gate, the splendid and colorful flowers immediately grabbed my attention, like, purple tulips, pink carnations, bright yellow sunflowers and stuff like that. So it was completely splendid and of course a perfect to relax.
audio_text: Describe a quiet place you like to go You should say: Where it is; How you knew it; How often you go there; What you do there; And explain how you feel about the place
label: P2-50
P3-安静的地方-Q1
text: Is it easy to find quiet places in your country? Why?
strategy: 这是一个 PART 2 当同意与否类型的问题，我们如果想把答案变得更加的详尽，我们可以采取分情况讨论的策略。例如，可以说在大城市中，是不是很容易找到安静的地方？如过不容易的找到的话，原因可能是什么。在小城市中是不是容易找到安静的地方？如果容易找到，这些地方通常是什么地方。在回答这样的问题时，除了要给出原因，还需要把 places 这个上义词，替换成不同的下义词。
answer: Well, it really depends. In those very-well developed megacities, I wouldn't say it's very easy to find quiet and relaxing places in, as metropolitans tend to build office buildings and entertainment facilities, you know, like shopping centers which are not quiet at all, instead, they sometimes cause noise pollution. However, in small cities or rural areas which haven't been spoiled by noise pollution, cars, and those annoying machines, people can easily find a tranquil place and relax, like places in mountains, beside lakes and things like that.
audio_text: Is it easy to find quiet places in your country? Why?

label: P3-安静的地方-Q2
text: Why do old people prefer to live in quiet places?
strategy: 这是一道典型的原因类型的题目，一开始我们可以先总述，然后在分条论述。第一，我们可以说老年人由于经历丰富，他们的去过太多热闹的地方，体验过太多经历，所以现在想居住在安静的地方。第二，我们可以从以外一个维度去说原因，他们厌倦了城市的快节奏，以及给出对应的具体表达方式。所以想体验不同的生活方式。
answer: There are mainly two reasons. One reason is that old people have had enough experiences, I mean, they have been to lively and vibrant places before so they must have known what things were like there. For them, quietness is probably something they desire because it helps them empty their mind and get completely relaxed. Another reason is that they get tired of the fast pace in a metropolis, like crowds of people in train stations and traffic congestions where people tend to honk horns, consequently, they might like to settle down in rural and quiet areas where they can experience a totally different lifestyle.
audio_text: Why do old people prefer to live in quiet places?

label: P3-安静的地方-Q3
text: Why are there more noises made at home now than in the past?
strategy: 这是一道原因类型的题目，拿到题目之后，可以发现这道题目涉及到了现在和过去，也就就是说需要我们去对比。这道题目的关键点在于家里的噪音为什么会比过去多，第一个能想到就是因为家电的使用比原来多，然后举例说明。在一个就是人们的生活方式也有变化，尤其是人们更喜欢开派对，听快节奏的音乐等等。在给完原因之后，一定要有例子去支撑自己的论点，这样答案才显得详尽。
answer: Well, the living standard has been boosted by leaps and bounds, so compared with the past, a significantly larger number of houses can afford household appliances like TVs, washing machines, computers, which might cause too much noise. What's more, people's lifestyle has also changed dramatically, especially an increasing number of teenagers tend to throw crazy parties at home, so they would play upbeat music like rap and rock in a high volume, this is also a reason for this phenomenon.
audio_text: Why are there more noises made at home now than in the past?

label: P3-安静的地方-Q4
text: How does technology affect the way people spend their leisure time?
strategy: 这道题属于事件的原因和影响类问题。回答时可以分析科技如何改变人们的休闲方式，比如提供更多娱乐选择、提高便利性或减少户外活动。
answer: Technology has changed the way people spend their leisure time by providing more entertainment options. People can watch movies, play video games, or use social media anytime. Online learning also allows them to explore new skills from home. However, technology has also reduced face-to-face social interactions and outdoor activities.
audio_text: How does technology affect the way people spend their leisure time?

text: Describe a wild animal that you want to learn more about
bullets: When or where you saw it
Why you want to learn more about it
And explain what you want to learn more about it

analysis_zh.text: 这是一道“动物类”话题，要求描述一种你想更多了解的野生动物。必须涵盖：它是什么、你什么时候看到的、在哪里看到的、以及你为什么想更多了解它。时态以过去时描述看到的经历，以现在时/将来时描述你的想法和理由。
可以选择常见的野生动物（如熊猫、老虎、狮子、大象、鹰等），或稍微特别的动物（考拉、企鹅、海豚、长颈鹿等）。描述时可以提到：你第一次在哪里看到（动物园、自然保护区、电视纪录片、旅行时），它的外形特征和习性，以及你为什么想进一步了解它（外表特别、生活习性神秘、濒危状态、象征意义等）。
第一段：介绍动物是什么、你什么时候看到的；第二段：讲述你为什么想要多了解它；第三段：解释你想要了解关于它的什么方面。

phrases: I first saw it in a wildlife park. 我第一次在野生动物园看到它。
I watched it in a nature documentary. 我在一部自然纪录片里看到的。
背景描述 It's a famous wild animal in my country. 它是我国著名的野生动物。
My friend showed me pictures of it. 朋友给我看过它的照片。
It caught my attention immediately. 它立刻吸引了我的注意。
It has black and white fur and looks very cute. 它有黑白相间的毛，看起来很可爱。
It moves slowly but eats a lot every day. 它动作缓慢，但每天吃很多。
具体描述 It lives in forests and needs a lot of bamboo. 它生活在森林里，需要很多竹子。
I saw it sitting quietly and eating. 我看到它静静地坐着吃东西。
It looked very different from other animals. 它看起来和其他动物很不一样。
I want to know more about its life and habits. 我想更多地了解它的生活和习性。
It makes me think about protecting wild animals. 它让我想到要保护野生动物。
描述感受 I feel curious about how it survives in the wild. 我很好奇它是如何在野外生存的。
I believe learning about it can teach us about nature. 我相信了解它能让我们学习自然。
It's not only cute but also very meaningful to study. 它不仅可爱，而且很有研究价值
answer: The wild animal I want to know more about is the giant panda. I first saw it when I visited a zoo in my city about three years ago. Before that, I had only seen pandas in books and on TV, but seeing them in real life was very exciting for me. The pandas were sitting under the trees and eating bamboo. They looked very calm and peaceful, and their black and white fur made them stand out from other animals. I stayed there for almost half an hour, just watching them. Sometimes they moved slowly, and sometimes they rolled on the ground like playful children. Many visitors were taking photos because pandas are really cute and special. I want to know more about pandas because they are not only the national treasure of China but also an endangered species. I feel curious about how they live in the wild, how they find food, and how scientists protect them. I also want to learn how bamboo forests are important for their survival. For me, pandas are more than just lovely animals—they remind us of the need to protect nature. That is why I hope to learn more about them in the future.
audio_text: Describe a wild animal that you want to learn more about You should say: What it is; When or where you saw it; Why you want to learn more about it; And explain what you want to learn more about it
label: P2-51
P3-想多了解的野生动物-Q1
text: Why should we protect wild animals?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从生态平衡（物种间的相互依赖）、科研价值（潜在的药物与基因研究）、以及道德义务（人类活动造成的破坏及其修复责任）等角度来说明保护野生动物的必要性。
answer: I believe wildlife conservation is paramount for two main reasons. First is the ecological equilibrium. Every species is an integral part of a complex biosphere; for instance, the loss of a keystone species can trigger a trophic cascade, destabilizing the entire ecosystem we rely on. Second, we have an ethical imperative. As most species depletion is driven by anthropogenic factors like habitat destruction, we have a moral obligation to act as stewards of nature. Furthermore, biodiversity holds untapped potential for scientific and medicinal breakthroughs. Protecting animals is, therefore, not just an act of compassion, but a necessity for our planet's long-term viability.
audio_text: Why should we protect wild animals?

label: P3-想多了解的野生动物-Q2
text: Why are some people more willing to protect wild animals than others?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从教育程度、个人兴趣、环保意识、情感联系等角度说明为什么有些人更愿意保护野生动物
answer: Some people are more willing to protect wild animals because they know more about nature. They may study it in school or see programs on TV. Others have a strong love for animals and feel connected to them. Some people don't think much about animals because they are busy with daily life. So, the difference comes from knowledge, feelings, and personal values.
audio_text: Why are some people more willing to protect wild animals than others?

label: P3-想多了解的野生动物-Q3
text: Do you think it's important to take children to the zoo to see animals?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从教育意义、亲身体验、兴趣培养和动物保护意识等角度说明带孩子去动物园的重要性，同时也可以提到局限，如动物自由受限。
answer: Yes, I think it is important to take children to the zoo. In the zoo, children can see real animals that they only read about in books or watch on TV. This gives them a deeper understanding and makes learning more exciting. Zoos also teach children about protecting wildlife and respecting nature. By seeing animals closely, kids may develop love and care for them. Of course, it is also good to combine zoo visits with videos and books, so children can learn in many ways.
audio_text: Do you think it's important to take children to the zoo to see animals?

label: P3-想多了解的野生动物-Q4
text: Why do some people attach more importance to protecting rare animals?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从生态平衡、科学研究、文化价值和责任感等角度说明人们重视保护珍稀动物的原因。
answer: People care more about protecting rare animals because they are very important for nature. If rare animals disappear, the balance of the environment may be broken. Rare animals also have scientific value, as studying them helps people understand life better. Many rare animals are symbols of culture or national pride. So, people feel a duty to protect them for future generations.
audio_text: Why do some people attach more importance to protecting rare animals?

text: Describe an important old thing that your family has kept for a long time
bullets: How or when your family first got this thing
How long your family has kept it
And explain why this thing is important to your family

analysis_zh.text: 这是“物品类+家庭情感类”题目，要求描述一件你家保留了很久的重要物品。需要涵盖：它是什么、家里什么时候或如何得到它、保存了多久、为什么重要。时态以过去时描述起源，以现在时总结意义。
物品可以是：老照片、古董家具、手表、书籍、书信、结婚戒指、传家玉佩等。要突出它的历史和家庭情感价值，而不是金钱价值。结尾可以强调“它让我们记住家族历史/传递感情/象征团结”。
第一段：介绍物品是什么、起源；第二段：描述它的外观、使用方式、家人保存它的细节；第三段：说明它对家庭的重要性，以及你自己的感受。

phrases: It is an old photo album from my grandparents. 它是我祖父母留下的老相册。
My family first got it many years ago. 我家很多年前得到它。
背景描述 It has been in our family for decades. 它在我们家已经保存了几十年。
The item was passed down from my grandfather. 这件物品是我爷爷传下来的。
We have always kept it in a safe place. 我们一直把它保存在安全的地方
The watch looks old but still works. 这块手表看起来很旧但还能用。
The photo album is full of black-and-white pictures. 相册里全是黑白照片。
具体描述 The furniture is simple but very strong. 这件家具很朴素但很结实。
It carries a lot of memories of the past. 它承载了很多过去的回忆。
My parents often tell me stories about it. 我父母常给我讲它的故事。
It makes me feel connected to my family history. 它让我觉得与家族历史紧密相连。
I feel proud that we have kept it for so long. 我为我们保存了它这么久而自豪。
描述感受 It reminds me of love and respect in the family. 它让我想起家里的爱与尊重。
I believe it is more valuable than money. 我相信它比金钱更有价值。
It is a symbol of our family spirit. 它是我们家族精神的象征。
answer: The important old thing my family has kept for a long time is an old photo album that once belonged to my grandparents. My family first got it many years ago, before I was even born. It has been passed down from my grandfather to my father, and now it is carefully kept in our living room cabinet. The album is thick and heavy, with a dark brown leather cover. Inside, there are many black-and-white photos of my grandparents when they were young, as well as pictures of my father and his brothers during their childhood. Some of the photos are already fading, but we still look at them from time to time. Whenever we open the album, my parents tell me stories about our family history—how they lived in the countryside, what kind of games they played, and even how they celebrated festivals in the past. This photo album is important because it keeps the memories of our family alive. It reminds us of the love, struggles, and happiness of the older generations. For me, it is not just a collection of pictures but also a bridge that connects me to my family's past. I feel proud that we have protected it for so many years, and I believe it is more valuable than anything we could buy with money. It is truly a symbol of our family spirit and traditions.
audio_text: Describe an important old thing that your family has kept for a long time You should say: What it is; How or when your family first got this thing; How long your family has kept it; And explain why this thing is important to your family
label: P2-52
P3-家中重要老物件-Q1
text: What kind of old things do people in your country like to keep?
strategy: 说明类问题。可以从个人纪念物（照片、信件）、家庭传承（首饰、家具）、文化物品（书籍、古董）等角度展开，强调情感价值和文化意义。
answer: In my country, people like to keep many kinds of old things. Families often keep photos, letters, or diaries because they bring back memories of the past. Some people also keep old furniture, coins, or clothes from parents and grandparents. Jewelry or small gifts are also passed down as family treasures. Books and antiques are kept by people who love history and culture. These old things are not just objects but symbols of family ties and tradition. So, people keep them mainly for memory, respect, and cultural value.
audio_text: What kind of old things do people in your country like to keep?

label: P3-家中重要老物件-Q2
text: Why do people keep old things?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从情感纪念、收藏价值、家族传承等角度说明人们为什么喜欢保留旧物。
answer: People keep old things because they carry memories. For example, photos, letters, or toys remind them of family and childhood. Some old things also have value, like coins, books, or jewelry. Families often keep heirlooms to pass to the next generation. Old objects are not just things; they connect people with their past and give them a sense of identity.
audio_text: Why do people keep old things?

label: P3-家中重要老物件-Q3
text: What are the differences between the things old people keep and those young people keep?
strategy: 比较类问题。可以从纪念价值、实用性、科技产品等角度说明老年人和年轻人保存物品的差异。
answer: Old people usually keep things with memories, like letters, photos, or gifts from family. These objects remind them of their past. Young people often keep modern items, like phones, game consoles, or fashion products. They like things that are useful now. The difference is that older people focus on memories, while young people focus on daily use and trends.
audio_text: What are the differences between the things old people keep and those young people keep?

label: P3-家中重要老物件-Q4
text: What are the differences between the things that people keep today and the things that people kept in the past?
strategy: 比较类问题。可以从保存物品的类型（数码 vs 实物）、价值观差异等方面说明。
answer: In the past, people kept letters, photos, and handmade objects. These items carried strong memories and family value. Today, people often keep digital things, like photos on phones or videos online. They also keep modern products like electronics. The difference is that old things were mostly physical, while modern things are often digital and practical.
audio_text: What are the differences between the things that people keep today and the things that people kept in the past?

text: Describe a toy you liked in your childhood
bullets: What kind of toy it is
And how you felt about it

analysis_zh.text: 这是“物品类+童年回忆类”话题，要求描述你童年时喜欢的玩具。需要包括：它是什么、你什么时候得到的、怎么玩的、以及你的感受。时态主要用过去时，最后总结时用现在时。
你可以选择：毛绒熊、玩具车、洋娃娃、乐高积木、木制拼图。要写清楚：谁送给你的、你怎么玩、为什么喜欢它。最后强调它给童年的快乐和现在的意义。
第一段：介绍玩具是什么、什么时候收到的；第二段：描述怎么玩的细节；第三段：表达感受和它对你的意义。

phrases: I got it as a birthday gift from my parents. 我在生日时从父母那里得到的。
It was a small but special toy car. 它是一辆小巧但特别的玩具车。
背景描述 My aunt gave it to me when I was five years old. 我五岁时姑妈送给我的。
It was the most precious toy in my childhood. 它是我童年最珍贵的玩具。
I kept it for many years. 我保存了很多年。
I played with it almost every day. 我几乎每天都玩它。
Sometimes I played alone, sometimes with friends. 有时我一个人玩，有时和朋友一起玩。
具体描述 I made up stories while playing with it. 我在玩的时候编故事。
The toy was simple but gave me a lot of fun. 这个玩具很简单，但给我很多乐趣。
I even took it to bed when I was little. 我小时候甚至睡觉也带着它。
I felt very happy and safe with it. 它让我觉得很开心和安心。
It was more than a toy; it was a friend. 它不只是玩具，也是朋友。
描述感受 It gave me a lot of sweet childhood memories. 它给了我很多美好的童年回忆。
Even now, I feel warm when I think of it. 直到现在，想到它我仍觉得温暖。
It reminds me of the love from my family. 它让我想起家人的爱。
answer: When I think about my childhood, the toy I liked the most was a teddy bear. I got it as a birthday gift from my parents when I was about six years old. It was light brown, very soft, and had a red ribbon around its neck. At that time, it was the most precious thing I had. I played with the teddy bear almost every day. Sometimes I pretended it was my classmate and talked to it as if we were in school. Other times, I carried it around the house, and it became my little “travel partner.” At night, I even took it to bed, because hugging it made me feel safe and warm. When friends came over, we played together and used the bear as part of our games. Even though it was just a simple toy, I created many stories and adventures with it, which made my childhood more colorful. This toy was very important to me because it gave me comfort and happiness. I felt like it was not just a toy but also a friend who listened to me. Looking back, I realize that it also symbolized the love of my parents, because they chose it carefully for me. Even now, when I think of that teddy bear, I feel warm inside, and it always reminds me of the sweet and simple moments of my childhood.
audio_text: Describe a toy you liked in your childhood You should say: What kind of toy it is; When you received it; How you played it; And how you felt about it
label: P2-53
P3-童年喜欢的玩具-Q1
text: How do advertisements influence children?
strategy: 事件影响类问题。可以从购物欲望、价值观、模仿行为等方面说明广告对孩子的影响。
answer: Advertisements influence children by making them want new toys, clothes, or snacks. The bright colors and fun music catch their attention. Some ads show famous people or cartoon characters, and children want to copy them. This can make children ask parents to buy things they don't really need. Ads can also shape their ideas about what is cool or popular.
audio_text: How do advertisements influence children?

label: P3-童年喜欢的玩具-Q2
text: Should advertising aimed at kids be prohibited?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从广告对孩子消费观念、价值观的影响以及家庭经济压力等方面分析是否应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
answer: Yes, I think advertising aimed at kids should be limited. Children are too young to understand the purpose of ads, so they may ask parents to buy things they don't need. Bright colors and cartoons can make kids believe everything is good. This can lead to bad habits and family stress. Protecting children from ads helps them grow with healthier ideas and choices.
audio_text: Should advertising aimed at kids be prohibited?

label: P3-童年喜欢的玩具-Q3
text: What's the difference between the toys kids play now and those they played in the past?
strategy: 比较类问题。可以从科技含量、娱乐方式、教育意义等角度说明现在和过去玩具的不同。
answer: Toys in the past were simple, like dolls, balls, or wooden cars. They didn't need electricity or the internet. Today, many toys are electronic, with lights, sounds, or even apps. Children also play more with digital games. The main difference is that old toys were about imagination, while modern toys often use technology to attract kids.
audio_text: What's the difference between the toys kids play now and those they played in the past?

label: P3-童年喜欢的玩具-Q4
text: Do you think parents should buy more toys for their kids or spend more time with them?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从物质和陪伴的不同价值出发，强调陪伴的重要性。
answer: I think spending time is more important than buying toys. Toys can make children happy for a while, but they don't replace real care. When parents play, read, or talk with children, it builds strong bonds and teaches values. So, time and love are more valuable than just giving toys.
audio_text: Do you think parents should buy more toys for their kids or spend more time with them?

text: Describe a book you read that you found useful
bullets: Why you think it is useful
And explain how you felt about it

analysis_zh.text: 本题属于“物品类+书籍类”话题，要求描述一本对你有用的书。必须涵盖：书的名字、你什么时候读的、为什么有用、你的感受。这里的“有用”可以是学习上的、生活上的、性格上的帮助。
可以选择一本学习类或励志类书籍，比如：英语学习书籍、时间管理类、励志传记、科普读物。重点要结合实用性和个人收获，说明它对你的学习或生活的积极影响。
第一段：介绍书的名字、什么时候读的；第二段：说明书的主要内容、你学到的有用之处；第三段：讲述你的感受以及为什么推荐。

phrases: I read this book when I was in high school. 我在高中时读过这本书。
It was recommended by my teacher. 它是老师推荐的。
背景描述 I borrowed it from the library. 我从图书馆借的。
I came across it in a bookstore. 我在书店里偶然看到的。
I finished it during my holiday. 我在假期里读完的。
The book is about how to manage time well. 这本书是关于如何管理时间的。
It gives many useful study methods. 它提供了很多有用的学习方法。
具体描述 The author shared his own life experience. 作者分享了自己的生活经历。
It helped me to improve my English skills. 它帮助我提高了英语技能。
I learned how to make good plans and follow them. 我学会了如何制定计划并坚持执行。
I found it very practical and inspiring. 我觉得它既实用又鼓舞人心。
It changed the way I study and live. 它改变了我的学习和生活方式。
描述感受 I felt more confident after reading it. 读完后我更有自信了。
It encouraged me to keep trying even when I failed. 它鼓励我即使失败也要继续努力。
This book is still meaningful to me today. 这本书对我今天仍然有意义
answer: A book I read that I found very useful is The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People by Stephen Covey. I first read it about three years ago when I was in high school. At that time, I felt stressed because I had too much homework and didn't know how to manage my time well. My English teacher recommended this book to me, and I borrowed it from the library. The book talks about seven habits that can help people become more organized and successful in both study and life. For example, it teaches us to “begin with the end in mind,” which means to set clear goals before doing anything. It also explains the importance of putting first things first, which helped me learn how to focus on my homework before playing games. I even wrote down some of the tips and tried to use them in my daily routine. Slowly, I noticed I was more productive and less stressed. I think this book is very useful because it gave me practical tools to improve myself. It is not just theory but also full of real examples. Reading it made me more confident and motivated. Even today, I still remember some of the advice and try to follow it. I believe it will continue to help me in my future studies and career, and that's why I consider it one of the most valuable books I have ever read.
audio_text: Describe a book you read that you found useful You should say: What it is; When you read it; Why you think it is useful; And explain how you felt about it
label: P2-54
P3-有用的书-Q1
text: What are the types of books that young people like to read?
strategy: 事件说明类问题。可以从小说、漫画、网络文学、励志类书籍等方面说明年轻人喜欢的书籍类型。
answer: Young people like to read different types of books. Many enjoy novels, especially adventure or romance stories. Some prefer comic books or online stories because they are short and easy to read. Others like books that give advice or inspire them. The choice depends on their age, hobbies, and what they want to learn.
audio_text: What are the types of books that young people like to read?

label: P3-有用的书-Q2
text: What should the government do to make libraries better?
strategy: 解决措施类问题。可以从增加书籍和电子资源、改善环境设施、提供活动和课程、推广阅读习惯等方面说明政府如何提升图书馆。
answer: The government can make libraries better by adding more books and modern e-resources. Free internet and digital tools also make libraries more useful. They can improve facilities, like comfortable seats and quiet study rooms. Organizing reading events or classes can attract more visitors. So, with better resources and activities, libraries can serve more people in the community.
audio_text: What should the government do to make libraries better?

label: P3-有用的书-Q3
text: Do you think old people spend more time reading than young people?
strategy: 比较类问题。可以从生活节奏、工作学习压力、休闲方式等方面分析老年人与年轻人阅读时间的差别。
answer: Yes, old people usually spend more time reading than young people. Retired people have more free time, so they enjoy books, newspapers, or magazines. Young people are often busy with school or work. They also spend much time on phones and social media instead of reading. So, older people read more for leisure, while younger people read less outside of study or work.
audio_text: Do you think old people spend more time reading than young people?

label: P3-有用的书-Q4
text: Which one is better, paper books or e-books?
strategy: 比较类问题。可以从阅读体验、便利性、价格和环保等角度说明纸质书与电子书的优缺点。
answer: Both paper books and e-books have advantages. Paper books give a special feeling and are easier on the eyes. Many people enjoy the smell and touch of real pages. E-books are lighter and cheaper. People can carry many books in one device and read anytime. They are also better for the environment. So, the choice depends on personal needs, but both are useful in modern life.
audio_text: Which one is better, paper books or e-books?

text: Describe a natural talent (sports, music, etc.) you want to improve
bullets: How you want to improve it
And how you feel about it

analysis_zh.text: 本题考察你对天赋和自我提升的表达。必须涵盖：它是什么、你什么时候发现的、你打算如何提升、以及你的感受。重点是把“自然天赋”和“努力改进”结合起来。时态以过去时描述发现的过程，以现在时/将来时描述提升计划和感受。
你可以选择音乐（唱歌、钢琴）、运动（跑步、篮球、游泳）、艺术（绘画、写作）等天赋。重点在于你为什么觉得自己有天赋，以及你打算如何通过努力让它更好，最后强调这对你的生活或信心的意义。
第一段：介绍这项天赋以及你什么时候发现的；第二段：描述你打算如何改进它，比如上课、练习、参加活动；第三段：表达你的感受和它对你的意义。

phrases: I discovered my talent when I was in primary school. 我在小学时发现了我的天赋。
My teacher told me I had a natural gift for it. 老师告诉我我在这方面有天赋。
背景描述 I realized it when I joined a school competition. 我在参加学校比赛时发现的。
My friends encouraged me to develop this skill. 朋友们鼓励我发展这项技能。
It has been part of my life since childhood. 它从小就是我生活的一部分。
I want to take lessons to improve my skill. 我想通过上课来提高我的技能。
I plan to practice regularly every week. 我计划每周定期练习。
具体描述 Watching professionals will help me learn more. 看专业人士表演会让我学到更多。
Joining a club would give me more chances. 加入社团能给我更多机会。
I need to work on both technique and confidence. 我需要在技巧和自信上都努力。
I feel excited about getting better at it. 我对提升它感到兴奋。
This talent makes me feel proud of myself. 这项天赋让我感到自豪。
描述感受 It helps me relax and express myself. 它帮助我放松并表达自己。
I believe improving it will bring me joy. 我相信提升它会带给我快乐。
It will be meaningful for my future life. 它对我的未来生活会有意义。
answer: The natural talent I would like to improve is singing. I first discovered it when I was in primary school. During a music class, my teacher asked us to sing, and she said my voice was clear and special. Later, I joined a small singing competition at school and got good feedback from my classmates. That was when I realized I had a natural gift for music. Even though I have this talent, I know it's not enough if I want to be better. I want to improve it by practicing regularly and learning more techniques. For example, I would like to take voice lessons to control my breathing and reach higher notes. I also plan to join the school music club, because singing with others will give me more chances to perform and build confidence. In my free time, I listen to professional singers and try to learn how they express emotions through songs. I feel excited whenever I think about improving my singing. It makes me proud and gives me a way to express myself. Singing also helps me relax after a long day, and it brings happiness to both me and the people who listen. I believe that working on this talent will not only make me more confident but also add more joy to my life in the future.
audio_text: Describe a natural talent (sports, music, etc.) you want to improve You should say: What it is; When you discovered it; How you want to improve it; And how you feel about it
label: P2-55
P3-想提升的天赋-Q1
text: Do you think artists with talents should focus on their talents?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从才能的价值、社会贡献、自我实现等方面说明艺术家是否应该专注于自己的才华。
answer: Yes, I think talented artists should focus on their talents. Their skills are special, and not everyone can do the same. By using their talent, they can create beautiful works that inspire people and make life richer. It also helps them feel happy and proud. Of course, they still need to live a normal life, but their talent should be the main part of their work.
audio_text: Do you think artists with talents should focus on their talents?

label: P3-想提升的天赋-Q2
text: Is it possible for us to know whether children who are 3 or 4 years old will become musicians and painters when they grow up?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从天赋表现、兴趣变化、成长环境等方面说明是否能预测孩子未来是否会成为音乐家或画家。
answer: It is hard to say for sure. Some children show talent very early, like singing in tune or drawing well at age three. This may suggest they have a gift. But children change as they grow. Interests can come and go, and many skills need years of practice. So, early signs can give a clue, but we cannot know for sure if they will become musicians or painters in the future.
audio_text: Is it possible for us to know whether children who are 3 or 4 years old will become musicians and painters when they grow up?

label: P3-想提升的天赋-Q3
text: Why do people like to watch talent shows?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从娱乐性、展示才华、观众共鸣、梦想实现等角度说明人们为什么喜欢看才艺节目。
answer: People like watching talent shows because they are fun and exciting. They can see many different skills, like singing, dancing, or magic. These shows also give ordinary people a chance to become stars, which makes the audience feel connected. Viewers enjoy stories of hard work and success. Talent shows are full of surprises, and people never know what will happen next. That makes them very popular.
audio_text: Why do people like to watch talent shows?

label: P3-想提升的天赋-Q4
text: Do you think it is more interesting to watch famous people's or ordinary people's shows?
strategy: 比较类问题。可以从知名度、亲近感、惊喜度等方面说明看明星表演和普通人表演的不同趣味，并表达个人观点。
answer: I think both are interesting, but in different ways. Famous people already have skills, so their shows are professional and polished. Ordinary people's shows feel more surprising, because no one expects them to be so good. Viewers enjoy seeing new talent and fresh stories. For me, ordinary people's shows are more exciting, because they show real effort and dreams coming true.
audio_text: Do you think it is more interesting to watch famous people's or ordinary people's shows?

text: Describe an interesting traditional story
bullets: When or how you knew it
And explain how you felt when you first heard it

analysis_zh.text: 这是“抽象物品+故事类”题目，要求描述一个有趣的传统故事。必须包含：故事内容、你是何时或如何知道的、谁告诉你的，以及你第一次听到时的感受。时态以过去时为主，感受部分可以用现在时总结。
你可以选择中国传统故事（如《牛郎织女》《嫦娥奔月》《孟姜女哭长城》）或西方传统故事（如《特洛伊木马》《伊卡洛斯》《罗宾汉》）。描述时要简要介绍故事情节，而重点放在你第一次听到时的感受（新奇、感动、震撼、害怕等）。
第一段：介绍故事的名字和大概内容；第二段：说明你是如何知道这个故事的，以及是谁告诉你的；第三段：描述你第一次听到时的感受，并解释为什么它有趣。

phrases: The story is about a famous legend in my country. 这个故事是我国著名的传说。
I first heard it when I was a child. 我第一次听到是在小时候。
背景描述 My grandmother used to tell me this story. 我奶奶常给我讲这个故事。
It is a traditional tale that has been told for centuries. 这是一个流传了几百年的传统故事。
The story is connected with a traditional festival. 这个故事和一个传统节日有关。
It is about a young couple who were separated by the gods. 它讲述了一对被神灵分开的年轻夫妻。
They could only meet once a year across the Milky Way. 他们一年只能在银河上相见一次。
The tale shows the power of love and sadness of separation. 这个故事展现了爱情的力量和分离的伤
具体描述 感。
Many poems and songs were later created about this story. 后来有很多诗歌和歌曲都与这个故事有
关。
Even today, people still celebrate it in a festival. 直到今天，人们还会在节日里纪念它。
I felt touched by the deep love in the story. 我被故事里的深情打动了。
It made me imagine what life was like in ancient times. 它让我想象古代的生活是什么样的。
I found it both sad and beautiful. 我觉得它既悲伤又美丽。
描述感受
It gave me a new way to understand love and family. 它让我用新的角度理解爱情和家庭。
Even now, I think it is one of the most meaningful stories. 即使现在，我仍觉得它是最有意义的故事
之一。
answer: One interesting traditional story that I want to talk about is the legend of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl, which is very famous in China. The story is about a poor young man who fell in love with a beautiful girl from heaven. They got married secretly and lived happily for a while, but the gods didn't allow their love. As a punishment, they were separated by the Milky Way and could only meet once a year when magpies formed a bridge for them. I first heard this story when I was about seven years old. My grandmother told it to me on the evening of the Qixi Festival, which is also called the Chinese Valentine's Day. She said people believed that on that night, the two lovers would meet in the sky. At that time, I even went outside to look up and tried to find them among the stars. When I first heard the story, I felt both sad and touched. I thought it was unfair that they couldn't stay together, but I was also amazed by their strong love. The idea of birds helping them meet sounded magical and beautiful to me. Even now, I think it's one of the most meaningful stories in our tradition because it teaches us about love, loyalty, and hope. That is why this story has stayed in my memory for so many years.
audio_text: Describe an interesting traditional story You should say: What the story is about; When or how you knew it; Who told you the story; And explain how you felt when you first heard it
label: P2-56
P3-传统故事-Q1
text: What kind of stories do children like?
strategy: 事件说明类问题。可以从题材（动物、冒险、童话）、情节特点（简单、有趣、带道理）等角度说明孩子喜欢的故事类型。
answer: Children usually like stories that are fun and easy to follow. Many enjoy fairy tales with magic, animals, or heroes. They also like adventure stories where characters go on exciting trips. Funny stories with jokes are popular too. Stories with simple lessons, like being kind or brave, are loved by children because they can understand and learn from them.
audio_text: What kind of stories do children like?

label: P3-传统故事-Q2
text: What are the benefits of listening to stories before bed?
strategy: 事件影响类问题。可以从语言学习、情感联系、习惯养成和想象力培养等方面说明睡前故事对孩子的好处。
answer: Bedtime stories bring many benefits for children. They help kids improve their language and learn new words in a fun way. Stories also make children feel safe and close to their parents before sleep. Listening to stories trains their imagination and teaches simple life lessons. It also builds a habit of reading. So, bedtime stories are good for both learning and emotional growth.
audio_text: What are the benefits of listening to stories before bed?

label: P3-传统故事-Q3
text: Why do most children like listening to stories before bedtime?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从安全感、娱乐性、语言学习、亲子关系等角度说明孩子为什么喜欢睡前故事。
answer: Most children like bedtime stories because they feel safe and happy when parents read to them. It's a warm moment before sleep. Stories are fun and take them to new worlds with animals, magic, or heroes. They also help children relax and forget worries from the day. At the same time, children learn new words and ideas. So, bedtime stories are both enjoyable and useful.
audio_text: Why do most children like listening to stories before bedtime?

label: P3-传统故事-Q4
text: What can children learn from stories?
strategy: 事件影响类问题。可以从语言能力、价值观、想象力、情感教育等角度说明孩子能从故事中学到什么。重点在于“故事”不仅是娱乐，更是教育的一种方式。
answer: Children can learn many things from stories. They can improve their language by learning new words and simple sentences. Stories also teach values like kindness, honesty, and courage. For example, many fairy tales show that being good brings rewards and being bad brings problems. Children can also grow their imagination by thinking about animals that talk or heroes that travel to new worlds. Stories help them understand life and people in an easy way.
audio_text: What can children learn from stories?

text: Describe a good habit your friend has and you want to develop
bullets: What habit he or she has
And explain why you want to develop this habit

analysis_zh.text: 这是“抽象物品+习惯类”话题，要求你描述一个朋友的好习惯，并说明你也想养成。必须包含：这个朋友是谁、习惯是什么、你什么时候注意到的、为什么你也想培养这个习惯。时态以现在时为主，涉及第一次注意到的细节时可用过去时。
好习惯可以选择：坚持锻炼、早起、每天阅读、写日记、节约、帮助别人。描述时要突出细节（你朋友如何做到），再说明你为什么想效仿（对学习/生活/健康有好处）。
第一段：介绍朋友是谁，以及他的好习惯；第二段：描述你第一次注意到的场景和细节；第三段：解释为什么你也想培养这个习惯，以及它的意义。

phrases: He is my close friend from high school. 他是我高中的好朋友。
She is my classmate at university. 她是我大学的同学。
背景描述 I have known him for many years. 我认识他很多年了。
She has always been disciplined in her daily life. 她的日常生活一直很自律。
He is someone I often learn from. 他是我经常学习的对象。
He reads for half an hour every night. 他每天晚上读半小时书。
She wakes up early to do morning exercise. 她每天早起锻炼。
具体描述 I noticed this habit when we lived in the same dorm. 我们住在一个宿舍时注意到的。
She keeps a diary to reflect on her day. 她写日记来反思一天的生活。
He never forgets to say thank you to others. 他从不忘记对别人说谢谢。
I admire his persistence and patience. 我钦佩他的坚持和耐心。
This habit makes her more confident and healthy. 这个习惯让她更自信、更健康。
描述感受 I want to follow his example. 我想效仿他。
I believe this habit will improve my life. 我相信这个习惯会改善我的生活。
It inspires me to be more disciplined. 它激励我更加自律。
answer: The friend I want to talk about is my classmate Lisa, who has a very good habit of reading every day. I have known her since middle school, and she has always been the kind of person who is disciplined and organized. Her habit is to read for at least half an hour every night before going to sleep. I first noticed this when we went to a school camp and stayed in the same dormitory. While most of us were busy chatting or playing with our phones, she always sat quietly with a book. At first, I thought it was just for that week, but later I realized she had been keeping this habit for years. She reads novels, magazines, and sometimes even non-fiction books. After reading, she often shares new ideas with us, which makes her conversations very interesting. I admire her because this habit has made her more knowledgeable and confident. I really want to develop the same habit, because I know reading can improve my language skills and broaden my view of the world. My plan is to start small, maybe ten minutes a day, and then slowly increase the time, just like she does. I believe if I can follow this habit, it will help me relax, give me new ideas, and make me more disciplined in life.
audio_text: Describe a good habit your friend has and you want to develop You should say: Who your friend is; What habit he or she has; When you noticed this habit; And explain why you want to develop this habit
label: P2-57
P3-学习朋友好习惯-Q1
text: What habits should children have?
strategy: 事件说明类问题。回答时可以从学习习惯、生活习惯、社交习惯三个角度展开。学习习惯包括按时完成作业、爱阅读；生活习惯包括早睡早起、健康饮食；社交习惯包括礼貌、分享、合作。这些习惯帮助孩子成长为健康、负责任的人。
answer: Children should have good habits in both study and daily life. For study, they should read regularly, finish homework on time, and stay curious about new things. In daily life, they should eat healthy food, sleep early, and keep clean. Social habits are also important, like being polite, sharing with others, and helping friends. These simple habits guide children to grow into kind, responsible, and successful people.
audio_text: What habits should children have?

label: P3-学习朋友好习惯-Q2
text: What should parents do to teach their children good habits?
strategy: 建议类问题。可以从以身作则、建立规则、给予奖励和鼓励等方面说明父母如何帮助孩子养成好习惯。
answer: Parents can teach their children by setting a good example. If parents read, eat healthy, or stay active, children often follow. They should also give clear rules, like going to bed early or finishing homework on time. Praise and small rewards can encourage children to keep good habits. Most importantly, parents need to be patient and guide their children step by step.
audio_text: What should parents do to teach their children good habits?

label: P3-学习朋友好习惯-Q3
text: What influences do children with bad habits have on other children?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从懒惰、压力、环境影响和缺乏自律等方面说明为什么人们会形成坏习惯。（解析有问题，答非所问）
answer: We develop bad habits because they are easy and comfortable. For example, eating junk food is faster than cooking healthy meals. Stress also makes people choose simple but unhealthy habits, like staying up late or smoking. Sometimes people copy friends or family without thinking. Bad habits often start small, but they grow if not controlled.
audio_text: What influences do children with bad habits have on other children?

label: P3-学习朋友好习惯-Q4
text: Why do some habits change when people get older?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从身体状况、责任变化、生活环境、兴趣发展等角度说明为什么习惯会随着年龄而改变。要强调“变化是自然的”，因为人们面对的需求和优先事项不一样。
answer: Some habits change when people get older because their lives are different. Young people may stay up late, play games, or try new things often. But when they grow older, they need more rest and focus on health. Adults also have more responsibilities, like work and family, so they spend time differently. Interests may change too, as older people prefer quiet activities instead of loud ones. So, habits change naturally as people's needs and priorities change.
audio_text: Why do some habits change when people get older?

text: Describe an important decision made with the help of other people
bullets: Who helped you make the decision
And how you felt about it

analysis_zh.text: 本题是“经历类+决策类”话题，需要描述一次你在他人帮助下做出的重要决定。必须包含：决策是什么、为什么要做、谁帮助你、你的感受。时态主要用过去时叙述经历，用现在时总结意义。
可以选择：选择文理分科、是否参加比赛、选择大学专业、换兴趣班。要写出纠结点，别人如何提供建议或支持，你最终的选择，以及为什么觉得重要。
第一段：介绍这个决定是什么、为什么要做；第二段：说明谁帮你做决定、他们给的建议；第三段：描述你最后的选择和感受，总结意义。

phrases: I had to make a decision about my future studies. 我必须做一个关于未来学习的决定。
It happened when I was in high school. 这件事发生在我上高中的时候。
背景描述 The decision was about choosing a major at university. 这个决定是关于大学专业选择的。
At that time, I felt very confused. 那时我感到很困惑。
I knew it would influence my future life. 我知道这会影响我的未来生活。
My parents gave me advice and shared their opinions. 我的父母给了我建议，分享了他们的看法。
My teacher explained the advantages and disadvantages. 我的老师解释了利与弊。
具体描述 My friend also encouraged me to follow my interest. 我的朋友也鼓励我追随兴趣。
We discussed the job chances and future plans. 我们讨论了就业机会和未来计划。
Finally, I made my decision with more confidence. 最终我更有信心地做出了决定。
I felt thankful for their help. 我对他们的帮助很感激。
The decision gave me a sense of direction. 这个决定给了我方向感。
描述感受 I realized the importance of listening to others. 我意识到倾听他人的重要性。
It made me more confident in facing challenges. 它让我更自信地面对挑战。
Now I think it was one of the best choices I made. 现在我认为那是我做过的最好选择之一。
answer: An important decision I made with the help of other people was choosing my major for university. It happened when I was in the last year of high school, and I had to decide whether to study English or computer science. At that time, I felt very confused, because both subjects seemed useful for the future, and I didn't want to make the wrong choice. I asked for advice from several people. My parents told me to think about what I really enjoyed, because passion would help me keep going even when things got difficult. My English teacher encouraged me by saying that I had a talent for languages and that studying English would give me many opportunities, like teaching or working abroad. On the other hand, some of my classmates suggested computer science because it was popular and had many job chances. After listening to them all, I compared the options and thought about my own interests. Finally, I chose English as my major, and I don't regret it. I felt thankful for all the advice, because without it, I might still have been lost. This decision gave me a clear sense of direction, and I became more confident in my studies. I also realized that asking for help is not a weakness but a smart way to make better choices. Even now, I believe it was one of the best decisions I made with others' support.
audio_text: Describe an important decision made with the help of other people You should say: What the decision was; Why you made the decision; Who helped you make the decision; And how you felt about it
label: P2-58
P3-别人帮忙下做的决定-Q1
text: What kind of decisions do you think are meaningful?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从人生选择、学习工作、家庭责任等方面说明哪些决定更有意义。
answer: Meaningful decisions are those that shape a person's life. Choosing a career, selecting a school, or deciding where to live are all important. Decisions about family, like marriage or having children, are also meaningful because they affect others. Even small decisions, like building healthy habits, can make life better. So, meaningful decisions are the ones that bring long-term changes.
audio_text: What kind of decisions do you think are meaningful?

label: P3-别人帮忙下做的决定-Q2
text: What important decisions should be made by teenagers themselves?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从学习选择、兴趣爱好、朋友关系和时间安排等方面说明青少年应有的自主决策。
answer: Teenagers should make decisions about their studies, hobbies, and daily life. For example, they can choose which subjects to focus on, or what activities to join after school. They should also decide how to spend their free time and choose friends they feel comfortable with. Making these decisions helps them grow independent and responsible. Parents can guide them, but teenagers need chances to learn from their own choices.
audio_text: What important decisions should be made by teenagers themselves?

label: P3-别人帮忙下做的决定-Q3
text: Why are some people unwilling to make quick decisions?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从害怕犯错、缺乏自信、性格谨慎等角度说明。
answer: Some people are unwilling to make quick decisions because they worry about making mistakes. They prefer to think carefully before acting. Others lack confidence and feel safer when they take more time. Some people are just cautious by nature. So, fear and carefulness often stop them from deciding quickly.
audio_text: Why are some people unwilling to make quick decisions?

label: P3-别人帮忙下做的决定-Q4
text: Do people like to ask for advice more for their personal life or their work?
strategy: 比较类问题。可以从两方面展开：在工作中，人们需要专业意见来解决任务或发展职业；在个人生活中，人们可能更依赖家人或朋友的建议。要说明哪一方面更常见，并给出原因，例如压力来源、决策的重要性或关系的亲密度。
answer: I think people ask for advice in both areas, but it depends on the situation. In personal life, many people turn to family or friends because they feel more comfortable talking about feelings and private problems. Advice here is often about relationships, money, or daily choices. At work, advice is also common. People may ask managers or colleagues when they face new tasks or want to grow in their career. Work advice is usually more practical and professional. So, both personal and work advice are important, but personal life advice may be asked more often because it feels closer and more emotional.
audio_text: Do people like to ask for advice more for their personal life or their work?

text: Describe a time when you received good service in a shop or store
bullets: When you went to the shop
What service you received from the staff
And explain how you felt about the service

analysis_zh.text: 这是“经历类+服务类”话题，要求描述一次你在商店/店铺里得到良好服务的经历。必须回答：商店在哪里、什么时候去的、得到的服务是什么、你的感受。时态以过去时为主，总结时用现在时。
可以选择：买衣服、买电子产品、在书店购物、在咖啡店消费。要写清楚：店员如何帮助你（介绍、耐心解答、推荐、包装），以及你为什么觉得服务好（专业、热情、让你满意）。
第一段：介绍商店位置、你什么时候去的；第二段：描述你买的东西，以及店员提供的服务；第三段：说明你的感受和为什么觉得这次服务特别好。

phrases: I went to a clothing store near my home. 我去了家附近的服装店。
It happened last winter when I needed a new coat. 这是去年冬天我需要新外套时发生的。
背景描述 The shop is located in a big shopping mall. 这家店位于一个大型商场里。
I visited it during my holiday. 我在假期里去的。
It was my first time shopping there. 那是我第一次去那里购物。
The staff greeted me with a friendly smile. 店员带着友好的微笑迎接我。
She recommended different sizes and colors. 她推荐了不同的尺码和颜色。
具体描述 He explained the material and how to take care of it. 他解释了材质和保养方法。
They also offered a discount and free gift wrapping. 他们还提供折扣和免费包装。
The service was fast, polite, and helpful. 服务快捷、礼貌又有帮助
I felt very satisfied with the service. 我对服务非常满意。
It made me want to visit the shop again. 它让我想再去这家店。
描述感受 I appreciated their patience and kindness. 我很感激他们的耐心和善意。
The shopping experience was relaxing and enjoyable. 购物体验轻松又愉快。
It gave me a good impression of the brand. 它让我对这个品牌有了好印象。
answer: A time when I received good service in a shop was last winter, when I went to a clothing store in a big shopping mall near my home. I needed a new winter coat, and my friend recommended that shop because she said the staff there were very helpful. When I entered the store, the sales assistant greeted me with a friendly smile and asked what I was looking for. I told her I wanted something warm but not too heavy. She patiently showed me several coats in different sizes and colors. She even suggested that I try on a larger size so I could wear sweaters inside during cold days. She explained the difference between wool and down material and gave me advice on how to wash and take care of them. After I chose one, she also reminded me about a seasonal discount and offered free gift wrapping, even though I was buying it for myself. I felt really satisfied with the whole experience. The staff were polite, professional, and kind, which made my shopping relaxing and enjoyable. I didn't feel any pressure to buy quickly, and I trusted her suggestions. It gave me a good impression of the store, and I decided I would go back again in the future. To me, good service means not only selling products but also showing respect and care for customers, and that's exactly what I experienced that day.
audio_text: Describe a time when you received good service in a shop or store You should say: Where the shop is; When you went to the shop; What service you received from the staff; And explain how you felt about the service
label: P2-59
P3-购物服务-Q1
text: Why are shopping malls so popular in China?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从购物便利、休闲娱乐、社交需求和气候等角度说明购物中心受欢迎的原因。
answer: Shopping malls are popular in China because they offer many choices in one place. People can buy clothes, food, and daily products easily. Malls are also places for fun, with cinemas, restaurants, and play areas for children. In hot or cold weather, malls give a comfortable space to spend time. They are not only for shopping but also for family and social activities.
audio_text: Why are shopping malls so popular in China?

label: P3-购物服务-Q2
text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of shopping in small shops?
strategy: 评估类问题。可以从价格、商品种类、个性化服务等角度说明小店购物的利与弊。
answer: Shopping in small shops has advantages like friendly service and personal care. Owners often know customers well and give good advice. But there are disadvantages too. Small shops may have fewer choices and higher prices than big supermarkets. So, small shops are good for personal service, but not always the best for variety or low cost.
audio_text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of shopping in small shops?

label: P3-购物服务-Q3
text: Why do some people not like shopping in small shops?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从商品选择少、价格高、便利性不足等方面说明。
answer: Some people don't like shopping in small shops because the choice is limited. They may not find everything they need. Prices in small shops are sometimes higher than in supermarkets. Also, small shops may not have modern services like online payment or delivery. So, many people prefer bigger shops for variety and convenience.
audio_text: Why do some people not like shopping in small shops?

label: P3-购物服务-Q4
text: What are the differences between online shopping and in-store shopping?
strategy: 比较类问题。可以从便利性、体验、选择、价格、退换货等方面说明。
answer: Online shopping is very convenient, as people can buy things anytime and get more choices. Prices are often lower too. In-store shopping lets people touch and try products before buying, which feels safer. They can also take items home immediately. The difference is that online shopping saves time, while in-store shopping gives a real experience.
audio_text: What are the differences between online shopping and in-store shopping?

topic: 感兴趣的科学学科或领域
text: Describe an area or subject of science (biology, robotics, etc.) that you are interested in and would like to learn more about
bullets: Which area or subject it is
When and where you came to know this area or subject
How you get information about this area or subject
And explain why you are interested in this area or subject

analysis_zh.text: 本题属于“抽象物品+学科兴趣”话题，要求描述一个你感兴趣并想深入学习的科学领域。必须涵盖：它是什么、你什么时候或在哪里知道它的、你如何获取相关信息、以及你为什么对它感兴趣。时态主要用现在时表达兴趣，涉及最初了解的部分可用过去时。
可选择：生物学（基因、生态）、机器人学（人工智能、自动化）、天文学（宇宙探索）、环境科学（气候变化）。介绍它是什么、你如何知道（课堂、书籍、纪录片、网络）、你平时如何学习（新闻、视频、网站），以及你为什么喜欢（有用、神秘、影响未来）。
第一段：介绍科学领域以及你最初如何接触；第二段：说明你现在如何获取信息，以及它的特点；第三段：解释为什么你对它感兴趣，以及它对你的意义。

phrases: I first learned about it in a science class. 我第一次在科学课上学到它。
I came across it in a documentary on TV. 我在电视纪录片里接触到它。
背景描述 It was introduced by my teacher in high school. 它是我高中老师介绍的。
I found it on a science website. 我在一个科学网站上看到的。
Since then, I have wanted to know more about it. 从那以后，我就想更深入了解。
I usually read articles online to get new information. 我通常在网上读文章获取新信息。
I watch videos and interviews with experts. 我看专家的视频和访谈。
具体描述 Sometimes I read magazines about science and technology. 有时我看科技类杂志。
This subject is closely related to daily life. 这个学科和日常生活紧密相关。
It develops very fast and changes the world. 它发展很快并改变世界。
I find it fascinating and meaningful. 我觉得它既迷人又有意义。
It inspires me to think about the future. 它激励我去思考未来。
描述感受 I believe it can improve people's lives. 我相信它能改善人们的生活。
It makes me more curious about nature and technology. 它让我对自然和科技更好奇。
I hope I can study it deeply in the future. 我希望将来能深入学习它。
answer: The area of science I am most interested in is robotics. I first learned about it when I was in high school. At that time, my teacher showed us a short video about how robots could help people in factories and even in hospitals. I was amazed because before that, I only thought of robots as toys or characters in movies. Now, I often read articles online and watch videos to get more information about robotics. Sometimes I find news about robots that can serve food in restaurants or help doctors in surgery. I also enjoy watching interviews with scientists who design robots. It is exciting to see how quickly this field is developing. Robotics is not only about machines but also about artificial intelligence, which makes it even more interesting. I think robotics is creative and meaningful because it can improve people's lives in many ways. For example, it can make dangerous jobs safer and help old people with daily tasks. When I see how robots are being used in real life, I feel inspired to learn more. I hope in the future I can study robotics more deeply, because it shows us what human imagination and technology can achieve together. For me, it is a subject that connects science, future, and daily life.

topic: 感兴趣的科学学科或领域
label: P3-感兴趣的科学学科或领域-Q1
text: Why do some children not like learning science at school?
strategy: 原因类问题。可以从难度、兴趣缺乏、教学方式等方面说明为什么有些孩子不喜欢科学课。
answer: Some children don't like science because they think it is hard. There are many new words and rules to remember. If teachers don't make the lessons fun, students may lose interest. Some children also find experiments difficult or boring. So, the way science is taught matters a lot in how children feel about it.
audio_text: Why do some children not like learning science at school?

topic: 感兴趣的科学学科或领域
label: P3-感兴趣的科学学科或领域-Q2
text: Is it important to study science at school?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从知识储备、逻辑思维、社会发展等角度说明科学学习的重要性。
answer: Yes, science is very important at school. It teaches students how the world works, from plants and animals to machines and space. Science also builds logical thinking and problem-solving skills. These are useful in many jobs and in daily life. Without science, students may not understand modern technology. So, it is a key part of education.
audio_text: Is it important to study science at school?

topic: 感兴趣的科学学科或领域
label: P3-感兴趣的科学学科或领域-Q3
text: Which science subject is the most important for children to learn?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从物理、化学、生物等学科的重要性出发，重点强调基础科学的作用。
answer: I think all science subjects are important, but if I must choose, I would say basic science like biology. It helps children understand nature, animals, and the human body. Physics and chemistry are also useful, but they can be harder for young students. Biology is easy to connect with daily life, so it is a good start for children.
audio_text: Which science subject is the most important for children to learn?

topic: 感兴趣的科学学科或领域
label: P3-感兴趣的科学学科或领域-Q4
text: Should people continue to study science after graduating from school?
strategy: 观点类问题。可以从终身学习、科技发展、个人成长等方面说明。
answer: Yes, people should keep learning science after school. Science changes quickly, and new knowledge appears all the time. It helps people understand modern technology, health, and the environment. Even simple science knowledge is useful in daily life. So, studying science is not only for students but also for lifelong learning.
audio_text: Should people continue to study science after graduating from school?
